summary_cn: 泰国能源企业 CKPower 获得 XPCL 支持。该公司公开了 2026 年前九个月的业绩成果。为提升后续月份的电力生产规划效率，CKPower 采用了先进的水流预测系统，以更精准地预测水位和水流量，从而优化电力规划与生产。此系统的使用有助于公司在干季来临前做好发电准备，确保泰国电力供应的稳定性。

title: Biofuel consumption soars following excise tax cuts
desc: Thailand has seen a sharp increase in biofuel consumption following the government's aggressive excise tax cuts on blended fuels, with the policy rapidly changing motorists' fuel-purchasing behaviour and providing support for the country's agricultural sector, says Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul.
title_cn: 生物燃料消费激增 政府消费税优惠政策见效
summary_cn: 泰国政府为刺激新能源消费大幅削减混合燃料消费税，政策实施后生物燃料消费出现明显激增。总理阿努廷（Anutin Charnvirakul）表示，该政策迅速改变了驾驶者的燃料购买行为，同时为国家农业部门发展提供有力支持，改善能源供应结构。
desc_original: Thailand has seen a sharp increase in biofuel consumption following the government's aggressive excise tax cuts on blended fuels, with the policy rapidly changing motorists' fuel-purchasing behaviour and providing support for the country's agricultural sector, says Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul.

title: Ex-monk leads convoy demanding cheaper fuel
desc: Mano Khrueakaew, a former monk turned village headman, has led a convoy from southern Thailand to Bangkok, demanding cheaper fuel and relief from rising living costs.
title_cn: 前僧侣率车队进京 呼吁降低燃油价格
summary_cn: 前僧侣、现任村长曼诺·克鲁阿凯（Mano Khrueakaew）率领来自泰国南部的车队进入曼谷，向政府提出降低燃油价格的诉求，并呼吁采取措施缓解日益上升的生活成本压力。此举充分反映了基层民众对油价上涨和物价高企的普遍关切。
desc_original: Mano Khrueakaew, a former monk turned village headman, has led a convoy from southern Thailand to Bangkok, demanding cheaper fuel and relief from rising living costs.

title: Deluge leaves more than water damage
desc: Protecting homes from flooding is no longer sufficient as increasingly unpredictable weather poses growing risks to both property and mental well-being, experts said on Wednesday, calling for stronger flood prevention measures, psychological preparedness and community cooperation.
title_cn: 洪灾威胁超乎想象 专家呼吁加强防洪和心理建设
summary_cn: 专家指出气候变化日益不可预测，传统的住宅防洪措施已不足以保护民众的财产和心理健康。洪灾造成的风险和影响远超单纯的水灾损失，需要更强有力的防洪措施、心理防备训练和社区合作等多管齐下应对。
desc_original: Protecting homes from flooding is no longer sufficient as increasingly unpredictable weather poses growing risks to both property and mental well-being, experts said on Wednesday, calling for stronger flood prevention measures, psychological preparedness and community cooperation.

title: KBank targets current clients for growth
desc: Kasikornbank (KBank) has focused its lending expansion primarily on existing customers, who account for 99% of new loan bookings, as it seeks to control credit risks amid mounting economic challenges.
title_cn: 开泰银行聚焦现有客户拓展业务
summary_cn: 开泰银行（KBank）为应对日益恶化的经济形势带来的信贷风险，采取保守策略，将贷款扩张重心集中于现有客户。数据显示新增贷款中99%来自既有客户，这一审慎的客户政策反映银行对当前经济前景的谨慎态度和风险管理思维。
desc_original: Kasikornbank (KBank) has focused its lending expansion primarily on existing customers, who account for 99% of new loan bookings, as it seeks to control credit risks amid mounting economic challenges.

title: Flood defences 'may fail' in future disasters
desc: Bangkok's flood defences face mounting pressure from extreme rainfall and shrinking water-retention areas, raising concerns over the capital's ability to withstand future disasters.
title_cn: 曼谷防洪设施面临失效风险
summary_cn: 曼谷的防洪防卫系统正面临来自极端降雨事件和水源涵养区萎缩的多重压力，引发外界对首都应对未来灾难能力的担忧。在气候变化加剧背景下，现有防洪设施的有效性备受质疑。
desc_original: Bangkok's flood defences face mounting pressure from extreme rainfall and shrinking water-retention areas, raising concerns over the capital's ability to withstand future disasters.

title: FTI welcomes pickup trade-in scheme
desc: The Federation of Thai Industries (FTI) has welcomed the government's planned pickup trade-in programme, saying it could help revive domestic vehicle sales, which have suffered a prolonged downturn, once the scheme receives cabinet approval, expected in 2027.
title_cn: 泰国工业联盟力挺皮卡以旧换新计划
summary_cn: 泰国工业联合会（FTI）支持政府推出的皮卡以旧换新计划，认为这将有助于拉动长期不景气的国内汽车销售。该计划预计将在2027年获内阁批准，有望成为提振泰国汽车产业的重要政策工具。
desc_original: The Federation of Thai Industries (FTI) has welcomed the government's planned pickup trade-in programme, saying it could help revive domestic vehicle sales, which have suffered a prolonged downturn, once the scheme receives cabinet approval, expected in 2027.

title: Kingdom goes on cyber alert
desc: Thailand is preparing its highest-level response to an escalating cyber threat, with the government ordering telecom operators to strengthen their defences and seeking intelligence from major technology companies, including Apple, Google and Line.
title_cn: 泰国启动最高级别网络安全警戒
summary_cn: 泰国政府发布最高级别网络威胁应对预案，要求电信运营商加强防御措施，同时向Apple、Google、Line等科技巨头征求情报。此举反映泰国正面临日益严峻的网络安全挑战，政府与私营部门携手应对威胁。
desc_original: Thailand is preparing its highest-level response to an escalating cyber threat, with the government ordering telecom operators to strengthen their defences and seeking intelligence from major technology companies, including Apple, Google and Line.

title: Analysts welcome stricter data centre regulations
desc: Stock market analysts have welcomed the cabinet's approval of stricter regulations for data centre operations, saying clearer rules should ease investor concerns over potential project delays and pave the way for fresh capital inflows to support the stock market and the wider economy.
title_cn: 监管机构批准数据中心运营新规
summary_cn: 股票市场分析师欢迎政府内阁批准的数据中心运营新规，认为更清晰的监管框架将缓解投资者对项目延期的忧虑，促进资本流入，进而支撑股市和经济发展。这一政策调整体现了泰国优化商业环境、吸引外资的努力。
desc_original: Stock market analysts have welcomed the cabinet's approval of stricter regulations for data centre operations, saying clearer rules should ease investor concerns over potential project delays and pave the way for fresh capital inflows to support the stock market and the wider economy.

title: Bang Na set to become a key economic hub
desc: In the next two years, Bang Na district is poised to become one of the most prominent economic areas in the South Sukhumvit corridor, driven by large-scale mixed-use projects such as Bangkok Mall, which will offer approximately 1 million square metres of space, as well as the expansion of existing major players such as Mega Bangna.
title_cn: 邦纳地区将成曼谷南部经济中心
summary_cn: 未来两年内，邦纳（Bang Na）区将凭借大型综合体项目——包括提供约100万平方米空间的Bangkok Mall和Mega Bangna的扩建——成为苏坤逸（Sukhumvit）南走廊最重要的经济区域之一，吸引大量商业和地产投资。
desc_original: In the next two years, Bang Na district is poised to become one of the most prominent economic areas in the South Sukhumvit corridor, driven by large-scale mixed-use projects such as Bangkok Mall, which will offer approximately 1 million square metres of space, as well as the expansion of existing major players such as Mega Bangna.

title: Scam losses reach B65.8bn in Thailand
desc: Thais suffered estimated losses of US$1.85 billion, or around 65.8 billion baht, from scams, averaging $335 per victim over a 12-month period, with phone calls, Meta social media platforms and Line remaining the most common channels used by fraudsters, according to the latest report by the Global Anti-Scam Alliance (GASA).
title_cn: 泰国诈骗损失达658亿泰铢
summary_cn: 根据全球反诈骗联盟（GASA）最新报告，泰国民众在过去12个月中因诈骗蒙受的经济损失高达约185亿美元，折合658亿泰铢，平均每名受害者个人损失达335美元。研究表明，电话、Meta社交媒体平台以及Line应用是诈骗分子使用最频繁的作案工具，这些渠道对在泰外国人和本地居民都构成重大安全隐患。
desc_original: Thais suffered estimated losses of US$1.85 billion, or around 65.8 billion baht, from scams, averaging $335 per victim over a 12-month period, with phone calls, Meta social media platforms and Line remaining the most common channels used by fraudsters, according to the latest report by the Global Anti-Scam Alliance (GASA).

title: Fuel protest poses security headache ahead of Li visit
desc: A month-long protest outside Government House has raised security concerns ahead of Chinese Premier Li Qiang's visit on Friday, with authorities seeking to reopen roads blocked by demonstrators demanding a 10-baht-per-litre cut in fuel prices.
title_cn: 燃油抗议成为李强访泰前的安保隐患
summary_cn: 政府大楼外发生的燃油价格抗议已持续一个月，示威者强烈要求政府将每升燃料价格下调10泰铢。抗议导致多条道路被占据阻塞，在中国总理李强定于本周五访问泰国前夕，给当局带来严峻的安保压力和外交挑战。政府已启动应急措施，试图重新开放被占据的道路以确保访问顺利进行。
desc_original: A month-long protest outside Government House has raised security concerns ahead of Chinese Premier Li Qiang's visit on Friday, with authorities seeking to reopen roads blocked by demonstrators demanding a 10-baht-per-litre cut in fuel prices.

title: NACC flags B50m sports equipment scam
desc: The National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) has found grounds for criminal proceedings in a 50.5-million-baht procurement scheme involving outdoor fitness and recreational equipment approved by the late former director-general of the Department of Physical Education, Saengchan Worasuman, in fiscal 2013.
title_cn: 反腐委发现5000万泰铢体育设备采购舞弊案
summary_cn: 泰国国家反腐败委员会（NACC）调查发现一起重大体育设备采购腐败案，涉案金额达5050万泰铢。该项目由已故体育教育部处长尚昌·沃拉素曼在2013财年时批准。NACC已掌握充分证据，决定推进刑事诉讼程序，涉案人员和相关责任方面临严肃法律追究。
desc_original: The National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) has found grounds for criminal proceedings in a 50.5-million-baht procurement scheme involving outdoor fitness and recreational equipment approved by the late former director-general of the Department of Physical Education, Saengchan Worasuman, in fiscal 2013.

title: Special holiday for cremation
desc: The cabinet has declared Dec 16 a special public holiday to allow people to attend or observe the royal cremation ceremony of Her Majesty Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother.
title_cn: 12月16日定为诗丽吉皇后太后火化仪式特别假期
summary_cn: 泰国内阁宣布将12月16日定为全国特别公众假期，以便全国民众能够参加或观礼诗丽吉皇后太后的皇家火化仪式。此举充分体现政府对这一重要王室活动的重视，同时为民众参与皇家庆典预留了充足的时间。此特别假期是国家对王室的敬礼。
desc_original: The cabinet has declared Dec 16 a special public holiday to allow people to attend or observe the royal cremation ceremony of Her Majesty Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother.

title: Gender gaps persist across Thai society
desc: Gender-based violence, unequal care responsibilities and limited political representation continue to restrict women's opportunities in Thailand despite progress in education and healthcare, according to a United Nations report.
title_cn: 性别不平等问题继续困扰泰国社会
summary_cn: 联合国最新报告指出，尽管泰国在教育和医疗领域取得显著进展，但性别不平等问题依然广泛存在。性别暴力、不平等的家庭照护责任分配、以及妇女在政治决策中的代表权不足，继续严重限制了妇女的各方面发展机会。报告强调，解决这些根深蒂固的性别差距仍是泰国社会发展的关键任务。
desc_original: Gender-based violence, unequal care responsibilities and limited political representation continue to restrict women's opportunities in Thailand despite progress in education and healthcare, according to a United Nations report.

title: Honouring 3 top CEOs
desc: The Bangkok Post today publishes the third instalment of its "Bangkok Post CEO of the Year 2026" series, profiling three more award winners.
title_cn: 表彰三位年度杰出CEO
summary_cn: 曼谷邮报今日公布「2026年度最佳CEO」系列报道的第三期，介绍三位新获奖的CEO人选，涵盖企业领袖的杰出贡献和成就。
desc_original: The Bangkok Post today publishes the third instalment of its "Bangkok Post CEO of the Year 2026" series, profiling three more award winners.

title: Federation slashes SET index year-end target
desc: The Federation of Thai Capital Market Organizations (Fetco) has cut its year-end target for the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) index to 1,550-1,600 points from 1,700, following a sharper-than-expected market decline, but noted that earnings and potential foreign inflows could limit further losses.
title_cn: 泰国资本市场联合会下调SET指数年底目标
summary_cn: 泰国资本市场组织联合会(Fetco)因市场跌幅超出预期，将泰国证券交易所(SET)指数年底目标从1700点下调至1550-1600点。联合会指出经济基本面和潜在外资流入可望限制进一步下跌空间。
desc_original: The Federation of Thai Capital Market Organizations (Fetco) has cut its year-end target for the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) index to 1,550-1,600 points from 1,700, following a sharper-than-expected market decline, but noted that earnings and potential foreign inflows could limit further losses.

title: NT strengthens network cybersecurity, resilience
desc: National Telecom (NT) has assured the public that Thailand's telecommunications infrastructure is prepared to withstand potential cyber-attacks and other disruptions, pledging to maintain uninterrupted communications through enhanced network surveillance, backup systems and strengthened cybersecurity measures.
title_cn: 泰国国家电信公司加强网络安全防御能力
summary_cn: 泰国国家电信公司(NT)宣布该国电信基础设施已做好应对网络攻击和其他中断事件的准备，将通过增强网络监控、备份系统和强化网络安全措施来确保通信服务不中断。
desc_original: National Telecom (NT) has assured the public that Thailand's telecommunications infrastructure is prepared to withstand potential cyber-attacks and other disruptions, pledging to maintain uninterrupted communications through enhanced network surveillance, backup systems and strengthened cybersecurity measures.

title: Thai bourse likely to remain range-bound
desc: Thailand's stock market is likely to remain range-bound as external pressures, particularly US interest rates and bond yields, weigh on global capital flows and investor sentiment, says global asset and wealth manager Aberdeen Investments.
title_cn: 泰国股市料将维持区间整理
summary_cn: 全球资产和财富管理公司Aberdeen Investments认为，泰国股市受美国利率和债券收益率等外部压力影响，全球资本流向和投资者情绪疲弱，股市可能继续维持区间震荡态势。
desc_original: Thailand's stock market is likely to remain range-bound as external pressures, particularly US interest rates and bond yields, weigh on global capital flows and investor sentiment, says global asset and wealth manager Aberdeen Investments.

title: New joint venture looking to revive Robinhood
desc: The SET-listed tech company SKY ICT and the shipping conglomerate Thoresen Thai Agencies (TTA) are joining forces to secure the intellectual property of the homegrown food delivery app Robinhood in a 100-million-baht deal.
title_cn: SKY ICT与Thoresen合作复兴Robinhood外卖应用
summary_cn: 泰国科技公司SKY ICT与运输集团Thoresen Thai Agencies (TTA)成立合资企业，以1亿泰铢收购本土外卖应用Robinhood的知识产权，意在重振这款曾活跃的本地服务平台。
desc_original: The SET-listed tech company SKY ICT and the shipping conglomerate Thoresen Thai Agencies (TTA) are joining forces to secure the intellectual property of the homegrown food delivery app Robinhood in a 100-million-baht deal.

desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月10日，泰国副总理兼财政部长艾尼提在内阁会议后表示，泰国内阁已批准数据中心行业监管政策，明确数据中心经营标准及审批许可制度，监管范围覆盖用电功率0.5兆瓦及以上的数据中心。内阁责成数字经济与社会部设立一站式服务中心（OSS），并成立审核委员会，统筹项目审批和制定各部门执行规则。获批企业须达到最低标准，并为泰国创造最大利益。 艾尼提表示，数据中心是人工智能和数字经济的重要基础设施，近两三年快速兴起，但消耗大量电力和水资源，也可能影响周边社区。此前泰国缺乏明确监管规则，各部门分别审批，出现投资促进申请、提前圈占电力配额后转售，以及提前申请设立和施工许可等问题。为此，泰国总理成立专门委员会，负责制定统一规则。 统一规则，加强行业监管 该政策有两大目标：一是为投资者提供确定性，让真正为国家创造利益的企业能够持续经营；二是通过环境、社区及选址监管，让公众安心。 内阁要求数字经济与社会部建立“TH-DC数据看板”，公开泰国数据中心的数量及位置，并依据国际标准，以用电功率作为分类依据。过去，银行、企业、应用程序及社交媒体的数据存储设施，均被统称为数据中心。 对于新增投资，审批将不再仅看投资金额，还将考虑就业创造、泰国劳动力技能提升、泰国民众收入增长、与本国产业供应链的衔接，以及清洁能源使用情况。政府将参考新加坡做法，要求投资者就创造就业、引进科技和人工智能供应链等提出竞争性方案。新项目须接受全面评估，包括环境影响、水电使用效率以及对整体经济的贡献。 按用电功率划分七级 泰国国家经济与社会发展委员会秘书长、数据中心经营政策委员会秘书达努查介绍，监管范围涵盖用电功率0.5兆瓦及以上的项目。低于这一规模的设施通常设于机构或银行内部，影响范围较小。具体分为七级： 第1级：低于0.5兆瓦 第2级：0.5兆瓦至低于5兆瓦 第3级：5兆瓦至低于10兆瓦 第4级：10兆瓦至低于20兆瓦 第5级：20兆瓦至低于50兆瓦 第6级：50兆瓦至低于200兆瓦 第7级：200兆瓦及以上 达努查表示，20兆瓦及以上项目将受到更严格监管。低于20兆瓦的第2至第4级项目，须遵守环境操作规范（CoP），包括噪声、温度及用电效率等要求，具体细则将进一步公开征求意见。选址方面，低于20兆瓦的项目可设于商业用地；20兆瓦及以上项目只能设于工业用地。 规范环境操作，明确过渡安排 关于环境影响评价报告（EIA），达努查解释，一般数据中心主要是在建筑内安装服务器、计算机及空调系统，按照EIA判定原则，不属于产生严重环境影响的项目，因此通常无须单独开展EIA。不过，CoP将规定：停电时启用备用发电机，项目围栏边界处噪声不得超过70分贝；建筑周边温度升幅不得超过约1至2摄氏度；循环冷却系统排水前须控制水质；如项目位于工业园区内，须遵守该园区EIA要求。 过渡期内，对2026年8月14日相关规定刊登
title_cn: 泰国内阁批准数据中心行业监管新规：0.5兆瓦及以上项目纳入审批许可管理
summary_cn: 泰国内阁批准了数据中心行业监管政策，覆盖0.5兆瓦及以上项目。政策旨在规范快速增长的数据中心行业，解决此前各部门分散审批导致的问题。新监管框架包括一站式服务中心、审核委员会，按用电功率分为七级，实行差异化管理。20兆瓦及以上项目需设于工业用地并接受更严格审查，涉及环保、社区影响等多方面评估。政府希望通过统一规则，既为投资者提供确定性，又通过监管保护公众利益。

title_cn: 泰国人储蓄能力强但退休后难以富足？低息存款陷阱与职业年金困境
summary_cn: KKP研究所指出，泰国人退休后面临的核心问题不仅是储蓄不足，更重要的是缺乏投资理财技能以应对通胀压力。随着国民平均寿命延长，单纯依靠储蓄和职业年金 PVD 基金可能难以维系晚年生活，因为银行存款利率极低、基金增值幅度有限。这提示泰国民众需要学习更多投资知识。

title: Khon Kaen University first-year student recognised by NASA for cybersecurity work
desc: Khon Kaen University first-year student recognised by NASA for cybersecurity work Legacy A first-year Thai cybersecurity student at Khon Kaen University received a letter of recognition from NASA after identifying and responsibly reporting a security vulnerability in the US space agency’s information systems. Khon Kaen University announced that Thanaphon Butsrisicha, a student in the Cybersecurity programme at its College of Computing, had received an official letter of appreciation dated November 5, 2026. He is also known online by the alias nullbyt3z. According to the university, NASA recognised Thanaphon’s contribution to maintaining the integrity and availability of its space information systems. Thanaphon identified a Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability, a type of security weakness that can allow malicious code to be inserted into web pages. He reported the issue through NASA’s Vulnerability Disclosure Policy (VDP). The university’s College of Computing described his approach as responsible disclosure, a standard practice in cybersecurity that involves reporting vulnerabilities directly to the system owner in accordance with established procedures.

summary_cn: 孔敬大学网络安全专业一年级学生 Thanaphon Butsrisicha（网名 nullbyt3z）因发现并负责任地报告美国航空航天局 NASA 信息系统中的跨站脚本 XSS 安全漏洞而获得官方表扬信。该学生通过 NASA 漏洞披露政策进行了规范的负责任披露，体现了专业的安全伦理。此成就对于同龄学生而言属罕见，展现了泰国年轻人的技术潜力。

title: Chinese tourists skip Thailand as safety concerns persist
desc: Chinese tourists skip Thailand as safety concerns persist Legacy Chinese tourist arrivals in Thailand fell in October despite China’s Golden Week holiday , with concerns over safety and recent flooding in Bangkok cited as possible reasons for the decline. Thailand welcomed 308,942 Chinese visitors during the month, down 13.6% from October 2025 and below the 349,182 arrivals recorded in September 2026, according to Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) figures. The decline came despite China’s National Day holiday, known as Golden Week, which is traditionally one of the busiest periods for Chinese residents travelling overseas. Safety concerns were identified as one factor affecting travel sentiment after the Chinese Embassy in Thailand issued an advisory on October 16, urging Chinese nationals to plan their journeys carefully and take precautions when travelling and using transport services. The warning followed several reported kidnappings involving Chinese nationals . The embassy also advised influencers and entertainers to be cautious of high-paying job offers in Thailand that could be linked to transnational criminal networks. Photo via Magnific The South China Mornin

title: Thai Airways faces complaints after Munich-Bangkok flight operated without running water
desc: Thai Airways faces complaints after Munich-Bangkok flight operated without running water Legacy Thai Airways drew mixed reactions online after a passenger experienced a flight from Munich to Bangkok without running water in the aircraft’s lavatory. International aviation blog LoyaltyLobby shared a photograph of a drinking water bottle placed on a lavatory counter yesterday, November 9, claiming that a reader had encountered another Thai Airways flight without running water on the Munich-Bangkok route. The bottle appeared to have been provided by cabin crew for passengers to wash their hands after using the toilet. A handwritten note was attached, although its message was difficult to read. LoyaltyLobby did not provide the flight date or number, and the extent of the reported water outage was unclear. Thai Airways had not publicly commented on the incident at the time of reporting. title: Thailand puts 10 border provinces on alert over Myanmar fighting
desc: Thailand puts 10 border provinces on alert over Myanmar fighting Legacy Thailand has ordered 10 provinces along the Myanmar border to step up security and preparations after bullets and shell fragments from fighting in Myanmar crossed into Mae Sot district, Tak, damaging homes and property. The Interior Ministry announced the measures yesterday, November 9, as clashes between Myanmar military forces and resistance groups continued near Phalu village on the Myanmar side of the border. Unsit Sampuntharat, permanent secretary of the Interior Ministry, said governors had been told to work with the military, police and local officials to monitor the situation and protect residents. The order covers Kanchanaburi, Chumphon, Chiang Rai, Chiang Mai, Prachuap Khiri Khan, Phetchaburi, Tak, Mae Hong Son, Ranong and Ratchaburi. Governors have been instructed to coordinate through provincial border command centres and report any serious incidents or significant developments to the ministry for further action. title_cn: 泰国10个边境省份因缅甸交战进入警戒状态
summary_cn: 泰国内政部11月9日下令10个缅甸边境省份提高安全防备。此前缅甸军队与反抗组织在坦克府(Tak)边界附近交战，子弹和炮弹碎片穿过国境，击中民居和财产。各府长被指示与军警协调，监控局势、保护居民，并通过省级边境指挥中心报告重大事件。防备措施覆盖北碧、春蓬、清莱等战略位置。

title: Thai news anchor calls for probe into Watchdog Thailand finances
desc: Thai news anchor calls for probe into Watchdog Thailand finances Legacy A Thai television news anchor called for an investigation into the finances of the animal welfare foundation Watchdog Thailand (WDT) , alleging that some members may have used donations for personal benefit. A former WDT president filed a defamation complaint against the anchor, denying the allegations. The news anchor, Narakorn Tiyayon, raised the issue in a Facebook post on November 9, calling for an examination of the foundation’s financial transactions. She said she had heard allegations that the president, board members and treasurer had used donations for personal purposes. Her post followed the arrest of former beauty queen Panadda Wongphudee and her husband over allegations that they misused donations to the Ongkorn Tham Dee Foundation for personal benefit. The case involving Ongkorn Tham Dee is separate from the allegations concerning WDT. Narakorn’s post attracted comments from social media users, some of whom called for WDT’s spending to be examined. Others shared accounts of their experiences seeking assistance from the foundation. Narakorn | Photo via Facebook/ นารากร ติยายน A wom

title: Thailand’s cool season is here, but don’t expect much cold
desc: Thailand’s cool season is here, but don’t expect much cold Legacy Thailand officially entered its cool season yesterday, November 9, but temperatures are expected to be milder than usual this year , with Bangkok forecast to see lows of just 19 to 21°C and the coldest weather arriving in January 2027. Nattawut Daendee, acting director-general of the Thai Meteorological Department (TMD), announced the start of the cool season, explaining that temperatures would not immediately drop across the country. He said the seasonal transition is marked by changes in wind patterns and weather conditions, while the extent of the temperature drop will depend on cold air masses moving south from China. As a result, conditions may vary between regions during the early part of the season. Some areas could experience cooler weather, while others may remain hot during the day or continue to receive rainfall. Photo via Magnific The department expects a milder-than-usual cool season, with El Niño and global warming potentially contributing to higher temperatures. title: Foreign man held over alleged convenience store theft in Pattaya
desc: Foreign man held over alleged convenience store theft in Pattaya Legacy Municipal officers and beach lifeguards detained a foreign man in Jomtien, Pattaya , yesterday, November 9, after staff at a convenience store reported that he had taken goods without paying . The officers held the man at the scene before coordinating with Pattaya City Police Station to hand him over for further legal proceedings. Pattaya City’s law enforcement unit said its Jomtien team responded to the store’s complaint with assistance from local beach lifeguards. Photo via Facebook: Pattaya City Law Enforcement The man was described only as a foreign national with a dishevelled appearance. His nationality was not disclosed, nor were details of the goods he allegedly took or their value. No charges have been announced at the time of reporting. Under Thailand’s Penal Code, theft carries a maximum penalty of three years in prison and a fine of up to 6,000 baht, regardless of the value of the stolen goods. title: Thai Airways confirms passenger data leak but credit card details safe
desc: Thai Airways confirms passenger data leak but credit card details safe Legacy Thai Airways reported a data breach involving approximately 60,529 passenger booking records accessed without authorisation through the Amadeus reservation system. The airline said credit card information was not affected . In a statement yesterday, November 9, Thai Airways said it had received notification from Amadeus IT Group S.A. , the provider of its passenger reservation and service systems, about unauthorised access to passenger booking information stored on the company’s systems. The incident involved unauthorised access detected between August 10, 2023, and September 23, 2026. An investigation found that approximately 60,529 passenger records had been accessed. The information included passenger names, passenger name records (PNRs), travel dates, flight routes and ticket classes. Photo by Chettarin via Getty Images Thai Airways also reported that more detailed personal information belonging to around 376 passengers had been exposed. title: Suvarnabhumi Airport tightens rules on bringing pets into terminals
desc: Suvarnabhumi Airport tightens rules on bringing pets into terminals Legacy Suvarnabhumi Airport has tightened restrictions on bringing animals into designated airport areas, banning pets unless they are travelling by air or qualify for specific exemptions. Airports of Thailand (AOT) issued the rules to improve safety for passengers, visitors and airport operations, with Suvarnabhumi Airport sharing the announcement on its official Facebook page. The restrictions cover the main passenger terminal, concourses, restricted airside areas and other locations designated by the airport director. The ban applies to all animals, including dogs, cats, birds, land and aquatic animals, and insects. However, exemptions are available for animals being transported by air, guide dogs for people with disabilities and specially authorised animals. Explosives detection dogs and other dogs working under the supervision of officials are also exempt. Photo via Suvarnabhumi Airport Under the rules, passengers travelling with pets must keep them securely inside suitable cages or carriers to prevent escapes, injuries or disturbances to other airport users. title: 泰国航空紧急增派人手，加快解决货物爆仓
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 近日，泰国航空就素万那普国际机场进出口货物仓储服务延误问题作出说明。由于航空进出口货运量持续增加，大量航空集装载具积压，等待拆分和入库存储，导致部分货物交付时间延长。对此，泰国航空正加紧调配人员、设备及相关资源，并与泰国机场公司合作，采取措施缓解货物积压，同时推进仓储管理系统升级。 泰国航空表示，公司已注意到此次延误对客户、合作航空公司及相关经营者造成的影响，并对由此带来的不便表示歉意。目前，公司正在增加作业人员、补充必要设备，全力加快积压货物的处理进度，争取尽快恢复正常运作。 在具体措施方面，泰国航空将增加作业人员，额外配置叉车，加快货物拆分、入库及交付流程，同时按照优先级安排货物交付，以提高整体处理效率。 其次，公司正与泰国机场公司协调，争取增加临时货物存放区域，以扩大货物接收能力、缓解仓库内部拥堵。此外，双方也将研究进一步优化场地使用的方案，并确保符合相关安全标准及规定。 在仓储管理方面，泰国航空计划引入仓储管理系统，覆盖货物接收、拆分、存放位置标记及最终交付等环节。同时，建立持续追踪和报告机制，实时掌握进口、出口货物数量及积压情况，以便及时评估仓库运营状况，合理安排人力和设备，根据实际情况灵活调整工作计划。 此外，泰国航空将进一步加强与泰国机场公司的合作，共同宣传并推动相关经营者使用AOT Cargo Clearhouse货运管理系统，以加快货物交付流程，提高整体货运运作效率。 泰国航空强调，此次措施不仅着眼于解决当前货物积压问题，也包括长期改善仓储管理体系，进一步提升作业效率、货物处理能力及服务质量。公司将持续优化工作流程，积极处理运营中出现的问题，并以客户的便利与利益为优先，逐步提升整体服务水平。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan） The post 泰国航空紧急增派人手，加快解决货物爆仓 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 泰国拟推电动摩托车补贴！每辆补1.7万泰铢，计划覆盖40万辆
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，近日，泰国政府计划推出电动摩托车补贴项目“MTC EV++”，又称“每人一辆Plus”，拟投入超过60亿泰铢，鼓励民众购买泰国本土生产的电动摩托车。根据方案，符合条件的消费者每购买一辆电动摩托车，可获得1.7万泰铢补贴，计划支持40万辆。不过，该项目目前仍处于贷款资金使用审核阶段，尚未正式获批实施。 11月10日，泰国消费税厅厅长蓬猜表示，消费税厅已提出“MTC EV++”项目申请，计划使用政府根据《2026年财政部借款授权紧急法令》设立的2000亿泰铢贷款额度，以应对能源危机带来的影响，并推动泰国能源转型。除电动摩托车补贴外，相关方案还包括以旧车置换新皮卡的项目。 “MTC EV++”项目的主要目标是鼓励民众购买泰国国内生产的纯电动摩托车（BEV），计划补贴40万辆，每辆补贴1.7万泰铢，总预算超过60亿泰铢。 消费税厅数据显示，2025年泰国新登记的纯电动摩托车共有23971辆，仅占当年所有新登记摩托车总量的1.38%，反映出泰国摩托车电动化转型仍面临一定限制。 摩托车是泰国民众日常生活中重要的交通工具，尤其受到中低收入群体、自由职业者及依靠摩托车谋生的劳动者广泛使用。然而，电动摩托车相对较高的初始购买价格以及首付款和分期付款渠道方面的限制，仍然影响消费者的购买意愿。 根据目前提出的项目执行方案，消费者购买电动摩托车时，授权经销商须通过项目管理系统录入交易资料及车辆识别号码。随后，符合条件的消费者需要确认相关信息，再由系统连接车辆登记数据库，核实购买资格并防止重复申领补贴。 完成相关程序后，制造商可向消费税厅提交补偿申请，经审核确认后，再交由泰国政府储蓄银行办理补贴资金拨付。按照这一机制，制造商将先行向消费者支付政府补贴，之后再向相关部门申请补偿。 此次电动摩托车补贴计划是泰国政府应对能源危机的一项措施，同时还将配合居民太阳能项目推进，旨在减少化石燃料使用，并让民众更容易获得替代能源技术。 不过，消费税厅强调，目前“MTC EV++”项目仍须等待贷款资金使用审查委员会的审核结果，尚未获得正式批准。因此，每辆补贴1.7万泰铢及覆盖40万辆的方案仍属于拟议措施，具体实施时间及申请条件有待后续公布。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：thaipbs） The post 泰国拟推电动摩托车补贴！每辆补1.7万泰铢，计划覆盖40万辆 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 一场现场失控，一场直接停演！BIGBANG曼谷演唱会两晚连出状况
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月7日至8日，韩国组合BIGBANG出道20周年世界巡回演唱会《XX : COSMOS》曼谷站在拉加曼加拉国家体育场连续举行两晚。此次巡演由AEG Presents Asia主办，iMe Thailand负责当地执行。然而，两晚演出接连出现不同状况：首场内场观众发生推挤、越过隔离围栏等秩序问题，次场则因强风、暴雨及雷电天气中途叫停。 11月9日，iMe Thailand宣布对8日场次实施全额退款，门票发行手续费及支付渠道手续费也由主办方承担。退款解决了票款问题，但更值得关注的是：这两起状况，有多少本可以通过事前规划和风险管理加以防范？ 首场：内场秩序为何出现混乱？ 社交平台流传的视频显示，11月7日首场演出期间，部分内场观众搬动塑料座椅并向舞台方向前移，周边观众随之跟进，人流逐渐向前涌动。靠近舞台围栏的位置一度出现推挤，甚至有人翻越围栏，安保人员多次上前劝阻，但未能及时有效控制现场局面。 从视频来看，内场座椅似为单张摆放，未见明显的固定或连排处理。如果现场情况确如视频所呈现，座椅设置及区域管理就值得进一步检视。 一些国际演出安全规范明确要求，临时座椅应妥善固定，或按照规定连排设置，避免观众随意移动座椅，同时防止座椅在紧急疏散时阻碍通道。此次曼谷站的座椅设置是否符合相关安全要求，仍有待主办方及场馆管理方说明。 座椅一旦能够被随意搬动，原有票区界线便可能失去实际约束力。当部分观众向舞台方向移动，周围人群跟随前移时，原本明确划分的观众区域就可能逐渐失去秩序。而围栏前的人群挤压，更可能进一步增加跌倒、踩踏及人员受伤的风险。 因此，关键不只是现场安排了多少安保人员，更在于主办方是否建立了明确的分级处置机制：当观众开始离座前移时，由谁负责介入？多长时间内必须作出反应？当人群出现持续推挤时，是否需要暂停演出，通过场馆大屏幕和广播重新稳定秩序？ 截至发稿，AEG Presents Asia与iMe Thailand均未就首场演出的现场秩序问题作出公开说明，也未见警方发布相关通报。公众有理由期待主办方进一步说明现场管理情况，并公布后续改进措施。 次场：天气风险并非完全无法预判 11月8日晚，曼谷突遭强风、暴雨及雷电天气。演出进行至第6首歌曲时，于20时05分被迫中止。场馆随后通过大屏幕以泰语、中文及英语发布通知，提醒观众保持冷静并有序离场。BIGBANG三名成员G-DRAGON（权志龙）、TAEYANG（太阳）及DAESUNG（大声）随后冒雨返回舞台，向现场观众鞠躬致歉。 对于露天场馆而言，遭遇雷暴天气后叫停演出，是必要的安全措施。强降雨可能导致舞台设备进水，电力系统、音响设备及金属结构在恶劣天气下也可能带来额外风险，而雷电更直接威胁场内数万名观众及工作人员的安全。演出能否继续，不应仅以雨势是否暂时减弱作为判断依据。 但及时叫停演出，并不意味着此前的风险
title_cn: 一场现场失控，一场直接停演！BIGBANG 曼谷演唱会两晚连出状况
summary_cn: 11 月 7-8 日，韩国组合 BIGBANG 在曼谷拉加曼加拉国家体育场（Rajamangala Stadium）连续举办出道 20 周年巡演两场。首场因观众推挤、越过围栏等秩序混乱险些失控，次场遭遇强风暴雨及雷电被迫中止。主办方随后对 8 日场次实施全额退款。事件暴露出现场座椅固定不足、应急处置机制不完善等风险管理漏洞。

title: 豪宅变诈骗窝点！泰国警方捣毁跨国诈骗团伙，10名嫌犯落网
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，11月9日，泰国警方突袭春武里府邦拉蒙县一处豪华住宅，成功捣毁一个跨国网络诈骗窝点，逮捕10名中国籍及缅甸籍嫌疑人，查获32部手机、2台笔记本电脑及178张以上SIM卡。初步调查发现，该团伙利用网络恋爱关系诱骗受害者投资，已有约100名中国公民受骗，累计经济损失估计高达3亿泰铢。 此次行动中，警方持春武里府法院签发的搜查令进入住宅，共逮捕10名外国人，其中包括8名中国籍人员和2名缅甸籍人员，查获2台笔记本电脑、32部手机及178张以上SIM卡。 经调查，8名中国籍嫌疑人均涉嫌非法入境泰国，其中7人经沙缴府泰柬边境进入泰国，另1人则经乌汶府泰老入境。此外，8人中有4人已被中国有关部门通缉，分别为涉嫌诈骗的Yang 某、涉嫌人身伤害案件的Chao某、涉嫌参与电信诈骗的Zuo某和Xu某。 另外，两名缅甸籍人员中，Min Khing因涉嫌非法入境被指控，Nang Thazin Aye则因签证逾期居留357天被查处。 警方初步调查发现，该诈骗团伙分工明确，主要分为三个环节。第一组人员负责通过抖音寻找潜在受害者；第二组人员则与受害者建立联系，通过聊天、培养感情等方式，在约15至30天内逐步取得对方信任，随后诱骗受害者下载虚假的中药股票投资应用程序，并要求将资金转入中国境内的银行账户；第三组人员则在中国境内负责从相关账户提取资金，并通过不同渠道转移、周转诈骗所得。 根据嫌疑人初步供述，该团伙以每月14万泰铢的价格租下这处豪华住宅，作为诈骗行动基地，至今已运作约6个月。警方初步发现，受害者约有100人，主要为中国公民。仅在11月9日上午，警方掌握的相关诈骗损失就约达200万泰铢；根据进一步询问及初步调查资料估算，该团伙累计造成的经济损失可能高达约3亿泰铢。 目前，警方正在进一步收集证据、核实嫌疑人身份，并中国有关部门协调，核查相关通缉信息，以依法追究涉案人员责任。同时，警方将继续扩大调查范围，追查其在泰国及其他国家的关联人员和资金流向。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：mgronline） The post 豪宅变诈骗窝点！泰国警方捣毁跨国诈骗团伙，10名嫌犯落网 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

desc_original: กรมอุตุนิยมวิทยา ประกาศฉบับ 4 ภาคใต้ยังคงมีฝนตกหนักถึงหนักมากบางแห่ง 10-13 พ.ย.69 ส่วนไทยตอนบนมีฝนน้อย และมีอากาศเย็นลงกับมีลมแรง สำหรับภาคเหนือตอนบนจะมีฝนฟ้าคะนองและลมกระโชกแรง

title: Survey finds Thais keen on AI use
desc: Thai consumers are significantly more optimistic about artificial intelligence (AI) than their global peers, with 74% seeing more benefits than drawbacks, compared with 55% worldwide. Meanwhile, 80% of employed Thais say AI tools have helped them save time at work, according to France-based research firm Ipsos.
title_cn: 调查显示泰国人热衷使用人工智能
summary_cn: 根据法国调查机构 Ipsos 研究，泰国消费者对人工智能的乐观态度远超全球同行，74% 认为益处大于风险，较全球 55% 的比例高出显著；80% 的泰国在职人士表示 AI 工具帮助节省工作时间。反映泰国对新技术的接受度和应用热情较高。
desc_original: Thai consumers are significantly more optimistic about artificial intelligence (AI) than their global peers, with 74% seeing more benefits than drawbacks, compared with 55% worldwide. Meanwhile, 80% of employed Thais say AI tools have helped them save time at work, according to France-based research firm Ipsos.

title: New platform rules put out to consultation
desc: The Trade Competition Commission is seeking public input on draft regulations prohibiting online platforms from tying sellers to their own logistics providers and requiring fair fees for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).
title_cn: 泰国平台竞争新规征意见 禁止强制绑定物流
summary_cn: 泰国贸易竞争委员会（Trade Competition Commission）向公众征求意见，草拟新规禁止在线平台强制卖家与其自有物流提供商绑定，并要求对中小企业（SME）收费执行公平定价，保护中小企业在平台上的公平竞争权益。
desc_original: The Trade Competition Commission is seeking public input on draft regulations prohibiting online platforms from tying sellers to their own logistics providers and requiring fair fees for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).

title: Benz plans 40 launches amid Asean EV boom
desc: Mercedes-Benz Group AG plans to launch 40 new vehicle models globally over the next two years (2027-28), driven by robust growth in electric vehicle (EV) markets, particularly in Southeast Asia.
title_cn: 奔驰计划推出40款新车，乘东盟电动车热潮
summary_cn: 梅赛德斯-奔驰集团计划在2027-2028年间全球推出40款新车型，其中东南亚市场是重点投入地区。这一战略响应了东盟地区电动车市场的迅速增长势头。该举措反映了全球汽车产业向电动化转型的大势，泰国作为重要汽车消费市场正迎来发展机遇。
desc_original: Mercedes-Benz Group AG plans to launch 40 new vehicle models globally over the next two years (2027-28), driven by robust growth in electric vehicle (EV) markets, particularly in Southeast Asia.

title: New initiative seeks to drive up investment in 7 sectors
desc: The government is committed to driving investment in seven target industries under its Reinvent Thailand initiative, aiming to generate an additional 5.4 trillion baht in revenue by 2030.
title_cn: 泰国推「重塑泰国」倡议，瞄准7大产业吸引投资
summary_cn: 泰国政府正式启动「重塑泰国」(Reinvent Thailand) 倡议，承诺在7个战略性产业中推动投资增长。该计划目标到2030年为国家经济增加5.4万亿泰铢的额外收入。政府期望通过产业投资升级，驱动国家经济实现可持续增长，促进经济多元化发展。
desc_original: The government is committed to driving investment in seven target industries under its Reinvent Thailand initiative, aiming to generate an additional 5.4 trillion baht in revenue by 2030.

title: Trade regulator defends new platform rules
desc: The Trade Competition Commission of Thailand (TCCT) has reaffirmed its legal authority to regulate fee structures imposed by ride-hailing, food delivery and e-commerce platforms, vowing to press ahead with its planned new guidelines despite reports that two major food delivery operators are considering legal action against them.
title_cn: 泰国贸易委员会为新平台监管规则辩护
summary_cn: 泰国贸易竞争委员会（TCCT）重申对网约车、外卖及电子商务平台收费结构拥有监管权限，坚定推进新监管指南的落地实施。尽管部分主要外卖运营商有意提起法律诉讼进行抵抗，但委员会表示态度坚定，将继续按计划推进新的平台监管规定，不会因法律威胁而动摇。
desc_original: The Trade Competition Commission of Thailand (TCCT) has reaffirmed its legal authority to regulate fee structures imposed by ride-hailing, food delivery and e-commerce platforms, vowing to press ahead with its planned new guidelines despite reports that two major food delivery operators are considering legal action against them.

title: BoT urges banks to step up cybersecurity
desc: Commercial banks are being urged to strengthen their cybersecurity measures amid a global rise in cyberthreats involving artificial intelligence (AI) over the past 1-2 weeks.
title_cn: 泰国央行促商业银行加强网络安全
summary_cn: 泰国央行（BoT）敦促商业银行强化网络安全防护措施，以应对全球范围内利用人工智能（AI）实施的网络威胁激增现象。相关AI驱动的网络攻击在过去两周内频繁出现，已成为全球关注焦点。银行系统需加强防御，保护客户资产和信息安全。
desc_original: Commercial banks are being urged to strengthen their cybersecurity measures amid a global rise in cyberthreats involving artificial intelligence (AI) over the past 1-2 weeks.

title: Mpox cases under control, infections 'only sporadic'
desc: The Department of Disease Control (DDC) says mpox remains under control in Thailand, with infections occurring sporadically and no evidence of widespread community transmission to date, despite a rise in cases since mid-2026.
title_cn: 泰国猴痘疫情受控，感染「仅零星出现」
summary_cn: 泰国疾病控制部门（DDC）宣布，猴痘（mpox）疫情在泰国整体可控，目前仅现零星散发病例，暂无广泛社区传播迹象。虽然自2026年中旬以来累计病例数有所增加，但控制措施得当，防控形势稳定。部门表示将继续密切监测疫情动向。
desc_original: The Department of Disease Control (DDC) says mpox remains under control in Thailand, with infections occurring sporadically and no evidence of widespread community transmission to date, despite a rise in cases since mid-2026.

title: Flood-hit residents to sue BMA
desc: The Democrat Party is preparing an Administrative Court lawsuit with residents of Khlong Chan Flats in Bang Kapi district against the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) over its handling of recent flooding and alleged delays in compensation payments.
title_cn: 洪灾受害居民将起诉曼谷市政府
summary_cn: 民主党联合曼谷邦卡皮区空鹰住宅（Khlong Chan Flats）的洪灾受害居民，正准备向行政法院提起诉讼，控告曼谷市政府（BMA）在处置近期洪灾时的不力及赔偿支付的拖延现象。此案涉及政府防灾责任与居民权益保护等重大问题。
desc_original: The Democrat Party is preparing an Administrative Court lawsuit with residents of Khlong Chan Flats in Bang Kapi district against the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) over its handling of recent flooding and alleged delays in compensation payments.

title: Pricey lemon trees at expo spark debate
desc: Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Suriya Jungrungreangkit on Monday denied reports that lemon trees bought for the Udon Thani International Horticultural Expo cost 12,000 baht each, saying the most expensive ones cost no more than 5,000 baht.
title_cn: 乌汶国际园艺博览会柠檬树价格引发争议
summary_cn: 泰国农业与合作部长素利亚·容隆格盖基特（Suriya Jungrungreangkit）驳斥关于乌汶国际园艺博览会（Udon Thani International Horticultural Expo）采购柠檬树价格过高的说法，声称最昂贵品种的价格不超过5000泰铢，而非网传的每株1.2万泰铢。部长意在澄清事实、平息争议。
desc_original: Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Suriya Jungrungreangkit on Monday denied reports that lemon trees bought for the Udon Thani International Horticultural Expo cost 12,000 baht each, saying the most expensive ones cost no more than 5,000 baht.

title: Airports of Thailand moves to clear late cargoes
desc: Airports of Thailand (AoT) has set aside warehouse space for oversized shipments at Suvarnabhumi airport as part of a joint effort with Thai Airways to clear a backlog of imported cargo.
title_cn: 泰国机场公司加速清理积压进口货物
summary_cn: 泰国机场组织公司(AoT)在素万那普机场(Suvarnabhumi)划拨仓库空间专门用于超尺寸货物，与泰国航空公司(Thai Airways)联合行动，加快处理长期积压的进口货物。此举旨在缓解航空货运堆积问题。
desc_original: Airports of Thailand (AoT) has set aside warehouse space for oversized shipments at Suvarnabhumi airport as part of a joint effort with Thai Airways to clear a backlog of imported cargo.

title: Expert sounds pollution alarm
desc: An academic has urged Thailand and its neighbours to act urgently against toxic pollution in northern rivers, warning that switching water sources will not protect communities from contamination linked to mining activities across the border.
title_cn: 专家警示北方河流有毒污染危机
summary_cn: 学者呼吁泰国及邻国采取紧急行动，治理北方河流日益严重的有毒污染问题。其警告称，仅改变水源供应无法保护社区免受与跨境采矿活动相关的污染威胁。该污染跨越国界，需要区域合作应对。
desc_original: An academic has urged Thailand and its neighbours to act urgently against toxic pollution in northern rivers, warning that switching water sources will not protect communities from contamination linked to mining activities across the border.

title: MP's husband named in online gambling complaint
desc: Lawyer Noraseth Nanongtoom has filed a complaint with the Cyber Crime Investigation Bureau against Zhang Taiyang, husband of Bhumjaithai MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap, over his alleged shareholding in Shuffle, an online gambling platform.
title_cn: 议员丈夫因赌博平台股份遭投诉
summary_cn: 律师诺罗赛特向网络犯罪调查局投诉，指控泰国发展党议员素查达·张的丈夫张太阳在在线赌博平台Shuffle中持股。该案涉及政界高层与网络赌博产业的关系，已引发社会关注和相关部门的调查。
desc_original: Lawyer Noraseth Nanongtoom has filed a complaint with the Cyber Crime Investigation Bureau against Zhang Taiyang, husband of Bhumjaithai MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap, over his alleged shareholding in Shuffle, an online gambling platform.

title: Unesco to consider 'Chud Thai'
desc: Thailand's nomination of 'Chud Thai', the traditional national costume, for Unesco's intangible cultural heritage list will be considered in China later this month, as the Culture Ministry calls on the public to celebrate the attire.
title_cn: 泰国民族服饰「筑泰」参评联合国非遗
summary_cn: 泰国提交的传统民族服饰「筑泰」(Chud Thai)将于本月晚些时间在中国参加联合国教科文组织非物质文化遗产的评审。泰国文化部呼吁全国公众庆祝和传承这一富有文化意义的传统服饰，旨在增进国际对泰国文化的认识。
desc_original: Thailand's nomination of 'Chud Thai', the traditional national costume, for Unesco's intangible cultural heritage list will be considered in China later this month, as the Culture Ministry calls on the public to celebrate the attire.

title: Anutin pledges stronger ties in Israeli envoy talks
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has pledged to strengthen cooperation with Israel in labour, technology and innovation, while stressing that all foreign tourists must comply with Thai laws.
title_cn: 总理阿努廷承诺深化泰以合作关系
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷·占维拉库尔在与以色列特使会谈中承诺加强两国在劳动力、技术和创新领域的合作，并强调将进一步深化双边关系。同时，他重申所有外国游客必须严格遵守泰国相关法律。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has pledged to strengthen cooperation with Israel in labour, technology and innovation, while stressing that all foreign tourists must comply with Thai laws.

title: Protesters to keep rallying 'for 30 days'
desc: Protesters demanding a 10-baht-per-litre cut in diesel prices and measures to ease the cost of living plan to remain outside Government House for an initial 30 days, their leader said on Monday.
title_cn: 示威者计划在政府大楼外集会「30天」
summary_cn: 示威者要求将柴油价格下调至每升便宜10泰铢，并采取措施缓解生活成本压力，计划在政府大楼外持续集会30天。此举反映了泰国民众对高油价和生活开支的关切，可能对泰国能源政策和社会稳定产生影响。
desc_original: Protesters demanding a 10-baht-per-litre cut in diesel prices and measures to ease the cost of living plan to remain outside Government House for an initial 30 days, their leader said on Monday.

title: WHAUP plans to expand renewables business
desc: WHA Utilities and Power Plc (WHAUP), the utility and power arm of industrial developer WHA Corp, plans to expand its renewable energy business in line with the new Power Development Plan (PDP), which is expected to accelerate the country's transition to clean energy.
title_cn: WHAUP公司计划扩展可再生能源业务
summary_cn: WHA电力公用事业公司（WHAUP）计划扩展可再生能源业务，积极响应泰国新发布的电力发展规划（PDP），加速国家能源结构向清洁能源转型。该举措符合全球能源转型大势，也是泰国推进绿色发展和实现可持续目标的重要步骤。
desc_original: WHA Utilities and Power Plc (WHAUP), the utility and power arm of industrial developer WHA Corp, plans to expand its renewable energy business in line with the new Power Development Plan (PDP), which is expected to accelerate the country's transition to clean energy.

title: Govt outlines major transport upgrades for South
desc: The Transport Ministry has outlined 14 major infrastructure projects worth about 362.6 billion baht in the South, including the 106.8-billion-baht second phase of the southern double-track railway.
title_cn: 政府公布泰国南部14项重大运输升级项目
summary_cn: 泰国运输部公布了南部地区14个重大基础设施项目，总投资约362.6亿泰铢，包括耗资106.8亿泰铢的南部双轨铁路第二期工程。这批项目将显著改善南部地区的运输网络，促进地区经济发展和均衡。
desc_original: The Transport Ministry has outlined 14 major infrastructure projects worth about 362.6 billion baht in the South, including the 106.8-billion-baht second phase of the southern double-track railway.

title: IdeasLabs expands into creator market
desc: IdeasLabs has transformed its position from an influencer marketing agency into what it describes as the country's first key opinion leader (KOL) economy platform provider, aiming to capitalise on the booming influencer market, particularly in the nano and micro-creator segments.
title_cn: IdeasLabs转型为泰国首个KOL经济平台提供商
summary_cn: IdeasLabs从网红营销代理成功转型为泰国首个关键意见领袖（KOL）经济平台提供商，重点开拓纳米和微观创作者市场。此举体现了泰国网红和内容创作产业的快速发展，以及数字商业平台创新的新方向。
desc_original: IdeasLabs has transformed its position from an influencer marketing agency into what it describes as the country's first key opinion leader (KOL) economy platform provider, aiming to capitalise on the booming influencer market, particularly in the nano and micro-creator segments.

desc: Ukrainian, Russian women among nine injured in Pattaya boat crash Legacy A speedboat carrying 27 passengers collided with a fishing boat near Bali Hai Pier in Pattaya late yesterday, November 9, leaving nine people injured before the speedboat began sinking. Pattaya Marine Rescue received a report of the collision at around 11pm. Rescue teams coordinated with Pattaya City Police Station and the Sawang Boriboon Thammasathan Foundation to assist those involved. At the scene, rescuers found a two-storey fishing boat with damage to its bow. Approximately 100 metres away, the speedboat had extensive damage along its left side and was gradually sinking. Rescue workers and local boat operators helped evacuate nine injured passengers, including six Thai women, one Ukrainian woman and two Russian women. Photo via Pattaya Tourist Police Most suffered abrasions and received first aid before being taken to nearby hospitals for treatment. title: NSC Sec-Gen: Thailand faces daily cyber threats
desc: Thailand faces daily cyberattack attempts targeting government agencies, banks and critical infrastructure, with attackers increasingly using artificial intelligence (AI) to identify vulnerabilities, National Security Council (NSC) Secretary-General Gen Chaipruak Doungprapat said on Monday.
title_cn: 国家安全委员会秘书长警示：泰国面临日常网络威胁
summary_cn: 泰国国家安全委员会秘书长差普鲁克·东普拉帕将军指出，政府机构、银行及关键基础设施每日遭受网络攻击威胁，攻击者越来越多地利用人工智能识别系统漏洞。泰国网络安全形势日益严峻。
desc_original: Thailand faces daily cyberattack attempts targeting government agencies, banks and critical infrastructure, with attackers increasingly using artificial intelligence (AI) to identify vulnerabilities, National Security Council (NSC) Secretary-General Gen Chaipruak Doungprapat said on Monday.

title: Panadda's father, foundation execs now suspects in charity fraud case
desc: The Economic Crime Suppression Division is expanding the charity fraud case against former Miss Thailand Panadda “Boom” Wongphudee to include her father, the treasurer and directors of her foundation, and contractors.
title_cn: 前泰国小姐帕纳达父亲等成为慈善欺诈案嫌疑人
summary_cn: 经济犯罪监督部门扩大对前泰国小姐帕纳达「Boom」翁扑迪慈善欺诈案的调查，将其父亲、基金会财务主管及董事、承包商等列为新增嫌疑人。案件涉及基金会资金管理不当。
desc_original: The Economic Crime Suppression Division is expanding the charity fraud case against former Miss Thailand Panadda “Boom” Wongphudee to include her father, the treasurer and directors of her foundation, and contractors.

title: Govt looks to Sri Lankans to plug labour shortage
desc: The government is acting to alleviate the labour shortage by extending the work permits of current Lao and Myanmar employees and will bring in additional workers from Sri Lanka.
title_cn: 政府引入斯里兰卡劳工缓解用人荒
summary_cn: 泰国政府采取多管齐下的措施应对劳动力短缺。除延长老挝和缅甸现有员工的工作许可外，还计划从斯里兰卡引入新的劳动力。此举旨在为制造业、建筑业和服务业补充所需的人力资源。
desc_original: The government is acting to alleviate the labour shortage by extending the work permits of current Lao and Myanmar employees and will bring in additional workers from Sri Lanka.

title: PM Anutin leads talks on cyber threats and national security
desc: PM Anutin leads talks on cyber threats and national security Legacy Thailand’s Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul chaired a meeting with the National Security Council (NSC) today, November 9, to discuss measures against potential cyber threats and the country’s national security strategy . The meeting was expected to cover possible security scenarios arising from tensions in the Middle East, as well as strategies to address cyber threats. The Royal Thai Army also attended to provide an update on the security situation along the Thai-Myanmar border. According to ThaiRath, discussions were also expected to include a three-year strategic security plan and concerns over the use of drones as a potential threat to national security. Photo by Fredrik Sandberg /TT News Agency via AP The meeting followed Anutin’s statement on November 3 about the potential impact of cyberattacks on Thailand. He made the remarks after reports that supermarkets in at least nine European countries had been affected by cyberattacks targeting refrigerator and freezer temperature-control systems, causing temperature fluctuations that damaged food products. title: Thailand urges no panic buying as 72-hour emergency bag sales rise
desc: Thailand urges no panic buying as 72-hour emergency bag sales rise Legacy Thailand’s government today, November 9, asked people across the country to s top panic buying and stockpiling essential goods , saying retailers and manufacturers have reported no shortages after advice on 72-hour emergency bags lifted sales. It has instructed both the Department of Internal Trade and the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation (DDPM) to continue monitoring supplies and demand throughout the country. Deputy Government Spokesperson Ploythalay Laksameesaengjan said sales of consumer goods had risen, but not only because of panic buying. She listed emergency purchases in flood-hit areas , extra spending after payday at the start of the month, and shopping through the State Welfare Card scheme and the Thai Help Thai Plus (60:40) co-payment programme, which she said had lifted sales at local retailers by about 5%. Ploythalay said every business operator had confirmed its stock levels to the government and that inspectors had also checked storage sites and refrigerated systems after reports of risks in other countries, finding nothing out of order in Thailand. title: 泰国推出两款王室纪念钞！12月21日起可兑换
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月9日，据泰国中央银行（泰国央行）行长威泰透露，央行已获王室批准，印制两款面额为100泰铢的纪念钞，以表达对诗丽吉王太后的崇高敬意，并铭记帕查拉吉蒂雅帕公主殿下为泰国人民和国家作出的贡献。此次发行的两款纪念钞每款印制1000万张，共计2000万张，按面值计算总金额达20亿泰铢。民众可自2026年12月21日起，按每张100泰铢的面值价格兑换，无须支付额外费用。 为方便民众兑换，泰国央行将通过全国各大商业银行，以及政府储蓄银行、农业与农业合作银行、政府住房银行和泰国伊斯兰银行的所有分行提供兑换服务。 两款纪念钞正面均沿用目前流通的第17版100泰铢聚合物钞票设计，背面采用特别设计，印有两位王室成员为泰国人民福祉及国家发展所开展的王室活动和相关纪念图像。纪念钞还增加紫外线照射荧光效果，采用不同于普通流通钞票的特殊色调与图案，以凸显其独特性。 除纪念钞外，泰国央行还将配套制作两款纪念钞说明册，每款印制200万套，共计400万套，每套售价10泰铢。说明册销售所得将全部呈献给泰国国王玛哈·哇集拉隆功陛下，作为捐献，用于支持王室慈善事业。 泰国央行表示，此次发行纪念钞不仅是为了表达对两位王室成员的敬意与缅怀，也希望让民众有机会收藏具有特殊纪念意义的钞票。纪念钞将按照票面价值兑换，民众无需额外支付收藏溢价。 （编译：Wan；来源：Mgronline） The post 泰国推出两款王室纪念钞！12月21日起可兑换 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Anutin tells Israeli ambassador Thailand will enforce its laws on all foreigners
desc: Anutin tells Israeli ambassador Thailand will enforce its laws on all foreigners Legacy Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul told Israel’s ambassador at Government House in Bangkok today, November 9, that Thailand welcomes tourists of every nationality but will apply its laws to any foreigner who breaks them , with no exceptions . The ambassador, Alona Fisher-Kamm, said Israel was ready to work with Thai agencies to help its nationals understand Thai laws, regulations and culture. Anutin said Thailand remained a popular destination for Israelis and that his government would not treat anyone differently because of their race, religion or nationality, while keeping foreign visitors safe. He added that every tourist was expected to respect Thai rules and customs, and that equal enforcement was what allowed visitors and local communities to live together peacefully and understand one another. Fisher-Kamm said closer work with Thai agencies on informing Israeli travellers would help prevent misunderstandings and bring the people of both countries closer together. Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul meets Israeli Ambassador Alona Fisher-Kamm, Nov. 9, 2026 | Photo via Government House
title_cn: 总理重申泰国对所有外国人一律执法，与以大使强化合作
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷11月9日与以色列大使阿洛娜·费舍尔-卡姆在政府大厦会晤。总理表示泰国欢迎各国游客但对违法者一律依法严肃处置，不因种族、宗教或国籍而区别对待。双方同意深化合作，由以色列政府协助国民了解泰国法律、规章制度及文化，以促进理解与和谐。

title: 一场现场失控，一场直接停演！BIGBANG曼谷演唱会两晚连出状况
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月7日至8日，韩国组合BIGBANG出道20周年世界巡回演唱会《XX : COSMOS》曼谷站在拉加曼加拉国家体育场连续举行两晚。此次巡演由AEG Presents Asia主办，iMe Thailand负责当地执行。然而，两晚演出接连出现不同状况：首场内场观众发生推挤、越过隔离围栏等秩序问题，次场则因强风、暴雨及雷电天气中途叫停。 11月9日，iMe Thailand宣布对8日场次实施全额退款，门票发行手续费及支付渠道手续费也由主办方承担。退款解决了票款问题，但更值得关注的是：这两起状况，有多少本可以通过事前规划和风险管理加以防范？ 首场：内场秩序为何出现混乱？ 社交平台流传的视频显示，11月7日首场演出期间，部分内场观众搬动塑料座椅并向舞台方向前移，周边观众随之跟进，人流逐渐向前涌动。靠近舞台围栏的位置一度出现推挤，甚至有人翻越围栏，安保人员多次上前劝阻，但未能及时有效控制现场局面。 从视频来看，内场座椅似为单张摆放，未见明显的固定或连排处理。如果现场情况确如视频所呈现，座椅设置及区域管理就值得进一步检视。 一些国际演出安全规范明确要求，临时座椅应妥善固定，或按照规定连排设置，避免观众随意移动座椅，同时防止座椅在紧急疏散时阻碍通道。此次曼谷站的座椅设置是否符合相关安全要求，仍有待主办方及场馆管理方说明。 座椅一旦能够被随意搬动，原有票区界线便可能失去实际约束力。当部分观众向舞台方向移动，周围人群跟随前移时，原本明确划分的观众区域就可能逐渐失去秩序。而围栏前的人群挤压，更可能进一步增加跌倒、踩踏及人员受伤的风险。 因此，关键不只是现场安排了多少安保人员，更在于主办方是否建立了明确的分级处置机制：当观众开始离座前移时，由谁负责介入？多长时间内必须作出反应？当人群出现持续推挤时，是否需要暂停演出，通过场馆大屏幕和广播重新稳定秩序？ 截至发稿，AEG Presents Asia与iMe Thailand均未就首场演出的现场秩序问题作出公开说明，也未见警方发布相关通报。公众有理由期待主办方进一步说明现场管理情况，并公布后续改进措施。 次场：天气风险并非完全无法预判 11月8日晚，曼谷突遭强风、暴雨及雷电天气。演出进行至第6首歌曲时，于20时05分被迫中止。场馆随后通过大屏幕以泰语、中文及英语发布通知，提醒观众保持冷静并有序离场。BIGBANG三名成员G-DRAGON（权志龙）、TAEYANG（太阳）及DAESUNG（大声）随后冒雨返回舞台，向现场观众鞠躬致歉。 对于露天场馆而言，遭遇雷暴天气后叫停演出，是必要的安全措施。强降雨可能导致舞台设备进水，电力系统、音响设备及金属结构在恶劣天气下也可能带来额外风险，而雷电更直接威胁场内数万名观众及工作人员的安全。演出能否继续，不应仅以雨势是否暂时减弱作为判断依据。 但及时叫停演出，并不意味着此前的风险
title_cn: BIGBANG曼谷演唱会两晚接连出问题，首场秩序混乱次场暴雨停演
summary_cn: 韩国组合BIGBANG出道20周年演唱会曼谷站于11月7日至8日在拉加曼加拉体育场举办。首场出现观众搬动座椅、推挤及越过围栏的秩序混乱，安保应对不及时。次场因强风、暴雨及雷电天气在第六首歌曲后中止，乐队成员致歉。主办方宣布8日演出实施全额退款，包括手续费由主办方承担。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月7日至8日，韩国组合BIGBANG出道20周年世界巡回演唱会《XX : COSMOS》曼谷站在拉加曼加拉国家体育场连续举行两晚。此次巡演由AEG Presents Asia主办，iMe Thailand负责当地执行。然而，两晚演出接连出现不同状况：首场内场观众发生推挤、越过隔离围栏等秩序问题，次场则因强风、暴雨及雷电天气中途叫停。 11月9日，iMe Thailand宣布对8日场次实施全额退款，门票发行手续费及支付渠道手续费也由主办方承担。退款解决了票款问题，但更值得关注的是：这两起状况，有多少本可以通过事前规划和风险管理加以防范？ 首场：内场秩序为何出现混乱？ 社交平台流传的视频显示，11月7日首场演出期间，部分内场观众搬动塑料座椅并向舞台方向前移，周边观众随之跟进，人流逐渐向前涌动。靠近舞台围栏的位置一度出现推挤，甚至有人翻越围栏，安保人员多次上前劝阻，但未能及时有效控制现场局面。 从视频来看，内场座椅似为单张摆放，未见明显的固定或连排处理。如果现场情况确如视频所呈现，座椅设置及区域管理就值得进一步检视。 一些国际演出安全规范明确要求，临时座椅应妥善固定，或按照规定连排设置，避免观众随意移动座椅，同时防止座椅在紧急疏散时阻碍通道。此次曼谷站的座椅设置是否符合相关安全要求，仍有待主办方及场馆管理方说明。 座椅一旦能够被随意搬动，原有票区界线便可能失去实际约束力。当部分观众向舞台方向移动，周围人群跟随前移时，原本明确划分的观众区域就可能逐渐失去秩序。而围栏前的人群挤压，更可能进一步增加跌倒、踩踏及人员受伤的风险。 因此，关键不只是现场安排了多少安保人员，更在于主办方是否建立了明确的分级处置机制：当观众开始离座前移时，由谁负责介入？多长时间内必须作出反应？当人群出现持续推挤时，是否需要暂停演出，通过场馆大屏幕和广播重新稳定秩序？ 截至发稿，AEG Presents Asia与iMe Thailand均未就首场演出的现场秩序问题作出公开说明，也未见警方发布相关通报。公众有理由期待主办方进一步说明现场管理情况，并公布后续改进措施。 次场：天气风险并非完全无法预判 11月8日晚，曼谷突遭强风、暴雨及雷电天气。演出进行至第6首歌曲时，于20时05分被迫中止。场馆随后通过大屏幕以泰语、中文及英语发布通知，提醒观众保持冷静并有序离场。BIGBANG三名成员G-DRAGON（权志龙）、TAEYANG（太阳）及DAESUNG（大声）随后冒雨返回舞台，向现场观众鞠躬致歉。 对于露天场馆而言，遭遇雷暴天气后叫停演出，是必要的安全措施。强降雨可能导致舞台设备进水，电力系统、音响设备及金属结构在恶劣天气下也可能带来额外风险，而雷电更直接威胁场内数万名观众及工作人员的安全。演出能否继续，不应仅以雨势是否暂时减弱作为判断依据。 但及时叫停演出，并不意味着此前的风险

title: Rotten bread at Bangkok condo leads police to 2 million baht cocaine operation
desc: Rotten bread at Bangkok condo leads police to 2 million baht cocaine operation Legacy The discovery of loads of rotten bread at a condominium in the Hua Mak area of Bangkok led to the discovery of a drug trafficking operation, the arrest of three suspects , and the seizure of drugs worth over 2 million baht. The investigation began after officers from the Narcotics Suppression Bureau (NSB) received information about suspicious activity at a condominium in the Hua Mak area. According to investigators, a group of suspicious residents repeatedly ordered large quantities of bread but left the food outside their accommodation until it rotted and became covered with ants. The unusual activity raised suspicions that the orders were being used to conceal an illegal operation. Officers began monitoring the condominium and noticed several people entering and leaving one room in what appeared to be shifts. Investigators also observed bread being handed to delivery riders more than 20 times a day. Photo via Facebook/ จ๋อแจ๊ะจับโจร Police subsequently followed one of the riders to a delivery destination and stopped him for inspection. Officers discovered that the bread contained hidden drugs. I

title: Elderly woman in Surat Thani dies after repeated abuse by caregiver
desc: Elderly woman in Surat Thani dies after repeated abuse by caregiver Legacy A 99 year old bedridden woman in Surat Thani died in the hospital on November 8 after her family discovered CCTV footage showing her caregiver physically abusing her at home. The woman’s grandson, Peerayut, filed a complaint against the 42 year old caregiver, Wassana, at Mueang Surat Thani Police Station. He revealed that he noticed bruises on her face and body, so he reviewed security camera recordings from his grandmother’s bedroom and found the abuse. Speaking to Channel 7, Peerayut said his family was shocked and distressed by the footage. He added that they had trusted Wassana because she previously worked at a care centre and appeared to provide good care. According to Peerayut, Wassana later resigned from the care centre and asked the family to employ her privately to look after his grandmother at their home. The family agreed because they believed she had consistently cared for the elderly woman well. title: BIGBANG曼谷演唱会唱到第6首突遭暴雨叫停！主办方宣布全额退款
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月8日晚，韩国人气组合BIGBANG出道20周年世界巡回演唱会《XX : COSMOS》曼谷站第二场，在演出进行至第6首歌曲时，因现场突发强降雨、强风及雷电天气，被迫于20时05分紧急中止。随后，三名成员冒雨返回舞台向观众鞠躬致歉。11月9日，主办方iMe Thailand正式公布退款安排，宣布所有购买当晚场次门票的观众均可获得全额退款，相关门票发行手续费及支付渠道手续费也将由主办方承担。 此次演唱会原定于11月7日、8日在曼谷拉加曼加拉国家体育场连续举行两场，属于BIGBANG 2026—2027世界巡回演唱会《XX : COSMOS》的曼谷站。据主办方此前公布的信息，两场演出门票均已售罄。 11月7日首场演出期间，现场同样遭遇强降雨，但成员们仍坚持完成演出。期间，太阳曾在舞台上滑倒，权志龙和大声也一度不慎绊倒，但三人随后继续表演，相关现场视频在社交平台引发粉丝关注。 然而，11月8日第二场演出未能延续首场的顺利。当晚演出原定于19时开始，开场时天气尚可，现场甚至没有下雨。权志龙在演出中也提到，原本还因为开场前没有下雨而感到庆幸。 但这份平静并未持续太久。演出进行至第6首歌曲时，曼谷突遭强风、暴雨及雷电侵袭，拉加曼加拉国家体育场现场天气迅速恶化。现场视频显示，雨水不断灌入舞台区域，看台观众纷纷撑起雨伞、穿上雨衣，仍有不少粉丝举着手机记录演出。 据泰媒Sanook、MGR Online等报道，恶劣天气还对舞台设备及现场演出造成影响。有现场工作人员在社交平台透露，舞台部分设施受损，设备进水，麦克风出现故障，现场一度发生断电情况，电力安全也成为需要考虑的问题。 当晚20时05分，主办方正式宣布中止演出，并通过场馆大屏幕以泰语、中文及英语发布通知，说明由于恶劣天气影响，为保障现场所有人员安全，演出无法继续进行，同时提醒观众保持冷静，听从工作人员指引，有序离场。 对于部分观众提出的雨势减弱后能否恢复演出的疑问，泰媒引述现场工作人员说法称，露天演出需要遵循防雷安全标准，一旦监测到规定范围内出现雷击，即须暂停或取消演出。即使降雨暂时减弱，也不代表雷电风险已经解除，尤其是在数万名观众聚集的露天场馆，人员安全仍是首要考虑。 演出宣布中止后，BIGBANG三名成员G-DRAGON（权志龙）、TAEYANG（太阳）及DAESUNG（大声）并未立即离场，而是冒雨再次走到舞台前方向观众鞠躬致歉。 权志龙表示，对于演出不得不中止感到非常抱歉，理解粉丝等待这场演出已经很久，自己同样感到遗憾和难过，但考虑到安全问题及相关规定，只能作出这样的决定，并希望未来能够再次与泰国粉丝见面。 太阳也表示，原本非常期待与泰国粉丝见面，开演前天气明明还不错，却突然出现暴雨、强风和雷电。虽然大家都希望能够完成演出，但观众及所有工作人员的安全更加重要。 大声则对未能完成整场演出表示遗憾
title_cn: BIGBANG曼谷演唱会遭暴雨强风中止 主办方宣布全额退款
summary_cn: BIGBANG 20周年「XX：COSMOS」世界巡回演唱会曼谷站第二场于11月8日晚在拉加曼加拉国家体育场（Rajamangala Stadium）进行至第6首歌曲时，因突发强暴雨、强风及闪电天气被迫紧急中止。三名成员随后冒雨致歉。主办方iMe Thailand宣布所有观众享受全额退款，包括票务及支付渠道手续费。

title: 两名中国籍诈骗嫌疑人在泰落网
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月9日，泰国曼谷京畿警察署联合移民局持续对10月23日发生的一起跨国电信诈骗案件展开追踪，在确定一名47岁的中国籍男子为涉案人员后，向刑事法院申请了逮捕令，并于近日指派调查人员前往该嫌疑人的住所，以“共同冒充他人诈骗公众，或作为他人、冒充他人共同诈骗公众”的罪名对其实施抓捕。 据悉，在“10月23日跨国电信诈骗案”中，一名高龄受害者接到了电诈团伙的电话，对方冒充警察，恐吓受害者称，她卷入了某洗钱案件，必须交出财产接受核查。受害者信以为真，将总重约5铢（1铢=15.244克）的金饰带到TaoPoon地区某商场，交给了电诈团伙的“收货跑腿员”。随后，该电诈团伙将金饰转交给18岁的“欧某”（音译，此前曾因涉电诈案件被Ratburana警察局起诉），欧某将金饰变现后，遵照“中国籍头目”的指示，将装有现金的袋子放在曼谷辉煌区Soi Pracharat Bamphen 13巷某公寓的一楼，再由一名中国籍男子将其取走，即本次行动中被抓的嫌疑人。 调查小组对其房间进行了搜查，现场查获多项关键涉案物品，包括： 1. 银行存折6本 2. 手机14部 3. 现金36,700铢 4. 信用卡/借记卡12张 在接受讯问时，该中国籍嫌疑人供认不讳，他表示，他负责接收各地“跑腿员”送来的电诈受害者资金，并将现金兑换为USDT稳定币等加密货币，再按照指令转给团伙头目。目前，调查人员已将其连同涉案证物一起移交给TaoPoon警察局依法起诉。 另外，调查人员在搜查房间时意外发现了一本属于一名40岁中国籍男子的护照，经初步核查，该护照内没有任何入境或出境泰国的盖章记录。被捕的47岁中国籍嫌疑人辩称，该护照是住在对面房间的朋友的。移民局调查人员随即核对入境数据库，确认没有该人的合法入境记录，推断其极可能为非法偷渡入境者。 就在此时，这本护照的持有人正好打开房门走过来，调查人员向他表明身份后进行检查。该男子承认，他确实是护照持有人，从中国云南省偷渡出境，坐汽车穿过邻国进入泰国，未经任何边检审查，已在泰国藏匿超过1年。调查人员指控他涉嫌“外籍人员非法偷渡入境泰国”，并将其移交给移民局依法起诉。在向中国官方核实信息后得知，这名40岁的中国籍男子为中国山东省逮捕令目标嫌疑人，其涉嫌利用“刷单返佣”诱骗受害者下订单，随后卷款潜逃至泰国，最终被泰国警方联合执法抓捕。 （编译：KA；来源：fm91bkk） The post 两名中国籍诈骗嫌疑人在泰落网 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 两名中国籍诈骗嫌疑人在泰国被捕 涉跨国电信诈骗与非法偷渡
summary_cn: 泰国警方破获跨国电信诈骗案。47岁中国籍男子负责接收诈骗所得现金并兑换加密货币USDT转账给头目，住处搜获银行存折、手机、现金36700铢等。同时发现40岁中国籍男子非法偷渡入泰逾1年，经中国官方确认其为山东省通缉犯，涉「刷单返佣」诈骗。两人均已被移交警方起诉。

title: 新智 通达 共享！2026“东盟伙伴”媒体合作周在广西开幕
desc: 11月7日，由中央广播电视总台和广西壮族自治区人民政府共同主办的2026“东盟伙伴”媒体合作周在广西南宁开幕。 中央广播电视总台党组成员、副台长齐竹泉，广西壮族自治区党委常委、宣传部部长陈奕君，缅甸宣传部联邦部长腾林，老挝人民革命党中央委员会委员、中央宣传部副部长万西·国穆，柬埔寨新闻部副国务秘书宋博·瓦纳利，泰国媒体发展基金会首席执行官塔纳功·习素塞出席开幕式并致辞。 本届活动以“新智、通达、共享”为主题，来自中国和东盟国家的近200位政府官员、驻华使节、媒体人士、专家学者等齐聚一堂，开展深层次对话交流，探讨合作共赢之道，为构建更为紧密的中国—东盟命运共同体、提升区域媒体在全球舆论场的话语权与影响力汇聚媒体力量。 △中央广播电视总台党组成员、副台长齐竹泉 中央广播电视总台党组成员、副台长齐竹泉在致辞中表示，今年是中国和东盟建立对话关系35周年，建立全面战略伙伴关系5周年，也是中国“十五五”开局之年。作为当今世界上体量规模最大、业务形态最多、覆盖传播范围最广的综合性国际媒体机构，总台将进一步发挥85种语言、CGTN融媒体平台、192个海外站点等国际传播优势，与东盟媒体在节目合作、人员交流、技术共享和活动共同策划等方面进一步加深合作，当好技术赋能的推动者、联合传播的通行者、资源共享的连接者，助力构建更为紧密的中国—东盟命运共同体。 △广西壮族自治区党委常委、宣传部部长陈奕君 广西壮族自治区党委常委、宣传部部长陈奕君在致辞中表示，广西与东盟山水相连、人文相亲，有着天然的情感联结和深厚的传播基础。今年恰逢中国—东盟建立对话关系35周年、建立全面战略伙伴关系5周年，广西愿与东盟各国一道，坚持在“新智”上携手共进、在“通达”上双向共生、在“共享”上生态共建，共同打造契合本土语境、恪守新闻伦理、尊重文化本真的智能传播工具，构建稳定可信、双向融通的区域传播链路，合力培育中国—东盟共有人文IP，持续探索数字赋能人文交流的更深层路径，织密更具韧性的跨域媒体协作网络，为构建更为紧密的中国—东盟命运共同体持续注入民心动力与传播活力。 △缅甸宣传部联邦部长腾林 缅甸宣传部联邦部长腾林在致辞中表示，随着数字技术、人工智能和社交媒体的不断发展与广泛应用，人们能够实时获取和分享信息，各国和各国人民之间的交流也变得比以往任何时候都更加快捷、便利。通过媒体，我们能够推动外交交往、增进区域团结、促进文化交流。缅甸一直积极与东盟成员国以及世界其他国家开展媒体合作，尤其是与中国媒体机构保持着密切合作，包括中央广播电视总台、国家广播电视总局、云南广播电视台等。中国和东盟成员国的媒体机构应进一步加强合作，分享经验和技术专长，共同加强区域媒体网络建设。 △老挝人民革命党中央委员会委员、中央宣传部副部长万西·国穆 老挝人民革命党中央委员会委员、中央宣传部副部长万西·国穆在致辞中表示，我们衷心感谢中国长期以
title_cn: 「新智、通达、共享」——2026「东盟伙伴」媒体合作周在广西开幕
summary_cn: 11月7日，由中央广播电视总台与广西壮族自治区政府共同主办的2026「东盟伙伴」媒体合作周在南宁开幕，以「新智、通达、共享」为主题。来自中国和东盟国家的近200位官员、驻华使节、媒体人士和专家齐聚一堂。今年恰逢中国-东盟建立对话关系35周年及全面战略伙伴关系5周年。总台将发挥85种语言、CGTN融媒体平台、192个海外站点等优势，在节目合作、人员交流、技术共享等方面深化与东盟媒体的合作，共同构建更为紧密的中国-东盟命运共同体。

title: 泰国拟敲定数据中心新监管标准，涵盖三大核心原则
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月8日，泰国副总理兼财政部部长艾尼提透露，财政部计划在11月10日的内阁会议中提出数据中心业务监管标准，为投资者提供明确指引，并支持国家技术基础设施的可持续增长。此前，由艾尼提担任主席的数据中心业务政策委员会已于10月27日原则性通过数据中心监管草案，其三大核心原则如下： 1. 规范投资与资源使用 授权数字经济与社会部建立数据中心仪表盘（TH-DC），汇总全国数据中心的位置、运营状态和资源使用情况，并制定最低运营标准，涵盖用电、用水、城市规划、安全和环保，适用于工业区内和区外项目。 2. 公平过渡，不追溯既往 对已经投资的项目制定过渡办法，不强制追溯新规适用，但要求经营者在1年内调整并遵守《行为准则》（Code of Practice，COP）；新投资项目则必须经过筛选和竞争，以证明其能为泰国带来实际利益，例如帮助泰国企业进入产业供应链，以及培养泰国劳动力掌握先进技术产业所需技能。 3. 设立数据中心一站式服务，便利投资者 由数字经济与社会部设立数据中心一站式服务中心（DC-OSS），作为整合信息和协调相关部门的枢纽，为投资者提供一站式便利，减少与政府部门重复对接。 监管草案的另一项重要内容是，按用电量把数据中心划分为7个等级，以此确定监管的严格程度，使标准与项目规模和资源使用风险相匹配。具体分级如下： 1级：用电量0–0.5兆瓦 2级：用电量超过0.5–5兆瓦 3级：用电量超过5–10兆瓦 4级：用电量超过10–20兆瓦 5级：用电量超过20–50兆瓦 6级：用电量超过50–200兆瓦 7级：用电量达200兆瓦及以上 这一分级将成为运营监管标准的重要机制，尤其是对电力和资源需求高的大型数据中心，必须采用比小型项目更严格的管理和安全措施。 艾尼提表示，COP将按业务规模设定不同的监管严格程度，避免小型经营者承担过重的负担，同时又能有效控制大型数据中心的影响。其中，1–4级的小型数据中心适用基础最低技术要求和轻量版COP；5级必须遵守COP 2.0版本；6–7级的大型数据中心则必须遵守最严格的COP 3.0版本，因为它们规模大、资源需求更高。这次按规模制定标准，目标是在促进投资与监管之间取得平衡，政府希望泰国能持续吸引海外数字基础设施投资，并让投资真正惠及泰国经济，包括供应链、就业以及劳动力技能的长期提升等。 （编译：KA；来源：thansettakij） The post 泰国拟敲定数据中心新监管标准，涵盖三大核心原则 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 泰国拟敲定数据中心新监管标准，涵盖三大核心原则
summary_cn: 泰国副总理兼财政部部长艾尼提宣布，计划11月10日内阁会议提出数据中心监管标准。三大核心原则：建立数据中心仪表盘(TH-DC)规范投资资源使用；对既有项目制定过渡办法不追溯，新投资项目需通过筛选竞争；设立一站式服务中心(DC-OSS)便利投资者。按用电量分为7个等级，1-4级适用基础要求，5级遵守COP 2.0，6-7级遵守最严格COP 3.0，目标在促进投资与有效监管间取得平衡。

title: 泰国跻身最受全球银发旅行者欢迎的5大目的地之一
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月8日，国际在线旅行服务平台Trip.com发布的2026年预订行为报告显示，全球55岁以上的旅行者总预订额（GMV）同比增长超过50%，反映出这一群体的消费能力和出行需求正在强劲扩张中。亚洲银发旅行者的出行需求是推动增长的关键力量，五大主要客源市场的数据尤为明显：中国香港的预订量同比增长14%，日本39%，中国台湾46%，韩国35%，新加坡35%；这与退休人群的时间灵活有关，他们没有固定工作地负担，可以稳定地安排全年的休闲、文化体验和健康旅游。 除了上述主要市场外，马来西亚的表现尤为突出，银发一代的航班预订量同比增长高达70%，在十大热门客源市场中增速最快，充分说明东南亚银发群体在财务上颇具实力，且希望在退休后积累海外体验。 从旅行目的地来看，全球银发旅行者航班预订量的前五名依次是： 1. 中国大陆，同比增长37%； 2. 日本，同比增长40%； 3. 泰国，同比增长12%； 4. 韩国，同比增长47%； 5. 越南，同比增长26%。 泰国稳居全球银发旅行者航班预订量前五名，体现出泰国作为休闲目的地的优势，如在服务、美食、文化和健康服务方面的完整配套等。而韩国预订量大幅增长47%，主要得益于其成功把大城市亮点、文化景点和公共交通便利性结合在一起，让银发旅行者能轻松往返购物区、餐厅和主要景点，不需面对太多麻烦。 按城市来看，曼谷位列银发旅行者最受欢迎的5座城市之一，预订量同比增长12%。全球五大热门旅游城市分别是：中国上海，增长29%；泰国曼谷，增长12%；中国深圳，增长22%；韩国首尔，增长34%；中国广州，增长44%。 其中，上海的外滩、豫园、南京路等景点与地铁2号线、10号线的便捷连接使得其备受银发旅行者的青睐，并登上了结合AI与专家评估的Trip.Best榜单；广州和深圳则是通往大湾区的门户：广州以粤菜见长，如点心、烧鹅、云吞面等；深圳则侧重海滨休闲、滨水步道和现代建筑。 从另一个重要指标“停留时间”分析，银发旅行者每次出行平均长达9.6天，在目的地停留更久，让他们能更深入、更放松地体验，而不必在有限时间内匆忙更换多个地点。 在出行方式和住宿选择上，银发旅行者把舒适和品质放在首位。超过五分之三的航班预订属于短途旅行；住宿则更看重高标准，全部酒店预订中有一半以上集中在四星和五星级酒店，五星级酒店的预订量更是同比增长高达38%，显示出他们愿意为舒适和安全多花钱。 与此同时，银发旅行也带有重要的社交属性，他们通过旅行建立和维护关系，与同龄朋友相聚，分享人生经历。这一属性也体现在团队游的预订数据上：由50岁以上旅行者预订的团队游中，同行者同样是50岁以上的比例高达85%，清楚表明银发群体更喜欢和兴趣、生活方式、活动节奏相近的同龄朋友一起出行。 （编译：KA；来源：thansettakij） The post 泰国跻身最受全球银发旅行者欢
title_cn: 泰国成为全球银发旅行者五大热门目的地之一
summary_cn: 根据Trip.com 2026年预订报告，全球55岁以上旅行者预订额同比增长超50%。亚洲主要客源市场中日本增长39%、中国台湾46%、韩国35%、马来西亚最快达70%。泰国成为全球银发旅行者航班预订量前三目的地，仅次中国大陆和日本，曼谷位列全球五大热门旅游城市之一。银发旅行者平均停留9.6天，超60%选择短途旅行，51%以上入住四星及以上酒店。团队游中85%同行者为50岁以上，显示银发群体倾向与同龄人同行。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月8日，国际在线旅行服务平台Trip.com发布的2026年预订行为报告显示，全球55岁以上的旅行者总预订额（GMV）同比增长超过50%，反映出这一群体的消费能力和出行需求正在强劲扩张中。亚洲银发旅行者的出行需求是推动增长的关键力量，五大主要客源市场的数据尤为明显：中国香港的预订量同比增长14%，日本39%，中国台湾46%，韩国35%，新加坡35%；这与退休人群的时间灵活有关，他们没有固定工作地负担，可以稳定地安排全年的休闲、文化体验和健康旅游。 除了上述主要市场外，马来西亚的表现尤为突出，银发一代的航班预订量同比增长高达70%，在十大热门客源市场中增速最快，充分说明东南亚银发群体在财务上颇具实力，且希望在退休后积累海外体验。 从旅行目的地来看，全球银发旅行者航班预订量的前五名依次是： 1. 中国大陆，同比增长37%； 2. 日本，同比增长40%； 3. 泰国，同比增长12%； 4. 韩国，同比增长47%； 5. 越南，同比增长26%。 泰国稳居全球银发旅行者航班预订量前五名，体现出泰国作为休闲目的地的优势，如在服务、美食、文化和健康服务方面的完整配套等。而韩国预订量大幅增长47%，主要得益于其成功把大城市亮点、文化景点和公共交通便利性结合在一起，让银发旅行者能轻松往返购物区、餐厅和主要景点，不需面对太多麻烦。 按城市来看，曼谷位列银发旅行者最受欢迎的5座城市之一，预订量同比增长12%。全球五大热门旅游城市分别是：中国上海，增长29%；泰国曼谷，增长12%；中国深圳，增长22%；韩国首尔，增长34%；中国广州，增长44%。 其中，上海的外滩、豫园、南京路等景点与地铁2号线、10号线的便捷连接使得其备受银发旅行者的青睐，并登上了结合AI与专家评估的Trip.Best榜单；广州和深圳则是通往大湾区的门户：广州以粤菜见长，如点心、烧鹅、云吞面等；深圳则侧重海滨休闲、滨水步道和现代建筑。 从另一个重要指标“停留时间”分析，银发旅行者每次出行平均长达9.6天，在目的地停留更久，让他们能更深入、更放松地体验，而不必在有限时间内匆忙更换多个地点。 在出行方式和住宿选择上，银发旅行者把舒适和品质放在首位。超过五分之三的航班预订属于短途旅行；住宿则更看重高标准，全部酒店预订中有一半以上集中在四星和五星级酒店，五星级酒店的预订量更是同比增长高达38%，显示出他们愿意为舒适和安全多花钱。 与此同时，银发旅行也带有重要的社交属性，他们通过旅行建立和维护关系，与同龄朋友相聚，分享人生经历。这一属性也体现在团队游的预订数据上：由50岁以上旅行者预订的团队游中，同行者同样是50岁以上的比例高达85%，清楚表明银发群体更喜欢和兴趣、生活方式、活动节奏相近的同龄朋友一起出行。 （编译：KA；来源：thansettakij） The post 泰国跻身最受全球银发旅行者欢

title: Phuket emerges as year-round draw
desc: Phuket's property market continues to expand despite a slowdown in Thailand's housing sector, supported by infrastructure investment, new commercial developments and a growing population relocating to the island.
title_cn: 普吉岛成为全年热门投资地
summary_cn: 普吉岛房产市场持续扩张，尽管泰国整体住房市场放缓，但得益于基础设施投资、新商业开发和不断增加的人口流入，房产市场保持增长动力。
desc_original: Phuket's property market continues to expand despite a slowdown in Thailand's housing sector, supported by infrastructure investment, new commercial developments and a growing population relocating to the island.

title: Ikea promotes small-store concept
desc: Ikea Thailand expects its small-store concept to help the brand expand into untapped areas, paving the way for further growth.
title_cn: 宜家推广小店概念
summary_cn: 宜家泰国分部希望通过小店概念进入未开发市场，为品牌进一步拓展铺路。
desc_original: Ikea Thailand expects its small-store concept to help the brand expand into untapped areas, paving the way for further growth.

title: Regulator spurns US telecom proposals
desc: The board of the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) has repeatedly rejected pressure from the US, funnelled through the Commerce Ministry, for Thailand to fully open the domestic telecom sector to 100% foreign ownership, as well as adopt US standards for the use of the upper 6 gigahertz spectrum band for WiFi.
title_cn: 泰国通信委员会拒绝美国电信提议
summary_cn: 泰国国家广播和电信委员会 (NBTC) 再次拒绝美国通过商务部施压的要求，包括允许泰国电信部门 100% 外资所有权，以及采用美国 6 吉赫兹频谱 WiFi 标准。
desc_original: The board of the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) has repeatedly rejected pressure from the US, funnelled through the Commerce Ministry, for Thailand to fully open the domestic telecom sector to 100% foreign ownership, as well as adopt US standards for the use of the upper 6 gigahertz spectrum band for WiFi.

title: K-Asset: Longer lives reshape retirement strategies for Thais
desc: Longer lifespans are complicating retirement planning amid market uncertainty, inflation and rising healthcare costs, prompting Kasikorn Asset Management (K-Asset) to recommend investors shift their focus from wealth accumulation to income generation in retirement.
title_cn: 人均寿命延长重塑泰国退休投资策略
summary_cn: 人均寿命延长加剧退休规划难度，加之市场不确定性、通胀和医疗成本上升，开泰资产管理公司 (K-Asset) 建议投资者将重点从财富积累转向退休收入生成。
desc_original: Longer lifespans are complicating retirement planning amid market uncertainty, inflation and rising healthcare costs, prompting Kasikorn Asset Management (K-Asset) to recommend investors shift their focus from wealth accumulation to income generation in retirement.

title: Chamber sounds alarm on food raw material issues
desc: To strengthen Thailand's position as the "Kitchen of the World", the government must address the raw material shortage, says the head of the Thai Chamber of Commerce.
title_cn: 商会敲警钟：食品原料供应短缺
summary_cn: 泰国工商总会主席指出，为维持泰国「世界厨房」的地位，政府必须解决食品原料短缺问题。原料短缺制约了泰国农业和食品产业的核心竞争力，亟需政府采取措施。
desc_original: To strengthen Thailand's position as the "Kitchen of the World", the government must address the raw material shortage, says the head of the Thai Chamber of Commerce.

title: Offering security in fraught times
desc: Global uncertainty from geopolitical tensions, rising energy costs and potential disruptions to critical infrastructure could create opportunities for Thailand's agriculture and food industries as countries seek to strengthen food security and build up emergency reserves.
title_cn: 危局中的安全机遇
summary_cn: 全球地缘政治紧张、能源成本上升及基础设施风险促使各国加强粮食安全防范。这为泰国农业和食品产业创造商机，各国正积极建立应急储备，泰国有望抢占市场份额。
desc_original: Global uncertainty from geopolitical tensions, rising energy costs and potential disruptions to critical infrastructure could create opportunities for Thailand's agriculture and food industries as countries seek to strengthen food security and build up emergency reserves.

title: Police brace for protest convoy in capital
desc: Police are preparing for a protest convoy of up to 1,000 vehicles heading to Bangkok to demand a 10-baht cut in fuel prices and measures to ease the cost of living.
title_cn: 曼谷警方备战大规模抗议车队
summary_cn: 警察部门为迎接最多1000辆车的抗议车队做准备。抗议者将前往曼谷要求政府下调燃料价格10泰铢，并采取措施缓解生活成本压力，引发公共安全和交通关注。
desc_original: Police are preparing for a protest convoy of up to 1,000 vehicles heading to Bangkok to demand a 10-baht cut in fuel prices and measures to ease the cost of living.

title: Energy cost crisis mounts
desc: Tax cuts on two selected fuels have failed to address the energy-cost crisis, as protests loom and pressure mounts on the government.
title_cn: 能源成本危机持续升温
summary_cn: 政府对两类燃料的税收减免政策未能有效缓解能源成本危机。随着大规模抗议活动迫在眉睫，政府面临越来越大的压力，寻求解决方案以稳定物价和民心。
desc_original: Tax cuts on two selected fuels have failed to address the energy-cost crisis, as protests loom and pressure mounts on the government.

title: TAT earmarks budget for year-end foreign markets
desc: As the conflict in the Middle East continues, the Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) is planning to allocate part of its emergency budget to stimulate foreign markets during the final two months of the year.
title_cn: 泰国旅游局年底海外促销预算启动
summary_cn: 中东冲突持续冲击全球旅游市场。泰国旅游局（TAT）计划从应急预算中划出资金，重点刺激年底两个月的国际客源市场，以弥补地缘风险对旅游业的影响。
desc_original: As the conflict in the Middle East continues, the Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) is planning to allocate part of its emergency budget to stimulate foreign markets during the final two months of the year.

title: Call for smart grid outlays to cut carbon
desc: Thailand must accelerate investment in smart grid infrastructure if it is to meet its carbon reduction targets while maintaining energy security at an affordable cost, according to an energy researcher.
title_cn: 泰国呼吁加大智能电网投资以减少碳排放
summary_cn: 泰国能源专家指出，为实现碳减排目标同时保障能源安全和价格可承受，泰国必须加速投资智能电网基础设施。这是推进国家能源转型和气候承诺的关键举措。
desc_original: Thailand must accelerate investment in smart grid infrastructure if it is to meet its carbon reduction targets while maintaining energy security at an affordable cost, according to an energy researcher.

title: True bolsters 5G network development
desc: True Corporation has stepped up the development of its nationwide 5G network, deploying artificial intelligence (AI)-powered network twin technology to improve network planning, optimise capacity and anticipate potential problems before they affect services.
title_cn: True 加快 5G 网络全国覆盖建设
summary_cn: True Corporation 加速推进全国 5G 网络部署，引入人工智能（AI）驱动的网络孪生技术，用于优化网络规划、提升容量管理，并提前预测和解决潜在故障，提升网络服务质量。
desc_original: True Corporation has stepped up the development of its nationwide 5G network, deploying artificial intelligence (AI)-powered network twin technology to improve network planning, optimise capacity and anticipate potential problems before they affect services.

title: “ครูเจี๊ยบ” ชี้พิรุธกระเป๋าหรู “บุ๋ม ปนัดดา” ใบละ 3-5 ล้าน แต่สภาพชวนสงสัย

title_cn: 政界人士率众进驻政府大楼抗议油价与腐败
summary_cn: 泰国政界人物「甘南·马埃」领导民众游行进驻曼谷政府大楼，呼吁政府调查油价成本、地方官员贪腐及职位买卖等问题，并威胁若政府不采取行动将升级游行规模，引发政治紧张局势。

title: Encroaching buildings demolished at Phuket's Freedom beach
desc: PHUKET - Authorities have made arrests and demolished structures encroaching on Freedom beach in Muang district, where foreigners were duped into buying illegally issued land title deeds at inflated prices.
title_cn: 普吉岛自由海滩违建被拆，曝光非法售地诈骗案
summary_cn: 普吉岛相关部门对自由海滩（Freedom Beach）的违法建筑进行拆除，并逮捕涉案人员。案件涉及诈骗外国人购买非法土地所有权证书、收取虚高价格等违法活动，对外国投资者权益造成威胁。
desc_original: PHUKET - Authorities have made arrests and demolished structures encroaching on Freedom beach in Muang district, where foreigners were duped into buying illegally issued land title deeds at inflated prices.

title: Black panther seen again in Kaeng Krachan park
desc: PETCHABURI - A black panther has again been spotted in Kaeng Krachan National Park, highlighting the rich biodiversity of Thailand's largest national park and one of its most elusive predators.
title_cn: 黑豹在乐宫国家公园再度现身
summary_cn: 泰国最大的国家公园乐宫国家公园（Kaeng Krachan National Park）位于碧差汶府（Petchaburi），近日再次出现黑豹身影。这种大型食肉动物因其极其隐秘而鲜少被目击。此发现凸显了该公园生物多样性的丰富程度，对于泰国野生动物保护工作具有重要意义。
desc_original: PETCHABURI - A black panther has again been spotted in Kaeng Krachan National Park, highlighting the rich biodiversity of Thailand's largest national park and one of its most elusive predators.

title: Alcohol ban on Buddhist holy days lifted for touristy venues
desc: Thailand has introduced new rules allowing alcohol sales at designated venues, including licensed nightspots,  on five major Buddhist holy days, while maintaining the general nationwide ban on alcohol sales on those dates.
title_cn: 泰国解除旅游场所佛教圣日酒精禁令
summary_cn: 泰国政府推出新政策，允许在五个主要佛教圣日的指定场所（包括获许可的酒吧和夜总会）销售酒精饮料，同时在全国范围内保持对酒精销售的传统禁令。这一调整反映了泰国在现代旅游业发展与传统佛教文化之间寻求平衡的努力，对游客和相关商业场所产生重要影响。
desc_original: Thailand has introduced new rules allowing alcohol sales at designated venues, including licensed nightspots,  on five major Buddhist holy days, while maintaining the general nationwide ban on alcohol sales on those dates.

title: Accused charity-fraud couple survive first night in remand prison
desc: Former beauty queen Panadda Wongphudee and husband Atip Anantawan had adjusted well during their first night behind bars after being charged with public fraud in the misuse of the huge donations fund run by her Goodness Foundation, according to the Corrections Department.
title_cn: 被控慈善欺诈的前泰国美皇后夫妇在狱中度过首夜
summary_cn: 前泰国美皇后帕娜达·翁普蒂（Panadda Wongphudee）和丈夫阿蒂普·阿南塔万（Atip Anantawan）因涉嫌挪用其创办的「善基金」（Goodness Foundation）巨额善款而被控公众欺诈罪。两人已被羁押在看守所接受审查，据泰国监狱部门报告，他们已基本适应狱中生活。该案引发社会对慈善机构监管的广泛关注。
desc_original: Former beauty queen Panadda Wongphudee and husband Atip Anantawan had adjusted well during their first night behind bars after being charged with public fraud in the misuse of the huge donations fund run by her Goodness Foundation, according to the Corrections Department.

summary_cn: 疫情后芭提雅房地产市场逐步复苏，开发商Lunic房地产公司与曼谷医院（Bangkok Hospital）合作推出总投资约48亿泰铢的大型项目，坐落于芭提雅（Pattaya）北部的暹海地区（Jomtien）。该项目瞄准全球养生旅游和退休居住市场，目标是将芭提雅打造成国际「第二家园」目的地，适应全球人口老龄化趋势。

title: Phuket landfill closes indefinitely amid waste crisis
desc: Phuket landfill closes indefinitely amid waste crisis Legacy Phuket City Municipality suspended rubbish deliveries to its landfill today, November 8, after mounting waste overwhelmed the site and several trucks dumped rubbish on an access road , blocking other vehicles. The suspension will remain in place indefinitely while officials prepare additional landfill space and coordinate with local councils and waste collection contractors. Phuket City Mayor Supachoke Laongphet signed the announcement today, describing the situation at the municipality’s waste disposal centre as its seventh waste management crisis . Photo via Phuket Municipality According to the municipality, the volume of rubbish arriving at the landfill has exceeded its capacity, forcing officials to arrange additional machinery to prepare new areas for waste disposal. The work has caused significant delays over the past week, with rubbish trucks having to wait longer than usual to enter the landfill. The situation worsened this morning when several rubbish truck drivers reportedly refused to wait and instead dumped their loads on the road leading into the disposal area. Photo via Phuket Municipality The discarde

title: South Korean tourists targeted in Chiang Mai supplement scam
desc: South Korean tourists targeted in Chiang Mai supplement scam Legacy Police raided two businesses in Chiang Mai today, November 8, following complaints from South Korean tourists who said they were taken by tour operators to buy unregistered health supplements costing up to 40,000 baht per box. The tourists reported that the products were advertised as treatments for various illnesses by a man posing as a traditional medicine expert. They discovered after returning to South Korea that the supplements lacked Thai Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval. The complaints prompted an investigation involving tourist police, the Department of Tourism and Chiang Mai provincial public health officials, who obtained search warrants from Chiang Mai Provincial Court for two locations. Photo via Facebook: Thaipolice The first raid targeted a company in Ton Pao subdistrict, San Kamphaeng district, where officers found four types of health supplements. Two were classified as regulated medicines or food products without the required FDA approval and were seized for examination. title: Southern Thailand rail expansion gets 106.8 billion baht backing
desc: Southern Thailand rail expansion gets 106.8 billion baht backing Legacy Thailand is pressing ahead with major transport projects across the South , including a 106.8 billion baht double-track railway expansion and two new bridges in Songkhla and Krabi. Deputy Transport Minister Sanphet Boonyamanee confirmed the plans yesterday, November 7, saying the government remains committed to improving southern Thailand’s roads, railways and transport links while addressing obstacles holding up development. The investments, overseen by Deputy Prime Minister and Transport Minister Phiphat Ratchakitprakarn, are intended to improve connectivity, reduce transport costs and support economic growth across the region. Sanphet acknowledged that large infrastructure projects can take years to complete. He said the ministry would continue addressing obstacles and speeding up projects that are ready to proceed. One of the largest developments is the second phase of the southern double-track railway project, which will extend the network further into southern Thailand. summary_cn: 泰国政府推进南部重大交通项目，南部双轨铁路扩建第二阶段获106.8亿铢投资。项目旨在延伸铁路网络覆盖范围，改善南部区域连通性、降低运输成本并支持区域经济增长。第一阶段已完成，覆盖纳空帕托姆 Nakhon Pathom 至春蓬 Chumphon 约420公里。同步进行的还有宋卡 Songkhla 和甲米 Krabi 两座新桥建设项目。

title: Four arrested over alleged 20-million-baht Freedom Beach land fraud in Phuket
desc: Four arrested over alleged 20-million-baht Freedom Beach land fraud in Phuket Legacy Police have arrested a Phuket man known as Sia Lek and three family members over the alleged sale of protected forest land behind Freedom Beach , where buyers lost more than 20 million baht. title: Thailand plans tougher driving licence rules for foreigners
desc: Thailand plans tougher driving licence rules for foreigners Legacy Thailand is considering major changes to driving licence requirements for foreigners , including scrapping exemptions from driving tests and requiring applicants to have at least two years of visa validity remaining. The Department of Land Transport (DLT) published the proposed changes on November 4, opening a public consultation that will run until December 4. The draft would amend regulations introduced in 2022 governing driving licence training and testing, with three proposed changes specifically targeting foreign applicants. Under the current rules, foreigners holding a valid driving licence from their home country or an International Driving Permit (IDP) can obtain a Thai driving licence without completing the standard training course, written examination or practical driving test. The DLT wants to remove these exemptions for both temporary two-year licences and five-year licences, meaning foreign applicants would have to complete the required training and tests even if they already hold a valid foreign licence.
