title: Koh Lanta bridge in Krabi set to start construction on November 14
desc: Koh Lanta bridge in Krabi set to start construction on November 14 Legacy Construction of a 1.78-billion-baht bridge linking Koh Lanta in Krabi with the mainland is due to start on Saturday, November 14, when the Department of Rural Roads plans to issue the order for work to begin. Construction of the 2.24-kilometre Koh Lanta bridge should take about three years, and the bridge is due to open in 2029, reducing the island’s reliance on the vehicle ferry. Deputy Transport Minister Sanpetch Boonyamanee, who oversees the ministry’s work in the South, gave the start date while setting out the ministry’s investment plans for the region, adding that a larger bridge over Songkhla Lake will follow the same schedule. The department signed construction contracts for both bridges on August 31 in a ceremony witnessed by Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul, with Director-General Phichit Hunsiri signing alongside the CMC Joint Venture and Malaysia’s CHEC Construction (M) Sdn Bhd. desc: Chao Phraya high tide may flood Bangkok riverside areas November 9 to 17 Legacy A Chao Phraya high tide could flood low-lying riverside and canal areas of Bangkok and six central provinces from tomorrow, November 9, to November 17, the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation (DDPM) warned. The greatest risk falls each morning, roughly between 6am and 1.30pm local time, when the river is forecast to reach or pass its critical level. DDPM Director-General Nirat Pongsitthithavorn said the department, acting as the central disaster prevention command, issued the alert after reviewing water conditions alongside Announcement No.15/2569, which the Royal Thai Navy’s Hydrographic Department published on November 5. The navy forecast two sets of tides, with all levels given in metres above mean sea level. Near Royal Thai Navy Headquarters in Bangkok, water is expected to reach 1.70 to 2 metres between 7.30am and 1.30pm from November 9 to 16, close to the 2-metre critical mark, so water could seep through gaps in flood walls, piers and drains. title: Arsenic in Sai River cuts Mae Sai tap water to 14 villages
desc: Arsenic in Sai River cuts Mae Sai tap water to 14 villages Legacy Arsenic above the safety standard and abnormally high turbidity in the Sai River led the Provincial Waterworks Authority (PWA) to cut Mae Sai tap water supplies to 14 villages in Chiang Rai to 60% of normal on November 5. The governor said yesterday, November 6, that output had recovered to about 80%. Chiang Rai Governor Chuchip Pongchai inspected the river at Ban Tham Pha Chom, in the Hua Fai area of Mae Sai district, at about 2pm yesterday, together with PWA and Pollution Control Department officials. The level of the Sai had dropped, leaving the contaminants more concentrated, and residents of the affected villages had not been getting enough water, while Chuchip said the province had taken control of the response and the situation was improving. PWA Mae Sai branch manager Khomsan Sanma said the raw water pumped from the Sai on November 5 was abnormally cloudy. Preliminary tests found arsenic above the standard and turbidity of 14,000 NTU (nephelometric turbidity units), more than the treatment plant can handle, against normal readings of 800 to 1,000 NTU in the dry season and 3,000 to 6,000 NTU in flood. title: 泰国书展吸引超140万人次 年轻人掀起纸质书阅读热潮
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，11月6日，泰国第31届全国书展在曼谷诗丽吉国家会议中心落下帷幕。为期10天的书展累计吸引超过140万人次参观，图书销售额突破5亿泰铢，同比增长近10%，创下销售新高。其中，Z世代年轻读者成为主要消费群体，占参观者总数的44.60%，漫画、小说及文学类图书最受欢迎。 尽管泰国图书出版行业面临消费购买力疲软、能源成本高企及洪涝灾害等多重挑战，但此次书展仍取得亮眼成绩，反映出泰国图书市场持续复苏的态势。尤其是年轻一代读者对纸质图书的热情，为出版行业增长提供了重要动力。 根据第31届全国书展参观者调查数据，出生于1997年至2012年的Z世代年轻读者，即14至29岁群体，占参观者总数的44.60%，成为本届书展最主要的消费力量。 从年龄结构来看，23至28岁的读者占比最高，达23.47%；其次为29至35岁群体，占20.38%；36至45岁群体占16.86%；19至22岁群体占15.55%。其余依次为46至55岁群体，占9.77%；55岁以上群体，占7.28%；15至18岁群体，占5.03%；12至14岁群体，占1.66%。 调查显示，Z世代读者的购书行为呈现较强的计划性。许多消费者在前往书展前，便已通过网络资讯、内容创作者及社交媒体意见领袖的图书推荐，提前了解新书信息，并列出计划购买的书单。 此外，本届书展还出现较为明显的重复参观现象。不少读者在书展开幕初期先到现场了解新书及价格，制定购买计划，待月底发放工资后再返回书展，按照此前拟定的书单集中采购。与此同时，首批参观者在社交媒体发布的购书分享和图书评价，也持续吸引新一批消费者前来，使书展在整个10天展期内保持较高人气。 消费金额方面，参观者平均每人支出约1300至1500泰铢，其中消费金额在500至1000泰铢之间的读者占29.90%。 本届书展的另一大亮点是纸质图书重新受到消费者青睐。随着数字技术发展，越来越多年轻读者选择阅读电子书（E-books），但调查结果显示，电子书并未完全取代传统纸质图书。相反，两种阅读形式呈现相互补充的发展趋势，共同推动读者群体扩大。 泰国出版商及书商协会（PUBAT）主席纳塔功表示，纸质图书能够持续吸引读者，主要在于现代消费者越来越重视书籍本身的收藏价值，包括封面设计、纸张质感、印刷工艺及整体制作质量。 为满足不同消费者需求，出版商也开始更加重视纸质图书的产品设计，将其打造为具有情感价值的收藏品。一方面推出特别收藏版，吸引收藏爱好者；另一方面提供价格更加亲民的普通版本，以适应不同消费群体的购买能力。 这一趋势表明，Z世代读者不仅希望通过电子屏幕获取阅读内容，同时也重视实体书带来的视觉、触觉体验，以及收藏和陈列书籍的满足感，推动纸质图书市场重新焕发生机。 根据书展对纸质图书及电子书阅读、购买偏好的调查，最受欢迎的五大图书类别分别为： 1.漫画，受欢迎比

desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，11月6日，泰国第31届全国书展在曼谷诗丽吉国家会议中心落下帷幕。为期10天的书展累计吸引超过140万人次参观，图书销售额突破5亿泰铢，同比增长近10%，创下销售新高。其中，Z世代年轻读者成为主要消费群体，占参观者总数的44.60%，漫画、小说及文学类图书最受欢迎。 尽管泰国图书出版行业面临消费购买力疲软、能源成本高企及洪涝灾害等多重挑战，但此次书展仍取得亮眼成绩，反映出泰国图书市场持续复苏的态势。尤其是年轻一代读者对纸质图书的热情，为出版行业增长提供了重要动力。 根据第31届全国书展参观者调查数据，出生于1997年至2012年的Z世代年轻读者，即14至29岁群体，占参观者总数的44.60%，成为本届书展最主要的消费力量。 从年龄结构来看，23至28岁的读者占比最高，达23.47%；其次为29至35岁群体，占20.38%；36至45岁群体占16.86%；19至22岁群体占15.55%。其余依次为46至55岁群体，占9.77%；55岁以上群体，占7.28%；15至18岁群体，占5.03%；12至14岁群体，占1.66%。 调查显示，Z世代读者的购书行为呈现较强的计划性。许多消费者在前往书展前，便已通过网络资讯、内容创作者及社交媒体意见领袖的图书推荐，提前了解新书信息，并列出计划购买的书单。 此外，本届书展还出现较为明显的重复参观现象。不少读者在书展开幕初期先到现场了解新书及价格，制定购买计划，待月底发放工资后再返回书展，按照此前拟定的书单集中采购。与此同时，首批参观者在社交媒体发布的购书分享和图书评价，也持续吸引新一批消费者前来，使书展在整个10天展期内保持较高人气。 消费金额方面，参观者平均每人支出约1300至1500泰铢，其中消费金额在500至1000泰铢之间的读者占29.90%。 本届书展的另一大亮点是纸质图书重新受到消费者青睐。随着数字技术发展，越来越多年轻读者选择阅读电子书（E-books），但调查结果显示，电子书并未完全取代传统纸质图书。相反，两种阅读形式呈现相互补充的发展趋势，共同推动读者群体扩大。 泰国出版商及书商协会（PUBAT）主席纳塔功表示，纸质图书能够持续吸引读者，主要在于现代消费者越来越重视书籍本身的收藏价值，包括封面设计、纸张质感、印刷工艺及整体制作质量。 为满足不同消费者需求，出版商也开始更加重视纸质图书的产品设计，将其打造为具有情感价值的收藏品。一方面推出特别收藏版，吸引收藏爱好者；另一方面提供价格更加亲民的普通版本，以适应不同消费群体的购买能力。 这一趋势表明，Z世代读者不仅希望通过电子屏幕获取阅读内容，同时也重视实体书带来的视觉、触觉体验，以及收藏和陈列书籍的满足感，推动纸质图书市场重新焕发生机。 根据书展对纸质图书及电子书阅读、购买偏好的调查，最受欢迎的五大图书类别分别为： 1.漫画，受欢迎比

title: Fuel protest convoy seeking 10-baht diesel cut due in Bangkok Sunday
desc: Fuel protest convoy seeking 10-baht diesel cut due in Bangkok Sunday Legacy A fuel protest convoy led by Krabi headman Mano Khrueakaew plans to reach Government House in Bangkok on Sunday evening, November 8, to demand a 10-baht-a-litre cut in diesel prices . Bangkok police have banned public gatherings within 50 metres of the compound until midnight on November 20. Mano, the kamnan, or subdistrict headman, of Krabi Noi in Krabi province, leads a group called the People’s Revolution Alliance to Protect the Land. Speaking in Chumphon yesterday, November 6, he said the convoy was heading for Gate 4 of Government House and would also press the government over drug problems he said had spread to every area. He told Daily News the group would stay put if the cut was not made. The convoy set off from Nakhon Si Thammarat on the morning of November 5 and spent the night in Surat Thani. It reached the Pathomphon intersection on Phetkasem Road (Highway 4) in Mueang Chumphon district at about 4pm on November 6, where supporters had been waiting since late morning and traffic slowed. title: 外国游客最爱泰国美食！青木瓜沙拉卖出1300万份，泰奶销量超860万杯
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，近日，泰国Grab公布平台消费数据，泰国美食持续受到外国游客欢迎。其中，青木瓜沙拉累计销量超过1300万份，泰式奶茶销量超过860万杯；打抛饭、炒饭和泰式炒河粉则是外国消费者最喜爱的三道泰国菜。 11月，Grab Thailand举办2026年政策论坛“GrabNEXT 2026”，以“The TASTE of THAI：释放泰国魅力，迈向美好新篇章”为主题，探讨如何将泰国文化资源与数字技术相结合，创造经济发展机遇，推动泰国软实力走向国际市场。 泰国文化部长萨比妲出席活动并致辞，强调文化部2027年政策方向“Cultural NEXUS——以文化连接未来”，旨在将泰国特色与传统智慧转化为经济价值，借助私营企业及数字技术平台推动相关发展。 Grab Thailand首席执行官詹素妲表示，2023年至2025年期间，Grab平台赴泰外国游客带来的相关收入达到150亿泰铢。与此同时，2025年通过GrabFood在区域市场订购泰国美食的交易额超过2200亿泰铢。 Grab提出“T.A.S.T.E.”五大策略，推动泰国文化资源与经济发展相结合。在文化旅游方面，Grab通过语言翻译、安全保障系统以及素万那普机场接送系统等技术服务，提升游客出行体验。数据显示，外国游客前往泰国文化旅游景点的叫车订单达到360万趟。热门目的地包括郑王庙、卧佛寺、真理寺、北榄府古城和吉姆·汤普森故居博物馆。其中，玛哈泰寺在被列入世界遗产名录后，相关叫车订单增长30%。 在文化特色与当代艺术推广方面，宋干节期间外国游客的叫车订单增长超过20%；前往曼谷拉差达慕拳击场的往返出行订单则增长至原来的2倍。 在扶持地方经营者方面，Grab与文化部合作，在GrabMart平台销售泰国社区产品。其中，鼻通、香薰蜡烛和藤条香薰等泰国特色香氛产品表现突出，累计订单达到25万件。GrabMart平台上，中小企业及社区商户占商家总数的74%。 在推动泰国品牌走向区域市场方面，Grab协助泰国品牌Emily’s进入新加坡市场，举办“Grab 5-Star Eats”活动，推广在海外经营的泰国餐厅，还曾在美国纽约时代广场的户外广告牌上宣传泰国美食。 在提升泰国美食标准方面，Grab连续第五年举办“GrabThumbsUp Awards”，并与文化部合作开展“The Lost Taste”项目，发掘和复兴逐渐失传的泰国传统食谱。 在餐饮消费方面，外国游客最喜爱的三道泰国菜分别为打抛饭、炒饭和泰式炒河粉。其中，青木瓜沙拉累计销量超过1,300万份，泰式奶茶销量超过860万杯，显示泰国传统美食在国际游客中具有较高人气。 论坛还围绕如何通过数字服务生态系统释放泰国文化潜力展开讨论，来自泰国财政经济办公室、国家旅游局及尚泰集团的代表分享了推动泰国产品与文化走向国际市场的经验。 泰国财政经济办公

summary_cn: 泰国2026年11月7日最新油价报价，涵盖汽油（Benzine）、高辛烷汽油混合（Gasohol）、柴油（Diesel）等主要油品。各大加油站包括中石油（PTT）、石油公司（BCP）、美孚（Mobil）、卡尔特克斯（Caltex）、沙索（Susco）和壳牌（Shell）的最新每升价格。

title: "แกร็บ" เฝ้าระวังแฮกเกอร์โจมตีทางไซเบอร์ ยกระดับความปลอดภัยขั้นสูง
desc: “แกร็บ” รับกังวลเทรนด์แฮกเกอร์โจมตีทางไซเบอร์ บริษัทแม่เร่งยกระดับเทคโนโลยีความปลอดภัยขั้นสูง สั่งระงับเปิดบริการที่อาจมีความเสี่ยงไว้ก่อน ประเมินปีหน้ายังโตได้ต่อ
title_cn: Grab加强网络安全防护 防范黑客攻击
summary_cn: Grab公司针对日益严峻的黑客网络攻击威胁采取主动防范措施。母公司已加快升级信息安全技术至最高级别，对可能存在风险的新服务暂时暂停上线。尽管面临安全挑战，Grab仍预期明年业务保持增长态势。
desc_original: “แกร็บ” รับกังวลเทรนด์แฮกเกอร์โจมตีทางไซเบอร์ บริษัทแม่เร่งยกระดับเทคโนโลยีความปลอดภัยขั้นสูง สั่งระงับเปิดบริการที่อาจมีความเสี่ยงไว้ก่อน ประเมินปีหน้ายังโตได้ต่อ

title: Grab seeks to monetise Thai cultural appeal
desc: Grab Thailand is capitalising on Thai culture and traditional wisdom to increase revenue from tourists while supporting the country's economic growth.
title_cn: Grab挖掘泰国文化魅力 拓展旅游收益
summary_cn: Grab泰国公司着眼于泰国文化和传统智慧的商业价值，通过深挖文化吸引力增加来自游客的收入，同时支持泰国经济增长。该战略体现了Grab在本地化运营中对文化资源的创新利用，为旅游经济注入新的增长动力。
desc_original: Grab Thailand is capitalising on Thai culture and traditional wisdom to increase revenue from tourists while supporting the country's economic growth.

title: Mall Group targets 20% rise in festive-season traffic
desc: The Mall Group Co Ltd has allocated 600 million baht for its year-end campaign, including New Year countdown celebrations, hoping to record a 20% increase in tourist numbers, driven by domestic travel.
title_cn: 商城集团瞄准节假日季客流增长20%
summary_cn: 商城集团公司投入6亿泰铢举办年末活动，包括新年倒计时庆典，目标通过带动国内旅游实现客流增长20%。
desc_original: The Mall Group Co Ltd has allocated 600 million baht for its year-end campaign, including New Year countdown celebrations, hoping to record a 20% increase in tourist numbers, driven by domestic travel.

title: SX festival spotlights climate
desc: The SX Food Festival 2026 opened on Friday with a climate change message, featuring a massive 10-tonne iceberg at the heart of the venue to demonstrate the effects of melting ice.
title_cn: SX美食节以气候变化为主题亮相
summary_cn: 2026年SX美食节周五开幕，在会场中心展示10吨冰山装置，以气候变化为主题直观演示冰融现象带来的影响。
desc_original: The SX Food Festival 2026 opened on Friday with a climate change message, featuring a massive 10-tonne iceberg at the heart of the venue to demonstrate the effects of melting ice.

title: Coins honour HM Queen's birthday
desc: The Treasury Department has issued its first commemorative coins honouring Her Majesty the Queen, including just 1,000 gold coins.
title_cn: 泰国财政部发行皇后生日纪念币
summary_cn: 泰国财政部首次发行纪念皇后生日的纪念币，其中金币仅限1000枚，规格珍稀。
desc_original: The Treasury Department has issued its first commemorative coins honouring Her Majesty the Queen, including just 1,000 gold coins.

title: Royal barges mark birthday
desc: People gathered along the banks of the Chao Phraya River on Friday to watch the Royal Barge Procession and the royal kathin presentation ceremony, held to mark Her Majesty the Queen's 48th birthday.
title_cn: 皇家驳船昭披耶河巡游庆祝皇后生日
summary_cn: 周五民众聚集昭披耶河（Chao Phraya River）两岸，观看皇家驳船巡游及皇家布施仪式（Kathin），为皇后48岁生日庆典。
desc_original: People gathered along the banks of the Chao Phraya River on Friday to watch the Royal Barge Procession and the royal kathin presentation ceremony, held to mark Her Majesty the Queen's 48th birthday.

title: Super El Niño effect could worsen PM2.5 next year
desc: The Ministry of Public Health has warned that the "Super El Niño" phenomenon could worsen Thailand's PM2.5 air pollution situation next year, especially in 40 high-risk provinces, including Bangkok.
title_cn: 超强厄尔尼诺现象可能加剧明年PM2.5污染
summary_cn: 泰国卫生部警示「超强厄尔尼诺」现象恐加剧明年PM2.5空气污染，包括曼谷在内的40个「高风险」省份将受重影响。
desc_original: The Ministry of Public Health has warned that the "Super El Niño" phenomenon could worsen Thailand's PM2.5 air pollution situation next year, especially in 40 high-risk provinces, including Bangkok.

title: Anutin orders charity checks
desc: The government is stepping up scrutiny of foundations nationwide after allegations that donations to the Goodness Foundation were misused, with the Interior Ministry ordering closer checks, particularly on those led by celebrities.
title_cn: 泰国加强慈善基金会监管
summary_cn: 泰国政府加强全国基金会的监管制度，起因是「善良基金会」(Goodness Foundation) 被指控挪用慈善捐款。内政部下令进行全面审查，特别加强对由名人领导的慈善组织的监管。此举措旨在确保公众捐款得到妥善使用和透明管理。
desc_original: The government is stepping up scrutiny of foundations nationwide after allegations that donations to the Goodness Foundation were misused, with the Interior Ministry ordering closer checks, particularly on those led by celebrities.

title: Gold rebound faces further volatility
desc: Investors are advised to avoid rushing into gold trading for short-term speculation as prices are expected to remain highly volatile amid further downside risks, says the Gold Traders Association (GTA).
title_cn: 黄金反弹面临进一步波动
summary_cn: 泰国黄金商人协会(GTA)发布市场警告，黄金价格预期将保持高度波动状态，仍存在进一步下跌风险。协会建议投资者避免因短期投机而仓促入场，应采取谨慎态度应对当前市场的不确定性和价格波动。
desc_original: Investors are advised to avoid rushing into gold trading for short-term speculation as prices are expected to remain highly volatile amid further downside risks, says the Gold Traders Association (GTA).

title: Bangkok's royal barge procession 2026
desc: Their Majesties the King and Queen take part in the royal barge procession to Wat Arun Ratchawararam Ratchaworamahawihan, commonly known as the Temple of Dawn, on Friday (Nov 6) to present royal Kathin robes as part of celebrations marking the Queen’s 48th birthday on June 3, 2026. The ceremony showcases Thailand’s royal traditions, with 52 elaborately decorated barges rowed...
title_cn: 曼谷皇家龙舟游行庆祝王后诞辰
summary_cn: 泰国国王和王后参加传统皇家龙舟游行，前往曼谷的暹罗黎明寺(Wat Arun Ratchawararam Ratchaworamahawihan)，呈献皇家卡欣长袍，庆祝王后48岁生日。此次盛典共有52艘精心装饰的龙舟参加，充分展现了泰国皇家的庆典传统文化。
desc_original: Their Majesties the King and Queen take part in the royal barge procession to Wat Arun Ratchawararam Ratchaworamahawihan, commonly known as the Temple of Dawn, on Friday (Nov 6) to present royal Kathin robes as part of celebrations marking the Queen’s 48th birthday on June 3, 2026. The ceremony showcases Thailand’s royal traditions, with 52 elaborately decorated barges rowed...

title: Ekniti optimistic on continued AI investment
desc: The outcome of the US midterm elections could trigger volatility in the global economy, but investment in the artificial intelligence (AI) industry is expected to continue flowing into Thailand, says Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas.
title_cn: 泰国财政部长看好AI投资前景
summary_cn: 泰国财政部长埃克尼蒂(Ekniti Nitithanprapas)表示，虽然美国中期选举可能引发全球经济波动，但人工智能(AI)产业的投资预计将继续流向泰国。这一乐观态度反映了泰国政府对吸引高端科技投资、发展数字经济的信心与决心。
desc_original: The outcome of the US midterm elections could trigger volatility in the global economy, but investment in the artificial intelligence (AI) industry is expected to continue flowing into Thailand, says Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas.

title: A proposal to seed the future
desc: The debate over Thailand's potential adoption of the 1991 International Convention for the Protection of New Varieties of Plants (UPOV 1991) highlights crucial issues regarding the control of seed use, the plant breeders' rights, and what stronger intellectual property protection could mean for Thailand's agricultural sector, farmers and consumers.
title_cn: 泰国推进植物品种保护制度改革
summary_cn: 泰国国内关于是否采纳1991年《国际新植物品种保护公约》(UPOV 1991)的讨论引发广泛关注。该公约涉及种子使用权、植物育种者权利及知识产权保护等核心问题，其采纳将影响泰国农业发展、农民权益和消费者利益，相关各方对此持不同观点。
desc_original: The debate over Thailand's potential adoption of the 1991 International Convention for the Protection of New Varieties of Plants (UPOV 1991) highlights crucial issues regarding the control of seed use, the plant breeders' rights, and what stronger intellectual property protection could mean for Thailand's agricultural sector, farmers and consumers.

title: Rally curbs set as convoy nears city
desc: The Metropolitan Police Bureau (MPB) has banned public gatherings within 50 metres of Government House ahead of the arrival today in Bangkok of a southern-led protest group demanding government action on fuel prices and living costs.
title_cn: 集会禁令启动　南方抗议车队逼近曼谷政府大楼
summary_cn: 泰国警察局（MPB）发布禁令，禁止在曼谷政府大楼（Government House）周围50米范围内举行公众集会。南方反对派组织车队逼近曼谷，抗议燃油价格高企和生活成本上升，要求政府采取行动。此举是当局为维持首都秩序而采取的安全措施。
desc_original: The Metropolitan Police Bureau (MPB) has banned public gatherings within 50 metres of Government House ahead of the arrival today in Bangkok of a southern-led protest group demanding government action on fuel prices and living costs.

title: Border areas to ramp up security steps
desc: The Department of Provincial Administration (Dopa) has ordered stricter security measures along Thailand's borders nationwide, bringing together local officials, police and military personnel to combat drug smuggling, illegal goods and illegal entry.
title_cn: 泰国全面加强边境安保措施
summary_cn: 泰国地方行政部门（Dopa）下令全国边境加强安保行动，组织地方官员、警察和军方力量联合巡查，重点打击毒品走私、违禁品运输和非法越境等违法行为。这是泰国政府加强边境管制的重要举措。
desc_original: The Department of Provincial Administration (Dopa) has ordered stricter security measures along Thailand's borders nationwide, bringing together local officials, police and military personnel to combat drug smuggling, illegal goods and illegal entry.

title: Minister vows no new EV import curbs this year
desc: The government will not introduce additional measures to curb electric vehicle imports before higher excise tax rates on imported EVs take effect on Jan 1, 2027, citing concerns over potential complaints that such actions could constitute trade barriers, according to the Industry Ministry.
title_cn: 泰国工业部承诺年内不加强电动车进口限制
summary_cn: 泰国政府表示在2027年1月1日提高进口电动车消费税政策生效前，不会推出新的进口限制措施，以避免被指控设置贸易壁垒。这反映出政府在鼓励电动车产业发展与监管进口间的平衡。
desc_original: The government will not introduce additional measures to curb electric vehicle imports before higher excise tax rates on imported EVs take effect on Jan 1, 2027, citing concerns over potential complaints that such actions could constitute trade barriers, according to the Industry Ministry.

title: Energy prices push inflation to 45-month high
desc: Thailand's headline consumer price index (CPI) rose 3.9% in October from a year earlier, driven by higher fuel prices, which accounted for 56% of inflation.
title_cn: 能源价格推高泰国通胀至45个月新高
summary_cn: 泰国10月消费者物价指数（CPI）同比上升3.9%，创45个月新高。能源价格是主要推手，占通胀因素的56%。燃油成本急速上升推高交通、物流和日用品价格，直接增加了普通民众和企业负担。
desc_original: Thailand's headline consumer price index (CPI) rose 3.9% in October from a year earlier, driven by higher fuel prices, which accounted for 56% of inflation.

title: Call for more clarity on digital platform fee rules
desc: The Thai Digital Platform Trade Association (TDPA) is urging the Trade Competition Commission of Thailand (TCCT) to clarify proposed rules on fee structures.
title_cn: 数字平台业界呼吁澄清收费规则
summary_cn: 泰国数字平台贸易协会（TDPA）敦促贸易竞争委员会（TCCT）澄清关于在线平台费用结构的拟议监管规则，以便企业明确合规标准。这反映出泰国政府对数字经济领域的监管逐步细化。
desc_original: The Thai Digital Platform Trade Association (TDPA) is urging the Trade Competition Commission of Thailand (TCCT) to clarify proposed rules on fee structures.

title: ระทึก รพ.เจ็ดเสมียน เสาตอม่อร้าวเห็นเหล็กสนิม-ทรุดหนัก หวั่นอาคารถล่ม
desc: รพ.เจ็ดเสมียน เสาตอม่อร้าวเห็นเหล็กสนิม-ทรุดหนัก จำใจต้องเปิดบริการต่อ เหตุไม่มีพื้นที่รองรับการย้ายผู้ป่วย เร่งหาทางออกสร้างอาคารใหม่ทดแทน
title_cn: 七圣医院结构危急 梁柱生锈下沉恐坍塌
summary_cn: 曼谷七圣医院发现建筑结构严重受损，支撑梁出现大面积裂缝并有生锈迹象，下沉情况严重。由于缺乏充足空间转移患者，医院被迫继续营业。院方正紧急推进新建筑建设以作替代。

title: ระทึก ฟ้าผ่ากระท่อมกลางดอยแม่แจ่ม ชาวบ้านดับ 1 ศพ เจ็บระนาว
desc: ระทึก ฟ้าผ่ากระท่อมกลางดอยแม่แจ่ม จ.เชียงใหม่ ชาวบ้านเกี่ยวข้าวเข้าไปหลบฝน เสียชีวิต 1 ศพ ได้รับบาดเจ็บหลายราย
title_cn: 闪电击中清迈茶园山草棚 致1死多伤
summary_cn: 清迈府茶园山（Doi Mae Jam）一座临时草棚在暴雨天气中遭闪电直击，当时村民正在进行茶叶收获工作。此次意外造成1人死亡，多人受伤。

desc: กทม. ลุยตรวจหาบเร่แผงลอยพญาไท-บางซื่อ ย้ำเคร่งสุขอนามัย ดักไขมัน แยกขยะ ห้ามเทน้ำมัน-คราบไขมันลงท่อระบายน้ำและโคนต้นไม้โดยเด็ดขาด เล็งผลักดัน “จุดไมโคร” จัดระเบียบนอกจุดผ่อนผันช่วยผู้ค้า
title_cn: 曼谷帕亚泰和邦淑区整顿流动摊贩 推「微型点」规范化管理
summary_cn: 曼谷市对帕亚泰区（Phayathai）和邦淑区（Bang Sueah）的流动摊贩展开检查整治。当局强化卫生要求，要求商户收集油脂、分类垃圾，禁止向排水管道和树根倾倒油脂及污水。同时推出「微型点」模式，在规定区域外为商户提供有序的经营位置，兼顾城市管理与商户生计。

desc: นโยบายการเปลี่ยนผ่านพลังงาน ดำเนินการตามวัตถุประสงค์การออก พ.ร.ก.กำหนดให้อำนาจกระทรวงการคลังกู้เงินเพื่อแก้ไขปัญหาผลกระทบจากสถานการณ์วิกฤตด้านพลังงานฯ พ.ศ.2569 วงเงิน 200,000 ล้านบาท

summary_cn: 泰国政府推行能源转型政策，根据新发布的政府令，财政部获得授权以借款方式处理能源危机带来的影响。本次授权借款额度高达2000亿泰铢（2026年），用于应对全国能源危机问题。

desc: ป.ป.ส. จับมือ AITF คุมเข้มท่าอากาศยานดอนเมือง เดินหน้าสุ่มตรวจตัดเส้นทางลำเลียงยาเสพติดระหว่างประเทศ
title_cn: 泰国缉毒局与机场安全部门联手加强国际航班检查
summary_cn: 泰国缉毒局与廊曼机场反恐安全部门（AITF）展开合作，加强对廊曼国际机场（Don Muang）的管制力度。双方推进对国际航班乘客及行李的随机检查，旨在切断跨境毒品贩运通道，防止毒品进出泰国。

title: Chiang Mai holds early talks on environmentally friendly Doi Suthep cable car
desc: Chiang Mai holds early talks on environmentally friendly Doi Suthep cable car Legacy Chiang Mai ‘s Provincial Administrative Organisation (PAO) held a discussion with Austrian and Canadian representatives about a cable car system on Doi Suthep mountain to reduce traffic congestion and pollution. The meeting took place at 11am today, November 4, under the direction of PAO President Pichai Lertpongadisorn, who assigned Deputy President Somchat Wattanakla to lead the discussions. The meeting included representatives from the Austrian Consulate in Chiang Mai, led by Honorary Consul Nikolaus Prachensky, as well as advisers from Cable Car Solutions CNX and relevant government agencies. Photo via CM 108 Representatives from Doppelmayr Group, the leading cable car system manufacturer from Austria, and Elevate, the investor in cable car projects from Canada, presented their initial concept for the proposed development. The proposed system would provide an alternative form of public transport while connecting visitors to tourism destinations. title: Where the festive lights shine brightest in Thailand this year
desc: Where the festive lights shine brightest in Thailand this year Legacy Thailand is starting to light up for the festive season, and this year’s celebrations go well beyond the usual Christmas trees and shopping centre decorations. The lighting festivals Thailand has lined up for 2026 range from synchronised riverside displays in Bangkok to immersive art installations in Ratchaburi and illuminated traditions in the northeast. Some are all about Christmas, while others use light and technology to showcase local culture. If you’re looking for somewhere to spend an evening surrounded by festive lights, here are five places worth adding to your calendar. 1. ICONSIAM’s annual illumination festival returns with The Blessing Tree , a Christmas tree standing over 21 metres tall, inspired by Manorah, a traditional performing art from southern Thailand. Decorated with more than 40,000 beads

title: Japan ‘concerts scam’ leave Thai artists and venue with financial losses
desc: Japan ‘concerts scam’ leave Thai artists and venue with financial losses Legacy Thai singer Aphaphorn Nakhonsawan , widely known as Hi Aphaphorn, asked the Office of the Consumer Protection Board (OCPB) to pursue legal action over a concert scam involving events planned in Osaka, Japan. The case emerged after a concert booking involving Aphaphorn and her team fell through. She told OCPB officials that the alleged organiser had befriended her at a wedding before inviting her to perform at an event linked to an application launch in Japan. Aphaphorn said other artists had also been invited to perform, although their names have not been disclosed publicly. She initially trusted the organiser because rehearsals were arranged, concert tickets were put on sale, and she had met members of the organising team during preparations. Photo via Amarin TV However, as the event dates approached, no flights had been booked, the agreed deposit had not been paid, and the organising team stopped responding to messages. title: Little-known Nan lures Caelan Moriarty in search of musical inspiration in TAT campaign
desc: Little-known Nan lures Caelan Moriarty in search of musical inspiration in TAT campaign Legacy A singer who admits he’d never heard of Nan until he saw photos of it has headed to the northern province in search of fresh creative ideas. His trip is part of a Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) campaign that pairs Thai destinations with film, music and creative work. Caelan Moriarty made the journey through TAT’s “Amazing Location: From Scene to Scenic” campaign, which invites travellers to see the country from a new angle. In an exclusive interview before the trip, he talked about music, travel and how unfamiliar places feed into his work. From Thai fans to a Thai music video Caelan’s career spans music and fashion. He’s a former member of the band INTERSECTION, gained further recognition on the Chinese talent show CHUANG 2021, and has since gone solo. One of his links to Thailand is “feel like”, a collaboration with Thai artist Tobii. The pair met at ComplexCon, where a shared taste in music and style brought them together. The result blends R&B and hip hop, drawing on the cultural influences of both artists. The music video for “feel like” was shot in Thailand, a choice Caelan

title: Officials seize 473 protected turtles sent from Mexico as leather belts
desc: Officials seize 473 protected turtles sent from Mexico as leather belts Legacy Thai wildlife officers seized 473 turtles shipped from Mexico to Suvarnabhumi International Airport in five parcels falsely declared as leather belts. The seizure took place on Tuesday, November 3, at the airport’s inbound cargo warehouse in the free zone in Bang Phli district, Samut Prakan. The parcels arrived aboard Korean Air flight KE657 from Incheon International Airport in South Korea. Officers became suspicious during an X-ray inspection because the packages, declared as leather belts, appeared to contain something else. They seized the parcels and opened them with assistance from THAI Cargo officers. The inspection uncovered 461 mud turtles of the genus Kinosternon and 12 Mexican musk turtles of the genus Staurotypus, instead of the declared leather goods. Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin said the seizure included both live turtles and carcasses, without giving a figure for either. title: Mystery object resembling space debris washes ashore in Krabi
desc: Mystery object resembling space debris washes ashore in Krabi Legacy A mysterious object resembling space debris has washed ashore on Koh Mai Phai in Krabi, prompting an investigation by Thailand’s space agency to determine where it came from. The object was reported on November 1 near a ranger station in Hat Noppharat Thara–Mu Ko Phi Phi National Park. Its origin has not yet been identified. Yesterday, November 5, the Geo-Informatics and Space Technology Development Agency (GISTDA) sent a team from its Space Technology Research Centre (S-TREC) to inspect and collect the object. Photo via Facebook: GISTDA The team worked with the Krabi branch of the Thai Maritime Enforcement Command Centre and national park officials to review information about its discovery and storage. The agencies also exchanged maritime monitoring data and technical information about the tracking of objects in space. Following the inspection, GISTDA transported the object to its Space Krenovation Park in Chon Buri for detailed engineering analysis. The examination is intended to establish the object’s origin, with GISTDA expected to announce its findings once the analysis is completed. Photo via Fac

summary_cn: 疑似太空垃圾的神秘物体在甲米（Krabi）诺帕拉特哈拉-皮皮群岛国家公园（Hat Noppharat Thara–Mu Ko Phi Phi National Park）附近冲上海岸。泰国地理信息与太空技术发展局（GISTDA）派出空间技术研究中心（S-TREC）团队赴现场调查，与泰国海事执法指挥中心、国家公园管理部门合作收集物体信息。该物体已被送往春武里（Chon Buri）的太空创新园进行工程分析，以确定其来源和属性。
desc_original: Mystery object resembling space debris washes ashore in Krabi Legacy A mysterious object resembling space debris has washed ashore on Koh Mai Phai in Krabi, prompting an investigation by Thailand’s space agency to determine where it came from. The object was reported on November 1 near a ranger station in Hat Noppharat Thara–Mu Ko Phi Phi National Park. Its origin has not yet been identified. Yesterday, November 5, the Geo-Informatics and Space Technology Development Agency (GISTDA) sent a team from its Space Technology Research Centre (S-TREC) to inspect and collect the object. Photo via Facebook: GISTDA The team worked with the Krabi branch of the Thai Maritime Enforcement Command Centre and national park officials to review information about its discovery and storage. The agencies also exchanged maritime monitoring data and technical information about the tracking of objects in space. Following the inspection, GISTDA transported the object to its Space Krenovation Park in Chon Buri for detailed engineering analysis. The examination is intended to establish the object’s origin, with GISTDA expected to announce its findings once the analysis is completed. Photo via Fac

title: Thai children under 18 must show birth certificates to leave Thailand
desc: Thai children under 18 must show birth certificates to leave Thailand Legacy Thailand’s Immigration Bureau has tightened checks on Thai children under 18 leaving the country , and adults travelling with them must now prove their relationship with a birth certificate and, in most cases, a consent letter. On November 4, Immigration Bureau Commissioner Police Lieutenant General Nopsin Poonsawat said the screening focuses on whether the adult has a genuine link to the child, and its aim is to prevent human trafficking, cross-border child abduction and children being taken out of Thailand unlawfully. A valid passport and a birth certificate are required (original, a photocopy or an electronic image), and the rule applies to children of Thai nationality , so it also covers Thai children with a foreign parent. A foreign or a divorced parent flying out alone with a Thai child will need a consent letter from the other parent. Photo via AzmanL/Getty Images A legal guardian must carry a copy of the court order appointing them, and a child travelling with anyone else needs a consent letter from both parents or the legal guardian. The bureau said every consent letter must be made in front

title: 泰国航空货运爆仓，出口商恐遭海外罚款
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，泰国航空（Thai Airways）货运仓库近期出现严重积压，导致出口货物无法按时交付。泰国出口商理事会（TNSC）指出，若问题持续，出口商可能面临海外进口商索赔及合同罚款，甚至影响泰国出口竞争力。 泰国出口商理事会主席塔纳功表示，目前泰国航空货运积压量远高于正常水平，主要受到IT产品进出口量激增及此前洪灾影响。实际上，货运问题在洪灾发生前就已出现，洪灾进一步加剧了货物堆积，使得运输延误持续扩大。 塔纳功指出，理事会已敦促泰国航空不要再次暂停接收货物，因为出口商仍需持续发货。航空公司管理层及货运团队应尽快改善内部管理、解决技术问题，加速处理积压货物，而不应要求出口商停止发货。 与此同时，理事会已致函泰国民航局（CAAT），请求在符合国际标准及相关规定的前提下，适当放宽部分可调整的运营条件，以提高货运管理灵活性，目前正等待相关部门回应。 目前，部分出口商虽然已将货物送入泰国航空货运仓库，但仍无法按照原定时间运出，不得不向海外进口商解释延误原因，争取对方理解。塔纳功指出，如果交货延迟影响贸易合同约定，进口商可能要求赔偿损失或支付违约罚款，出口商将面临额外经营压力。 尽管转用其他航空公司的货运服务是可行的替代方案，但目前尚未出现大规模调整。由于已有大量货物积压在泰国航空货运系统内，加上其运费仍具有一定吸引力，部分出口商暂时仍选择继续使用其服务。 塔纳功表示，目前尚未出现海外进口商明确取消订单或转向其他国家采购的情况。由于IT制造业供应链规模庞大、结构复杂，更换采购来源需要较长时间，因此海外合作伙伴目前仍在等待泰国解决货运问题并陆续接收货物，但尚未明确该问题正式解决期限。 泰国航空方面已表示了解相关问题并愿意与受影响企业合作。泰国出口商理事会将继续敦促其加快处理货物积压，政府部门也已表示愿意提供支持，但部分技术问题及监管规定仍需进一步协商。 塔纳功表示，航空货运商品大多具有较高价值，且对交付时效要求严格。如果运输系统无法尽快恢复正常，不仅可能拖累泰国出口表现，还可能损害海外贸易伙伴对泰国供应链的信心，削弱泰国出口商的国际竞争力。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：bangkokbiznews） The post 泰国航空货运爆仓，出口商恐遭海外罚款 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 泰国猴痘出现新变化！两种症状需警惕
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，11月5日，泰国传染病内科专家卡松教授通过个人Facebook账号发布消息，提醒医务人员和公众提高警惕，加强对患者的检查与诊断。近期发现，猴痘的临床表现与以往有所不同，导致部分病例出现误诊，甚至造成医务人员在不知情的情况下接触病毒。 卡松教授介绍，上个月，多所医学院及医院曾就患者病例向其咨询，其中出现了以下两种特殊情况： 1.被误认为臀部脓肿： 一名患者因臀部出现类似脓肿的症状进入手术室，但手术过程中却发现患者臀部及周围分布着大量脓疱和透明水疱。随后检测确认患者感染猴痘，导致多名医生和护士被列为高风险接触者。 2.被误认为扁桃体炎： 最近又发现一名猴痘患者因出现类似扁桃体炎的症状入院治疗。据医院感染控制管理人员（IC/ICN）的LINE工作群通报，多个医疗机构也陆续报告了类似病例。 对此，该专家提醒医务人员，应详细询问患者病史，谨慎评估皮肤病变情况，并采取适当的个人防护措施（PPE）。这是因为患者可能并未出现像过去那样明显的全身皮疹或脓疱，容易增加诊断难度及医务人员感染风险。 （编译：hansa；审校：wan；来源：onenews31） The post 泰国猴痘出现新变化！两种症状需警惕 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 警惕！泰国猴痘出现新症状易被误诊
summary_cn: 泰国传染病专家卡松教授提醒，近期发现猴痘临床表现与既往不同，导致诊疗困难。一例患者臀部症状被误认为脓肿，手术中才发现满布脓疱和水疱，经检测确认为猴痘，致医护人员成为高风险接触者。另一例患者因类似扁桃体炎症状入院，医疗机构因缺乏警觉未能及时识别。专家建议医务人员详细询问病史、仔细评估皮肤病变并采取适当防护措施。由于患者可能不呈现过往典型皮疹或脓疱，诊疗延迟增加医护感染风险。

title: 泰国警方捣毁跨国电诈团伙，17人落网！
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，11月5日，泰国中央调查局、国家警察总署反网络诈骗中心宣布，成功捣毁一个以老挝为据点的跨国电信诈骗团伙，目前已有17名嫌疑人落网。该团伙成员冒充泰国电信运营商AIS工作人员及普吉府警察，通过电话、LINE视频通话及伪造政府文件等方式，恐吓受害者并诱骗其转账。 据警方介绍，此次行动由国家警察总署反网络诈骗中心联合中央调查警察局、网络犯罪调查部门及相关单位开展。 案件源于老挝波乔省警方此前打击当地电信诈骗团伙的行动。当地警方共逮捕23名泰国籍人员及1名非泰国籍人员，并于2026年6月30日将24人遣返回泰国。行动中查获4件类似泰国警察制服的卡其色衬衫、1台台式电脑、5台iPad、5部手机以及记录诈骗话术的笔记。 泰国警方接收人员后，对涉案人员及电子设备展开调查，发现设备中存在通过LINE和WhatsApp进行的工作指令群聊，内容包括诈骗话术、受害者名单及伪造政府文件照片。警方据此认定，相关人员可能参与跨国诈骗犯罪网络。 经过进一步调查，警方共申请对32名嫌疑人签发逮捕令，目前已抓获其中17人。涉案人员被控涉嫌合谋冒充他人身份企图诈骗公众、伪造及使用伪造政府文件、向计算机系统输入虚假数据以及参与跨国有组织犯罪等罪名。 调查发现，2026年5月至6月17日期间，该团伙在海外设立诈骗据点，采取明确的分工模式，幕后组织人员负责招募员工、安排办公地点及设备，并通过泰国境内银行账户转账为诈骗活动提供资金。 具体实施诈骗时，第一线人员冒充泰国电信运营商AIS工作人员，谎称受害者的手机号码涉嫌与违法犯罪活动有关，随后将电话转接给第二线人员。第二线人员则冒充普吉府直辖县警察局警员，声称受害者涉嫌与犯罪案件有关，要求其将资金转入指定银行账户接受所谓的资金核查。为增强可信度，诈骗人员还会添加受害者的LINE账号，通过视频通话展示类似泰国警察制服的服装，并自称警察中尉，向受害者发送伪造的银行存折及普吉府法院文件，以司法调查为由施加压力，诱骗受害者转账。 泰国反网络诈骗中心提醒公众，随着数字通信技术的发展，电信诈骗及网络诈骗手段不断翻新，不仅造成经济损失，也给受害者及其家庭带来严重影响。民众应提高警惕，不要轻信陌生来电及所谓执法人员的身份，更不要按照对方要求向陌生账户转账。 警方同时提醒，有意通过社交媒体前往邻国工作的民众，应谨慎核实招聘信息及工作单位，避免被诱骗加入电信诈骗团伙或跨国犯罪组织。相关人员不仅可能成为人口贩运的受害者，还可能因参与诈骗活动而触犯泰国法律，最高可面临15年监禁。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：mgronline） The post 泰国警方捣毁跨国电诈团伙，17人落网！ appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 泰国警方捣毁跨国电诈团伙，17名嫌犯落网
summary_cn: 泰国中央调查局和国家警察总署反网络诈骗中心联合破获一跨国电信诈骗团伙，17名嫌疑人被逮捕。该团伙以老挝(Laos)为据点，成员冒充泰国电信运营商AIS工作人员及普吉府(Phuket)警察，通过电话、LINE视频通话和伪造政府文件等方式，声称受害者涉嫌违法犯罪，诱骗受害者向指定账户转账。警方提醒公众警惕陌生来电，谨防诈骗，并警告求职者应核实招聘信息真伪，避免被诱骗参与犯罪活动。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，11月5日，泰国中央调查局、国家警察总署反网络诈骗中心宣布，成功捣毁一个以老挝为据点的跨国电信诈骗团伙，目前已有17名嫌疑人落网。该团伙成员冒充泰国电信运营商AIS工作人员及普吉府警察，通过电话、LINE视频通话及伪造政府文件等方式，恐吓受害者并诱骗其转账。 据警方介绍，此次行动由国家警察总署反网络诈骗中心联合中央调查警察局、网络犯罪调查部门及相关单位开展。 案件源于老挝波乔省警方此前打击当地电信诈骗团伙的行动。当地警方共逮捕23名泰国籍人员及1名非泰国籍人员，并于2026年6月30日将24人遣返回泰国。行动中查获4件类似泰国警察制服的卡其色衬衫、1台台式电脑、5台iPad、5部手机以及记录诈骗话术的笔记。 泰国警方接收人员后，对涉案人员及电子设备展开调查，发现设备中存在通过LINE和WhatsApp进行的工作指令群聊，内容包括诈骗话术、受害者名单及伪造政府文件照片。警方据此认定，相关人员可能参与跨国诈骗犯罪网络。 经过进一步调查，警方共申请对32名嫌疑人签发逮捕令，目前已抓获其中17人。涉案人员被控涉嫌合谋冒充他人身份企图诈骗公众、伪造及使用伪造政府文件、向计算机系统输入虚假数据以及参与跨国有组织犯罪等罪名。 调查发现，2026年5月至6月17日期间，该团伙在海外设立诈骗据点，采取明确的分工模式，幕后组织人员负责招募员工、安排办公地点及设备，并通过泰国境内银行账户转账为诈骗活动提供资金。 具体实施诈骗时，第一线人员冒充泰国电信运营商AIS工作人员，谎称受害者的手机号码涉嫌与违法犯罪活动有关，随后将电话转接给第二线人员。第二线人员则冒充普吉府直辖县警察局警员，声称受害者涉嫌与犯罪案件有关，要求其将资金转入指定银行账户接受所谓的资金核查。为增强可信度，诈骗人员还会添加受害者的LINE账号，通过视频通话展示类似泰国警察制服的服装，并自称警察中尉，向受害者发送伪造的银行存折及普吉府法院文件，以司法调查为由施加压力，诱骗受害者转账。 泰国反网络诈骗中心提醒公众，随着数字通信技术的发展，电信诈骗及网络诈骗手段不断翻新，不仅造成经济损失，也给受害者及其家庭带来严重影响。民众应提高警惕，不要轻信陌生来电及所谓执法人员的身份，更不要按照对方要求向陌生账户转账。 警方同时提醒，有意通过社交媒体前往邻国工作的民众，应谨慎核实招聘信息及工作单位，避免被诱骗加入电信诈骗团伙或跨国犯罪组织。相关人员不仅可能成为人口贩运的受害者，还可能因参与诈骗活动而触犯泰国法律，最高可面临15年监禁。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：mgronline） The post 泰国警方捣毁跨国电诈团伙，17人落网！ appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Thais worldwide invited to wear traditional clothing throughout December
desc: Thais worldwide invited to wear traditional clothing throughout December Legacy The Thai Ministry of Culture invited Thai people around the world to wear traditional Thai clothing throughout December , ahead of an expected UNESCO decision on the country’s nomination for intangible cultural heritage status . Thailand submitted the eight styles of Chut Thai Phra Ratcha Niyom to UNESCO in 2024. The nomination is expected to be considered from December 1 to 3 during the 21st session of UNESCO’s Intergovernmental Committee for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage, in Xiamen, China, from November 30 to December 5. The eight styles were developed by experts at the direction of Queen Sirikit, the Queen Mother, who asked them to study clothing worn in the Thai royal court and adapt it for everyday use. Photo via Facebook/ กรมส่งเสริมวัฒนธรรม The collection includes Ruean Ton, Chitlada, Amarin, Boromphiman, Dusit, Chakri, Siwalai and Chakkraphat. Ahead of the decision, the Culture Ministry has promoted the clothing through exhibitions in several countries, including the Netherlands, Japan and France. In The Hague, Thai dress was displayed at the de Bijenkorf department store

title: 泰国传统服饰有望进入联合国非遗名录
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，11月4日，泰国文化部长萨比妲宣布好消息，今年12月1日至3日期间，联合国教科文组织（UNESCO）将正式审议“将泰国传统服饰列入人类非物质文化遗产名录”这一提案。 此前11月2日，萨比妲在乌隆他尼府暹罗大酒店主持召开了文化部东北部府级政策部署及工作进展跟踪会议，并参与泰国传统服饰专题研讨会。会后，萨比妲表示，目前，泰国传统服饰即将提交联合国教育、科学及文化组织（UNESCO），申请列入人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录，预计于2026年12月初在中国厦门接受审议。她邀请泰国民众共同关注此次申遗进展。 萨比妲表示，文化部将通过文化促进厅持续开展宣传活动，鼓励民众在不同场合穿着泰国传统服饰，同时不断普及相关知识。 此次赴乌隆他尼府开展公务考察，旨在推动东北部5府的文化工作。在政府正式异地召开内阁会议期间，文化部还举办了专题研讨会，帮助公众了解泰国传统服饰的历史渊源、文化价值、审美特色及其独特性，鼓励民众将相关知识应用于实践，进一步开发创意产品。 东北部这5个府各自拥有独具特色的传统织物，乌隆他尼府班清地区有螺旋纹图案的织锦丝绸；廊开府有大型那伽蛇纹织物；廊磨喃蒲府有织锦与扎染交替图案的织物；黎府有当地棉花花纹织物；汶干府则以Mak Beng传统图案为特色。 持续推广泰国传统服饰已经取得一定成效，过去，民众通常只在重要活动中穿着泰服，如今穿着场合已逐渐扩大。2025年，每家泰服经营商的服饰制作订单增加了200套，带动了泰国纺织产业的发展，反映出越来越多民众开始穿着泰国传统服饰，文化部还鼓励民众将Ruean Ton和Chitralada两种传统泰服进行混搭，适应不同场合。文化部将继续贯彻诗丽吉王太后的王室遗志，鼓励民众利用地方传统织物制作泰国传统服饰，传播泰国艺术文化，同时为当地社区创造就业机会、增加收入。 她强调，每次穿着泰国传统服饰，都不应只关注服装的美观，还应了解其背后的文化知识。从一块织物的制作到最终裁剪缝制成衣，每一个环节都能为相关从业群体创造收入。 关于将泰国传统服饰相关知识纳入基础教育课程的进展，萨比妲表示，目前已初步与教育部长巴瑟进行讨论。双方提出，可考虑将相关知识纳入课程体系，让儿童和青少年，尤其是中学生，了解泰国传统民族服饰的历史渊源及其重要意义。11月5日，文化部再次与教育部举行了会谈，进一步讨论了具体实施方案。 （编译：hansa；审核：wan；来源：matichon） The post 泰国传统服饰有望进入联合国非遗名录 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Scam call centre investigation leads to discovery of SIM boxes at Khao San guesthouse
desc: Scam call centre investigation leads to discovery of SIM boxes at Khao San guesthouse Legacy Police found two SIM boxes hidden above the ceiling of a guesthouse nea r Khao San Road in Bangkok during a call centre scam investigation yesterday, November 4. Officers from the Investigation Division of the Metropolitan Police searched the guesthouse on Tanao Road in Bowon Niwet subdistrict, Phra Nakhon district, at about 3.45pm. Police said the search followed complaints from people who had received calls from suspected scammers posing as Revenue Department officials. The callers allegedly threatened them with false legal charges before attempting to trick them into transferring money. Investigators traced the phone numbers used to contact the complainants to Room 4 on the ground floor of the guesthouse. The room was empty, and officers found no suspicious items during their initial search. title: Thailand moves birth records online to combat fake father schemes
desc: Thailand moves birth records online to combat fake father schemes Legacy More than 400 private hospitals across Thailand will be required to submit birth certification forms electronically from December 1, as part of a government crackdown on fake paternity declarations used to obtain Thai nationality for children. The Department of Health Service Support (DHSS) announced the nationwide change on November 4, saying the new system would replace paper submissions and make it easier to detect irregularities in birth records. The Department of Provincial Administration (DOPA) has developed an online platform at exservices.bora.dopa.go.th for hospitals to submit birth certification forms known as Tor Ror 1/1. Instead of sending the documents to registration offices on paper, private hospitals will submit them electronically. DHSS will be responsible for verifying and registering hospital staff authorised to use the system. title: Thai critic Pavin Chachavalpongpun criticises RTP after book ban
desc: Thai critic Pavin Chachavalpongpun criticises RTP after book ban Legacy Royal Thai Police (RTP) banned the import of the Routledge Handbook of Contemporary Thailand , an academic book edited by Pavin Chachavalpongpun , a critic of the Thai government who lives in Japan. The Royal Gazette website published the order on November 5. It was signed by RTP Commander Samran Nuanma on October 30 and applies to the book’s second edition. The order prohibits anyone from ordering or importing copies for distribution in Thailand. It states that articles in the book could affect national security, cause trouble or encourage unrest, and says their content is contrary to public order, national security and public morals. Photo via Royal Gazette The order cites Section 10 of the Printing Recordation Act 2007. It says anyone who violates the ban faces up to three years in prison, a fine of up to 60,000 baht, or both. It also authorises police to seize and destroy copies. The order took effect upon publication. Pavin is a professor at Kyoto University’s Centre for Southeast Asian Studies in Japan. The promotional 10% is then applied to the reduced amount. title: Bangkok’s Gen Z embraces late-night cycling through old town
desc: Bangkok’s Gen Z embraces late-night cycling through old town Legacy Bangkok’s public bike-sharing scheme recorded 171,492 trips in October , up about 60% from just over 107,000 in September, according to figures City Hall released yesterday, November 4. The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) credits much of the jump to Night Ride, a social media trend of late-night cycling around the old town on Rattanakosin Island . Aekvarunyoo Amrapala, an adviser to Bangkok Governor Chadchart Sittipunt, said the trend has caught on with Gen Z riders and tourists. He said they rent shared bikes through an app, with rides starting at 10 to 20 baht, and cycle past the lit-up landmarks of the historic quarter after dark. Photo via BMA He welcomed the growth in sightseeing by bike as it brings the city to life, and noted that usage had been climbing steadily before the latest jump. The scheme opened in January 2024 with about 1,700 trips a month, and the BMA now counts more than 719 docking points across 35 districts. title: 泰国电车协会提35%进口消费税呼吁推动产业升级
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，11月4日，泰国电动汽车协会（EVAT）名誉顾问、前会长吉萨达表示，协会支持调整进口电动汽车（EV）消费税结构，将税率设定为35%。这一税率与该协会此前联合另外9家合作协会向政府提出的建议一致。上述10家协会合计拥有超过1500家会员企业，旨在保护和提升泰国本土汽车产业。 他指出，此次调整税收结构的关键，并非单纯限制电动汽车进口，而应从国家发展战略的角度出发，着眼于提升泰国经济水平和国内生产总值（GDP）。提高进口电动汽车税率属于防御性措施，旨在保护已在泰国投资的企业，使其能够使用本地生产的零部件、创造就业岗位，并与进口整车后直接在泰国销售的企业展开竞争。 提高税率仅是防御性措施，接下来还需要采取主动措施，吸引投资并为泰国零部件制造商创造发展机会。当前的重要任务是制定积极的产业扶持政策，吸引外国汽车制造商赴泰投资并扩大产能，同时鼓励其采购泰国本土制造商生产的零部件，将这些零部件用于企业自身或其全球关联工厂的生产线。此外，还应支持未来汽车技术转让，包括自动驾驶系统和车联网技术。 对于此前讨论的税收结构，预计将划分为三个等级。其中，最低税率档面向在泰国本土生产的汽车制造商，适用2%的税率；最高税率档面向进口整车，税率为35%。至于中间档（Tier 2），其特殊税率及相关条件仍有待进一步明确，预计将与企业在泰投资、创造就业以及采购本土零部件等因素挂钩。 不过，汽车产业界希望政府尽快明确上述政策，以便制造商能够提前规划2027年及以后的电动汽车生产和销售，尤其需要明确相关条件，确保企业投资与技术转让同步推进，从而推动泰国汽车产业持续发展。 在消费者影响方面，预计从目前至今年年底，将成为计划购买进口电动汽车消费者提前购车的一个阶段。由于消费者已获悉明年将确定上调进口电动汽车税率，部分购车者可能因此提前作出购买决定。至于已经在泰国本土组装生产的电动汽车车型，预计受到的影响较小，甚至可能不会产生明显变化。 此前，泰国电动汽车协会联合另外9家合作协会向政府提交了8项发展战略，主要可归纳为以下三个方面： 一、鼓励实质性投资，提升本土附加值。 政府应设计相应的税收优惠政策，明确进口数量与在泰国投资之间的挂钩机制，同时对本土零部件使用比例（Local Content）进行核查，确保相关投资真正为泰国经济创造附加值。 此外，政府还应审慎考虑投资促进委员会（BOI）提供的投资优惠政策。对于泰国本身已具备足够发展能力的产业领域，可考虑限制投资促进优惠资格，以防止企业陷入价格竞争或出现倾销（Dumping）行为，进而损害泰国本土零部件制造商的利益。 但与泰国企业成立合资企业（Joint Venture），或与泰国企业开展合作且泰方持股比例不低于40%的情况，可作为例外。同时，还应加强对已获得投资促进优惠企业的后续监管。 二、推动泰国成为具有竞争力的汽车生产基

title: 泰国知名大学学生公寓坠亡 监控拍下事发前画面
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，11月4日，泰国巴吞他尼府空銮县警局接到报案，称当地一处公寓旁发生高处坠落死亡事件。事发地点位于空銮县空一镇，靠近当地一所知名大学。 接报后，空銮县警局调查人员拉差德赶赴现场，并会同调查部门副负责人查拉、治安部门负责人蒙提，以及第一警证中心工作人员、泰国法政大学诗丽吉王太后纪念医院值班医生、警方调查人员和救援基金会志愿者展开调查。 警方在公寓旁的混凝土路面上发现一具男性遗体，死者面部朝下。初步检查发现，死者身上没有携带身份证明文件。经查，死者现年23岁，来自素林府，是空銮县当地一所知名大学的大四学生，独自居住在事发公寓4楼的一间房间内。 警方随后调取公寓监控录像，还原事发经过。监控显示，事发当天，死者先从4楼住所走出，随后乘坐电梯前往7楼。当天上午9时40分左右，7楼走廊的监控拍到死者独自走到走廊窗边，长时间站立不动，随后从窗户跳下，最终身亡。 公寓维修人员表示，死者独自居住在公寓4楼。事发前一天，他还曾与死者正常交谈，完全没有想到会发生这样的悲剧。 目前，空銮县警局调查人员已对现场进行拍照取证，并收集相关证据，同时传唤有关人员及死者亲近人士接受进一步询问，以查明事件的真正原因。 死者遗体已交由救援基金会志愿者送往泰国法政大学诗丽吉王太后纪念医院法医研究所进行尸检。警方随后将联系死者家属，安排前来认领遗体并办理后续宗教仪式。 （编译：hansa；审校：wan；来源：matichon） The post 泰国知名大学学生公寓坠亡 监控拍下事发前画面 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Spain, Portugal, Tonga agree to visa exemptions for Thai officials
desc: Spain, Portugal, Tonga agree to visa exemptions for Thai officials Legacy Thailand has signed visa-waiver agreements with Spain, Portugal and Tonga that will allow holders of certain Thai government passports to travel without applying for visas. The agreements do not apply to ordinary Thai passport holders. Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow signed the agreements during diplomatic missions in October, as Thailand continued efforts to improve travel arrangements and expand international cooperation. The agreement with Spain, signed during Sihasak’s visit to Madrid, applies only to holders of Thai official passports. Portugal’s agreement, signed on October 23, covers both official and diplomatic passports. The exemptions are intended to make it easier for government representatives to travel for official duties, meetings and cooperation between government agencies. title: 中国籍通缉犯潜逃泰国，携毒偷渡入境被捕
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 近日，泰国移民局警方在廊开府逮捕一名中国籍男子，其涉嫌参与2026年6月发生在阿联酋迪拜的一起杀人案，被阿联酋警方通缉。警方在其偷渡入境时将其逮捕，同时查获5公斤依托咪酯，该物质在泰国被列为第二类精神药物，常被不法分子用于制作“僵尸烟弹”“快乐水”等毒品。 11月4日，泰国移民局局长纳蓬辛及移民局第四分局局长听取廊开府移民警察工作汇报。据调查，10月6日，廊开府移民警察联合边境巡逻部队在廊开府蓬披赛县湄公河沿河展开行动，抓获中国籍男子Wan某。 当时，Wan某乘坐长尾船。试图从老挝横渡湄公河进入泰国，随身携带一个装有5公斤白色粉末的行李袋。经检查后确认，相关物质为依托咪酯。随后，警方以未经许可非法入境以及未经许可非法持有第二类精神药物等罪名对其提出指控。 进一步调查发现，Wan某曾涉嫌参与2026年6月在阿联酋迪拜发生的一起杀人案，被阿联酋警方正式通缉。警方追查其出入境记录后发现，Wan某曾辗转泰国、老挝、迪拜、柬埔寨及越南等多个国家和地区，之后长期居住在老挝，此次试图通过湄公河自然通道偷渡进入泰国。 警方怀疑，Wan某此次潜入泰国可能是为了躲避追查，寻找新的藏身之处。目前，泰国警方已依法对其进行处理，并计划将其移交至案件来源国，以接受后续法律程序。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：mgronline） The post 中国籍通缉犯潜逃泰国，携毒偷渡入境被捕 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

desc_original: ประชุมบอร์ดกสทช. 2 นัดซ้อน บรรยากาศ 6 กรรมการคึก หลังเสนอ ครม. ไฟเขียว พล.ต.อ.ณัฐธร นำคณะร่วมประชุมไอทียูที่โดฮาแทน นพ.สรณ ด้าน พล.อ.ท.ธนพันธุ์ เผยเตรียมพิจารณาไทยคม 4 ขอหยุดบริการ 5 พ.ย.

title_cn: O'oishi 推出「荔枝扭转」5 款新品，分渠道销售瞄准 Gen Z，目标触达 100 万试饮人次
summary_cn: O'oishi 绿茶推出「荔枝扭转」系列 5 款新口味饮品，产品按不同零售渠道分别销售。公司通过 TikTok 社交媒体和遍布全国 100 多个试饮点的体验活动，精准锁定 Gen Z 年轻消费者族群。此举展现了品牌在数字营销和消费者体验创新上的投入，目标为 100 万消费者创造品尝机会，进一步拓展市场份额。

title: TAT targets European market to boost tourism revenue by 5-7% next year
desc: Amid the Middle East conflict, the Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) is focusing on tailoring products to individual European markets to lift tourism revenue by 5-7% next year, as the agency and Thai operators participate in this week's World Travel Market (WTM) trade show.
title_cn: 泰国旅游局瞄准欧洲市场，目标明年旅游收入增长 5-7%
summary_cn: 受中东冲突影响，泰国旅游局（TAT）调整战略重心转向欧洲市场。该机构计划针对欧洲各国市场的差异化特征定制旅游产品和服务，期望实现明年旅游收入 5-7% 的增长目标。泰旅局及当地旅游运营商正参加世界旅游市场（World Travel Market）展览，向国际游客和行业合作伙伴推介新的欧洲市场产品组合和营销策略。
desc_original: Amid the Middle East conflict, the Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) is focusing on tailoring products to individual European markets to lift tourism revenue by 5-7% next year, as the agency and Thai operators participate in this week's World Travel Market (WTM) trade show.

title: แมคไทย จับมือชาตรามือ ส่ง 3 เมนูชาไทยลงตลาด ชิงใจผู้บริโภคสายหวาน
desc: แมคโดนัลด์ จับมือ ชาตรามือ นำชาไทยต้นตำรับพัฒนา 3 เมนูใหม่ ทั้งพายชาไทยคัสตาร์ด แมคเฟลอร์รีชาไทย และปาท่องโก๋ดิปชาไทย เดินหน้ากลยุทธ์ Localization เจาะรสนิยมผู้บริโภคไทย เริ่มต้น 35 บาท
title_cn: 麦当劳泰国与「茶铁手」合作，推出 3 款泰式茶创意新品
summary_cn: 麦当劳泰国与知名茶饮品牌「茶铁手」展开跨界合作，推出融合传统泰式茶风味的 3 款创意新品，包括泰茶蛋挞派、泰茶麦卡弗罗里及泰茶炸油条蘸酱。这一举措属于「本地化」战略的重要组成部分，旨在深度满足泰国本地消费者对传统风味与现代甜品组合的需求。新品价格从 35 泰铢起，竞争力十足。

title: Sensors to monitor temperatures near two coral reefs
desc: Sirinat National Park has installed underwater temperature loggers at two coral reef sites in Phuket to monitor rising sea temperatures and provide early warnings of potential coral bleaching.
title_cn: 普吉岛国家公园部署水下温度传感器监测珊瑚礁水温
summary_cn: 普吉岛西瑞那特国家公园（Sirinat National Park）在两处重要珊瑚礁区域部署了先进的水下温度监测设备。该举措旨在实时追踪海水温度变化，及时发现水温异常上升的警报信号，为珊瑚白化灾害提供提前预警机制。此举充分体现了泰国对海洋生态保护的承诺，也是维护普吉岛旅游资源和海洋生物多样性的重要举措。
desc_original: Sirinat National Park has installed underwater temperature loggers at two coral reef sites in Phuket to monitor rising sea temperatures and provide early warnings of potential coral bleaching.

title: จตุภัทร์ นำ TOA คว้า 2 รางวัลใหญ่ SET Awards 2026
desc: TOA คว้า 2 รางวัลใหญ่ SET Awards 2026 “จตุภัทร์ ตั้งคารวคุณ” รับ Outstanding CEO Awards พร้อมรางวัล Best Company Performance Awards ตอกย้ำผลงานบริหารองค์กรโดดเด่นในตลาดทุนไทย
title_cn: TOA 公司获 2026 年 SET Awards 两大奖项，CEO 获杰出领导人奖
summary_cn: TOA 公司在 2026 年泰国证券交易所（SET）颁发的年度大奖中获得两项重要奖项，成为行业内的佼佼者。董事长兼首席执行官 Chatuphat Tukarsukawattana 获得「杰出首席执行官奖」，公司本身获得「最佳企业业绩奖」。这两项荣誉充分证明了 TOA 在上市公司治理制度、经营管理能力和财务业绩表现上的卓越成就。
desc_original: TOA คว้า 2 รางวัลใหญ่ SET Awards 2026 “จตุภัทร์ ตั้งคารวคุณ” รับ Outstanding CEO Awards พร้อมรางวัล Best Company Performance Awards ตอกย้ำผลงานบริหารองค์กรโดดเด่นในตลาดทุนไทย

title: PTT targets transformation into a major LNG player
desc: National oil and gas conglomerate PTT Plc is pressing ahead with plans to become a leading global liquefied natural gas (LNG) trader despite growing uncertainty in energy markets caused by geopolitical conflicts, says president and chief executive Kongkrapan Intarajang.
title_cn: PTT石油公司力争成为全球液化天然气交易巨头
summary_cn: 泰国国家油气集团PTT公司董事长兼首席执行官肯格拉潘·因塔叻表示，尽管地缘政治冲突导致能源市场不确定性增加，公司仍在加紧推进成为全球领先液化天然气(LNG)贸易商的计划。这一战略转型将有助于PTT在国际能源市场中获得更大的竞争力。
desc_original: National oil and gas conglomerate PTT Plc is pressing ahead with plans to become a leading global liquefied natural gas (LNG) trader despite growing uncertainty in energy markets caused by geopolitical conflicts, says president and chief executive Kongkrapan Intarajang.

title: Ekniti promotes green transport outlays
desc: The government is preparing to use the remaining 100 billion baht under the 400-billion-baht emergency loan decree to support the energy transition in the transport sector.
title_cn: 泰国政府推进绿色运输能源转型投资
summary_cn: 泰国政府计划利用「紧急贷款法令」下剩余的100亿泰铢(该法令总额400亿泰铢)，用于支持交通运输领域的能源转型。这一举措旨在通过大规模绿色运输项目投资，推动国家低碳发展战略，改善公共交通基础设施。
desc_original: The government is preparing to use the remaining 100 billion baht under the 400-billion-baht emergency loan decree to support the energy transition in the transport sector.

title: Belgium seeks closer ties
desc: Belgium has called for closer cooperation with Thailand in trade, parliamentary affairs and maritime development, citing shared interests and opportunities for collaboration.
title_cn: 比利时寻求与泰国加强合作关系
summary_cn: 比利时政府表示希望与泰国在贸易、议会事务和海事开发等领域加强合作，双方看好共同利益和合作机遇。此举反映出两国在多个领域加深关系的意愿，致力于促进互利共赢的长期合作框架。
desc_original: Belgium has called for closer cooperation with Thailand in trade, parliamentary affairs and maritime development, citing shared interests and opportunities for collaboration.

title: Automatic passport control extended to 33 countries
desc: Thailand has expanded access to automated passport control to travellers from 33 countries and territories to speed up immigration processing, reduce queues and ease congestion at airports.
title_cn: 泰国自动护照检查系统扩至33个国家和地区
summary_cn: 泰国扩大了自动护照控制系统的使用范围，现已覆盖33个国家和地区的旅客。该措施旨在加快移民处理速度、减少排队等候、缓解机场拥堵。这一升级将为国际游客提供更便捷的入境体验，进一步完善泰国机场的通关效率。
desc_original: Thailand has expanded access to automated passport control to travellers from 33 countries and territories to speed up immigration processing, reduce queues and ease congestion at airports.

title: Damaged runway to be repaired by Friday: airport
desc: Suvarnabhumi airport expects to complete repairs to damaged taxiway E21 by Friday following an Emirates A380 incident.
title_cn: 苏万那普机场受损滑行道将于周五前修复完成
summary_cn: 苏万那普机场宣布将在周五前完成E21滑行道的维修工作，该滑行道因一架阿联酋航空A380客机事故受损。机场正全力推进维修进程，以恢复正常运营能力。这次事故和维修对机场及国际航线可能产生暂时性影响。
desc_original: Suvarnabhumi airport expects to complete repairs to damaged taxiway E21 by Friday following an Emirates A380 incident.

title: Sihasak to urge curbs to violence on trip
desc: Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Affairs Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow will visit Myanmar on Nov 12 to urge a reduction in violence, prevent conflict from spilling across the border and assess the country's readiness to re-engage with Asean.
title_cn: 西哈萨克赴缅甸敦促减少暴力冲突
summary_cn: 泰国副总理兼外交部长西哈萨克·普昂基克将于11月12日访问缅甸，敦促该国减少暴力事件，防止战事蔓延至泰缅边界，并评估缅甸重新融入东盟的准备程度。
desc_original: Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Affairs Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow will visit Myanmar on Nov 12 to urge a reduction in violence, prevent conflict from spilling across the border and assess the country's readiness to re-engage with Asean.

title: 'No need' to stockpile food
desc: The National Security Council (NSC) has urged the public not to panic or stockpile food, saying domestic supplies remain sufficient despite rising global tensions.
title_cn: 国安委呼吁勿囤积食品
summary_cn: 泰国国家安全委员会敦促民众不要惊慌失措或囤积食品，强调尽管全球局势紧张，泰国国内粮食供应仍然充足。
desc_original: The National Security Council (NSC) has urged the public not to panic or stockpile food, saying domestic supplies remain sufficient despite rising global tensions.

title: Pattaya tourism lags as flight costs jump up to 40%, group warns
desc: Pattaya tourism lags as flight costs jump up to 40%, group warns Legacy Pattaya tourism is slowing because airfares to Thailand have risen by 30% to 40% , the President of the Chon Buri Tourism Federation, Thanet Supornsahasrungsi, said yesterday, November 4. He warned that operators in Pattaya and the wider province still see no clear high-season bookings, which normally start arriving months ahead. Thanet blamed the higher fares on the conflict between the United States and Iran . He said it had pushed up fuel prices and airline operating costs, and that the extra cost was now influencing whether foreign tourists choose to travel to Thailand. He said European travellers had been hit hardest, because many of them reach Thailand on Middle Eastern airlines whose connecting fares had been about 20% to 30% cheaper than direct flights. Restrictions on travel through that region had raised their costs, and some of them had postponed their trips. President of the Chon Buri Tourism Federation, Thanet Supornsahasrungsi | Photo via Siam Rath Thanet told reporters that operators usually get a picture of advance bookings two to three months ahead. title: Chinese tourist rescued after canoe capsizes off Phuket coast
desc: Chinese tourist rescued after canoe capsizes off Phuket coast Legacy A Chinese tourist who could not swim was left clinging to her overturned canoe after it capsized off Phuket on November 3. A passing fishing boat spotted her and brought her safely back to shore. The incident occurred at around 5.40pm near the southern end of Koh Man, off Rawai subdistrict, Mueang Phuket district. The tourist, believed to be in her 20s, had reportedly paddled out from Ya Nui Beach before waves overturned her canoe and carried her further away from the shore. According to people involved in the rescue, the woman was unable to swim and initially held on to the canoe to stay afloat. She eventually managed to climb onto the overturned vessel, where she waited for someone to notice her. A fishing boat returning from the Koh Man area spotted the woman sitting on top of the canoe and waving her paddle while shouting for help. Photo via Komchadluek The crew approached the canoe and helped her aboard their boat before taking her safely back to shore. title: Amlo orders tighter checks
desc: The Anti-Money Laundering Office (Amlo) has ordered licensed digital-asset businesses to strengthen transaction monitoring to prevent their services from being used for money laundering.
title_cn: 反洗钱办加强数字资产监管
summary_cn: 泰国反洗钱办公室要求所有获许可的数字资产企业加强交易监控机制，防止其平台被用于洗钱活动。
desc_original: The Anti-Money Laundering Office (Amlo) has ordered licensed digital-asset businesses to strengthen transaction monitoring to prevent their services from being used for money laundering.

title: Court say in Senate cases faces test
desc: The Election Commission (EC) has voted 5-2 to seek a Constitutional Court ruling on whether the Supreme Court has the authority to examine Senate candidates' qualifications and review EC decisions.
title_cn: 选举委员会寻求宪法法院裁定参议院权力争议
summary_cn: 泰国选举委员会投票5票对2票要求宪法法院作出裁决，明确最高法院（Supreme Court）是否有权审查参议院候选人的资格条件，以及是否可以推翻选举委员会的相关决定。此案涉及司法权力分配和参议院组建程序的关键问题，将直接影响参议院的构成和政治权力格局。
desc_original: The Election Commission (EC) has voted 5-2 to seek a Constitutional Court ruling on whether the Supreme Court has the authority to examine Senate candidates' qualifications and review EC decisions.

title: Speaker defends new House rules
desc: House Speaker Sophon Zarum has denied claims that new regulations governing the work of 35 standing parliamentary committees are intended to strip committee chairmen of their authority or silence the opposition.
title_cn: 众议院议长辩护议会新规则
summary_cn: 泰国众议院议长Sophon Zarum为新颁布的议会规则进行公开辩护。新规涉及35个常设议会委员会的工作规程调整。议长否认了外界关于新规旨在削弱委员会主席权力或压制议会反对派声音的指控，强调改革的目的是完善议会运作机制。此举在政治圈引发权力制衡问题的讨论。
desc_original: House Speaker Sophon Zarum has denied claims that new regulations governing the work of 35 standing parliamentary committees are intended to strip committee chairmen of their authority or silence the opposition.

title: คนร้ายดักซุ่มยิง "จ.ส.อ.อัมพล" ทหารพราน ฉก.ทพ.48 เสียชีวิต ขณะลาพักมาเยี่ยมภรรยา
desc: นราธิวาสเดือด คนร้ายดักซุ่มลอบยิง "จ.ส.อ.อัมพล เยาว์ดำ" ทหารพราน ฉก.ทพ.48 เสียชีวิตคาที่ ขณะลาพักมาเยี่ยมภรรยา เจ้าหน้าที่เร่งปิดล้อมพื้นที่ล่าตัวผู้ก่อเหตุ
title_cn: 南部边防军人遭伏击枪杀
summary_cn: 泰国南部发生严重暴力事件。名为Ampon Yeawdam的边防巡逻队军人在休假期间返家探望妻子时，遭不明武装人员伏击并被枪杀身亡。死者属于泰国边防部队48区。事件发生在纳拉提瓦府（Narathiwat），该地区长期面临安全威胁。当地军警部队已启动追捕行动，试图围捕嫌疑人。此事件反映泰国南部边境地区局势仍很紧张。
desc_original: นราธิวาสเดือด คนร้ายดักซุ่มลอบยิง "จ.ส.อ.อัมพล เยาว์ดำ" ทหารพราน ฉก.ทพ.48 เสียชีวิตคาที่ ขณะลาพักมาเยี่ยมภรรยา เจ้าหน้าที่เร่งปิดล้อมพื้นที่ล่าตัวผู้ก่อเหตุ

title: S&P affirms Thailand’s BBB+ credit rating
desc: S&P Global Ratings has affirmed Thailand’s sovereign credit rating at BBB+ with a stable outlook, the Ministry of Finance said on Wednesday.
title_cn: 标普维持泰国主权信用评级在BBB+级别
summary_cn: 国际评级机构标普全球评级（S&P Global Ratings）已确认泰国主权信用评级维持在BBB+级别，展望评级保持稳定。泰国财政部对外公布了此项裁决。BBB+评级反映泰国具有良好的偿债能力和经济基本面稳定性。评级稳定展望有利于泰国在国际资本市场上的融资成本和投资吸引力，也为泰国的经济政策制定提供了积极信号。
desc_original: S&P Global Ratings has affirmed Thailand’s sovereign credit rating at BBB+ with a stable outlook, the Ministry of Finance said on Wednesday.

title: Panadda foundation probe nearly complete, police say
desc: Police have frozen 17 bank accounts containing about 60 million baht belonging to people linked to Panadda Wongphudee and her husband, as the investigation into the operations of the Goodness Foundation, chaired by the former Miss Thailand, gathers momentum.
title_cn: 潘纳达基金会调查即将完成 警方已冻结6000万泰铢资产
summary_cn: 泰国警方宣布对慈善机构「善良基金会」的调查近期完成。警方已冻结17个银行账户，资金总额约6000万泰铢，这些账户与该基金会主席潘纳达·翁布迪（前泰国环球小姐）及其丈夫有关。该案涉及资金流转和合规性调查。
desc_original: Police have frozen 17 bank accounts containing about 60 million baht belonging to people linked to Panadda Wongphudee and her husband, as the investigation into the operations of the Goodness Foundation, chaired by the former Miss Thailand, gathers momentum.

title: China has warrants out for 5 Uyghurs, Thailand says
desc: Five Uyghurs detained in Thailand since 2014 are subject to Chinese arrest warrants, the kingdom’s security chief said on Wednesday, adding that a court would decide if they would be returned to China.
title_cn: 泰国证实中国对被滞留泰国的5名维吾尔人发出逮捕令
summary_cn: 泰国安全部门负责人宣布，中国已对自2014年起被关押在泰国的5名维吾尔人发出逮捕令。泰国法院将决定这些人是否被遣返中国。此事涉及国际法律、人权和外交协议，反映了泰国面临的复杂国际政治处境。
desc_original: Five Uyghurs detained in Thailand since 2014 are subject to Chinese arrest warrants, the kingdom’s security chief said on Wednesday, adding that a court would decide if they would be returned to China.

title: Thai foreign minister criticises China’s travel warning for misplacing blame for scam
desc: Thai foreign minister criticises China’s travel warning for misplacing blame for scam Legacy Thailand’s Foreign Affairs Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow raised concerns with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi in Beijing yesterday, November 3, that a travel warning issued by the Chinese embassy had caused panic and affected Thailand’s tourism image. Sihasak was in Beijing for the 11th Mekong-Lancang Cooperation Meeting, and seized this chance to meet Wang Yi to discuss further trade, transnational crime , and regional issues. On trade, Sihasak said he urged China to open its market to Thai products, particularly rice. He said China had promised to import 500,000 tonnes of rice from Thailand. The ministers also discussed investment that could add value to Thailand’s manufacturing industry, including technology transfer, joint technology development and cooperation on workforce development. title: Complaints on Udon Thani expo mount over garden displays, site services, and value for money
desc: Complaints on Udon Thani expo mount over garden displays, site services, and value for money Legacy The Udon Thani World Horticultural Expo , which opened on November 1, faced criticism over value for money, botanical accuracy, management and readiness. Udon Thani is hosting the world horticultural expo for the first time. The event was previously held twice in Chiang Mai. The government expected it to attract more than 3.6 million visitors and generate over 20 billion baht for Thailand, following an investment of more than 2.5 billion baht. Thailand’s Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul joined several senior politicians at the opening ceremony on November 1. The expo’s reported highlights include 32 international gardens representing 17 countries, 16 gardens created by public- and private-sector organisations, more than 50 gardens featuring rare plant species, and over 1 million colourful flowers. Photo via Facebook/ พืชสวนโลกอุดรธานี 2569 Udon Thani Expo 2026 The event also includes academic exhibition halls, a riverside market with 50 stalls and architecture inspired by Isan style. title: Phuket launches new EV bus route from airport to Rawai
desc: Phuket launches new EV bus route from airport to Rawai Legacy Phuket has launched a new electric bus service connecting Phuket International Airport with Rawai, offering residents and tourists another public transport option with fares starting at 40 baht . The service was officially introduced on November 2 by the Phuket Provincial Administrative Organisation (PPAO), with 10 air-conditioned electric buses operating along Route 8580. The route runs from Phuket International Airport along Chaloem Phra Kiat Rama IX Road to Ban Rawai, providing a new connection between the airport and the southern part of the island. Students, religious practitioners, people with disabilities and elderly passengers are eligible for free travel, while regular fares start at 40 baht. Photo via Phuket Provincial Administrative Organisation Phuket Governor Chotnarin Kerdsom presided over the November 2 launch, attended by PPAO President Rewat Areerob, provincial officials, community leaders and residents. Rewat said the PPAO was prioritising public transport improvements to ease traffic congestion and make travel more convenient for residents and tourists. title: Blue by Alain Ducasse unveils its Autumn 2026 Menu by Chef Evens López
desc: Blue by Alain Ducasse unveils its Autumn 2026 Menu by Chef Evens López Legacy Blue by Alain Ducasse has unveiled its Autumn 2026 Menu , a seasonal set of tasting menus created by Executive Chef Evens López. The menu is served at both lunch and dinner at the Michelin-starred restaurant at ICONSIAM. Chef Evens built the menu around produce sourced from France, Thailand and beyond, pairing classical French technique with ingredients at the peak of their season. title: Koh Chang bridge could charge motorists 340 baht each way from 2035
desc: Koh Chang bridge could charge motorists 340 baht each way from 2035 Legacy Motorists could pay 340 baht each way to use the proposed Koh Chang bridge in Trat when it opens in 2035, according to preliminary toll rates released by the Expressway Authority of Thailand (EXAT). The proposed charges, presented as part of a feasibility study yesterday, November 3, would also see motorcyclists pay 90 baht per trip. The rates have not yet received final approval. Under the proposal, pedestrians would cross free of charge, while four-wheel vehicles would pay 340 baht each way, or 680 baht for a return journey. Vehicles with six to 10 wheels would pay 680 baht per trip, while those with more than 10 wheels would be charged 1,020 baht. EXAT plans to introduce a flat-rate toll system, with payments collected at a toll plaza on the Laem Ngop side of the crossing. Both cash and electronic payments would be accepted. The planned bridge would stretch 5.90 kilometres from Khlong Yai subdistrict in Laem Ngop district to Koh Chang subdistrict in Koh Chang district. title: 泰航回应航班返航事件！TG663驾驶舱挡风玻璃开裂，受影响旅客获安排转乘
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月4日，泰国国际航空（下文简称：泰航）发布声明，就TG663上海飞往曼谷航班因驾驶舱挡风玻璃出现裂痕返回上海浦东国际机场降落一事作出说明。 泰航表示，涉事航班于当地时间11月4日8时08分从上海起飞。飞行过程中，机组人员发现驾驶舱左侧挡风玻璃出现裂痕。出于安全考虑，机长决定按照安全程序将飞机返航，并降落在出发地上海浦东国际机场。此次事件未造成人员受伤。 针对此次事件，泰航已为受影响的乘客及机组人员安排住宿，并与合作航空公司协调，协助旅客转乘其他航班。 此外，为妥善安排旅客出行，泰航决定调整11月5日TG662及TG663航班的机型，改用载客量更大的飞机，以便接载转乘旅客，为旅客后续行程提供便利。 泰航强调，乘客及机组人员的安全始终是公司的首要任务，并对此次事件给旅客带来的不便表示歉意。 （编辑：Wan；来源：泰国国际航空公司） The post 泰航回应航班返航事件！TG663驾驶舱挡风玻璃开裂，受影响旅客获安排转乘 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Chinese man arrested for overstay, drug use in Chiang Mai
desc: Chinese man arrested for overstay, drug use in Chiang Mai Legacy Tourist police arrested a Chinese man at a hotel in Chiang Mai yesterday, November 3, after discovering he had overstayed his permission to remain in Thailand and testing positive for drug use . The man, identified as 40 year old Chung, was arrested at around 2.40pm at a hotel in Suthep subdistrict, Mueang Chiang Mai district, following a tip-off about a foreign guest suspected of using drugs. Officers visited the hotel with a staff member and knocked on Chung’s room door to check his documents. Photo via Facebook: Thaipolice His passport showed that he had entered Thailand on September 17 with permission to stay until October 16. Police said he had not applied for an extension and had overstayed by 17 days. During the inspection, officers noticed what appeared to be drug paraphernalia on a table inside his room. Police identified it as a bent glass tube with black burn marks. Chung told officers he had brought it from a house in San Kamphaeng district. Photo via Facebook: Thaipolice He was taken to Chiang Mai Tourist Police Station, where officers conducted a urine test that returned a positive result for drugs

title: 泰国移民局升级出入境管控，严打假泰籍身份犯罪
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月4日，泰国移民局宣布全面升级出入境管理措施，一方面联合地方行政厅打击利用虚假出生登记为外国儿童非法获取泰国国籍的犯罪网络，另一方面加强18岁以下泰国籍未成年人的出境审查，同时严查跨国犯罪人员及毒品走私。此外，泰国还将自动护照查验通道的适用范围扩大至33个国家和地区，以兼顾国家安全、旅客权益及通关效率。 近日，泰国移民局与内政部地方行政厅联合开展追捕假泰籍父亲网络专项行动，成功侦破两起涉嫌利用泰国籍男子冒充外国儿童生父、通过虚假出生登记非法获取泰国国籍的案件，多名涉案人员落网。 第一起案件发生于10月25日。素万那普机场移民警察发现，一名40岁的泰国男子拉塔蓬与一名26岁的中国籍女子及其8个月大的男婴一同出行。由于男婴登记为泰国籍，但两名成年人无法清楚说明家庭关系，引起警方怀疑。 经调查，警方发现孩子的亲生父亲实际上是一名32岁的中国籍男子，从事内容创作者相关行业，因涉嫌诈骗被中国警方通缉。据调查，该男子涉嫌以中介身份谎称能够帮助儿童进入学校，实施诈骗。警方怀疑，该男子与孩子母亲安排在泰国生育，再由泰国籍男子冒充生父，为孩子取得泰国国籍。10月31日，警方取得芭堤雅法院逮捕令，随后将三名涉案人员全部抓获。 第二起案件发生于10月27日。素万那普机场移民警察发现，一名31岁的中国籍女子准备带着2岁儿子出境。调查发现，孩子持有两份内容不同的出生证明：一份登记为泰国籍，父亲为26岁的泰国男子查达蒙；另一份则登记为外国籍，父亲为32岁的中国籍男子。 警方调查确认，泰国籍男子查达蒙并非孩子的亲生父亲，相关案件还涉及整份伪造的医院出生证明文件。警方随后向曼谷南部刑事法院申请逮捕令，追查包括孩子亲生父亲、母亲、冒名父亲及相关人员在内的4名涉案人员。 进一步调查发现，该中国籍男子已被中国警方通缉，涉嫌涉及银行账户及洗钱犯罪，相关案件牵涉133个银行账户，经济损失约5亿元人民币，折合约25亿泰铢。 此外，泰国地方行政厅已成立委员会，对负责办理相关出生登记的东北部地方官员暂时停职并展开严重纪律调查。 针对上述犯罪网络，泰国移民局进一步升级未成年人出境审查措施，重点核实18岁以下泰国籍儿童与同行人员之间的亲属关系，防范人口贩运、跨国绑架及利用虚假父亲身份非法取得泰国国籍等行为。 泰国移民局局长纳蓬辛表示，2026年7月至10月期间，移民局共对120名出境泰国籍儿童进行筛查，其中32人因相关文件及中国籍母亲、泰国籍父亲的陈述存在可疑情况，被怀疑可能涉及“假泰籍父亲”犯罪网络，因此遭到拒绝出境。随后，警方根据相关线索对涉案人员进行了进一步调查及逮捕。 根据规定，未满18岁的泰国籍儿童出境时，须准备有效护照及出生证明。出生证明可使用原件、复印件或电子照片，并根据同行人员身份提供相应补充文件： 与父亲或母亲其中一方出行：须提供另一方由政府机构出具的同意书；如父母未登
title_cn: 泰国移民局升级管控严打「假泰籍父亲」犯罪网络
summary_cn: 泰国移民局11月4日宣布升级出入境管理措施，重点打击利用虚假出生登记为外国儿童非法获取泰国国籍的犯罪。近期侦破两起案件，涉及中国籍人员冒充儿童亲生父亲。移民局加强18岁以下泰国籍未成年人出境审查，防范人口贩运与跨国绑架。此外，扩大自动护照查验通道至33个国家和地区，兼顾国家安全与通关效率。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 11月4日，泰国移民局宣布全面升级出入境管理措施，一方面联合地方行政厅打击利用虚假出生登记为外国儿童非法获取泰国国籍的犯罪网络，另一方面加强18岁以下泰国籍未成年人的出境审查，同时严查跨国犯罪人员及毒品走私。此外，泰国还将自动护照查验通道的适用范围扩大至33个国家和地区，以兼顾国家安全、旅客权益及通关效率。 近日，泰国移民局与内政部地方行政厅联合开展追捕假泰籍父亲网络专项行动，成功侦破两起涉嫌利用泰国籍男子冒充外国儿童生父、通过虚假出生登记非法获取泰国国籍的案件，多名涉案人员落网。 第一起案件发生于10月25日。素万那普机场移民警察发现，一名40岁的泰国男子拉塔蓬与一名26岁的中国籍女子及其8个月大的男婴一同出行。由于男婴登记为泰国籍，但两名成年人无法清楚说明家庭关系，引起警方怀疑。 经调查，警方发现孩子的亲生父亲实际上是一名32岁的中国籍男子，从事内容创作者相关行业，因涉嫌诈骗被中国警方通缉。据调查，该男子涉嫌以中介身份谎称能够帮助儿童进入学校，实施诈骗。警方怀疑，该男子与孩子母亲安排在泰国生育，再由泰国籍男子冒充生父，为孩子取得泰国国籍。10月31日，警方取得芭堤雅法院逮捕令，随后将三名涉案人员全部抓获。 第二起案件发生于10月27日。素万那普机场移民警察发现，一名31岁的中国籍女子准备带着2岁儿子出境。调查发现，孩子持有两份内容不同的出生证明：一份登记为泰国籍，父亲为26岁的泰国男子查达蒙；另一份则登记为外国籍，父亲为32岁的中国籍男子。 警方调查确认，泰国籍男子查达蒙并非孩子的亲生父亲，相关案件还涉及整份伪造的医院出生证明文件。警方随后向曼谷南部刑事法院申请逮捕令，追查包括孩子亲生父亲、母亲、冒名父亲及相关人员在内的4名涉案人员。 进一步调查发现，该中国籍男子已被中国警方通缉，涉嫌涉及银行账户及洗钱犯罪，相关案件牵涉133个银行账户，经济损失约5亿元人民币，折合约25亿泰铢。 此外，泰国地方行政厅已成立委员会，对负责办理相关出生登记的东北部地方官员暂时停职并展开严重纪律调查。 针对上述犯罪网络，泰国移民局进一步升级未成年人出境审查措施，重点核实18岁以下泰国籍儿童与同行人员之间的亲属关系，防范人口贩运、跨国绑架及利用虚假父亲身份非法取得泰国国籍等行为。 泰国移民局局长纳蓬辛表示，2026年7月至10月期间，移民局共对120名出境泰国籍儿童进行筛查，其中32人因相关文件及中国籍母亲、泰国籍父亲的陈述存在可疑情况，被怀疑可能涉及“假泰籍父亲”犯罪网络，因此遭到拒绝出境。随后，警方根据相关线索对涉案人员进行了进一步调查及逮捕。 根据规定，未满18岁的泰国籍儿童出境时，须准备有效护照及出生证明。出生证明可使用原件、复印件或电子照片，并根据同行人员身份提供相应补充文件： 与父亲或母亲其中一方出行：须提供另一方由政府机构出具的同意书；如父母未登

title: 泰国男星Blue回应与Lisa恋情传闻：因朋友圈相识，坦言单身“可追求”
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，近日，泰国男演员Blue Pongtiwat出席电视剧《再婚皇后》发布活动，现场接受媒体采访时谈及个人感情状况，回应外界广泛关注的与Lisa恋情传闻。 针对与Lisa关系密切的传闻，Blue表示，两人之所以熟悉，主要是因为拥有共同的朋友圈，属于同一个朋友群体。他坦言，对于外界关注两人的关系并没有感到压力。 谈及目前的感情状态，Blue表示自己仍处于单身，并大方表示“可以追求”。当记者询问他的感情生活是否已经进入粉红色阶段时，他幽默回应称，自己的心是“蓝色”的，因为粉丝昵称是“Blue Da”。 此外，Blue透露，目前与Lisa之间仅有泰国旅游局相关的合作项目，并没有其他双人合作计划。对于网传自己出演Lisa歌曲MV的消息，他明确否认，强调出演者并不是自己。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：matichon） The post 泰国男星Blue回应与Lisa恋情传闻：因朋友圈相识，坦言单身“可追求” appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 泰国猴痘累计确诊470例、3人死亡，疾控厅提醒警惕异常皮疹
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，近日，泰国疾病控制厅公布，截至2026年10月31日，全国猴痘累计确诊470例，死亡3例。卫生部门提醒公众留意发热、皮疹、水疱及异常伤口等症状，尤其是近期有高风险接触史者，应尽快就医检查，避免延误诊断并增加病毒传播风险。 泰国疾病控制厅厅长蒙提表示，猴痘目前仍在全球多个地区传播。根据世界卫生组织2026年9月14日公布的数据，2025年1月1日至2026年8月31日期间，全球107个国家和地区累计报告猴痘确诊病例68096例，死亡272例。泰国病例数据则统计至2026年10月31日。 猴痘初期症状通常包括发热、头痛、背痛、肌肉疼痛及淋巴结肿大，随后可能出现皮疹、水疱或脓疱，分布于身体、面部、生殖器及肛门周围。部分患者的皮损数量较少，也可能伴随肛门疼痛。 由于猴痘皮损可能与生殖器疱疹、水痘及其他皮肤感染相似，不能仅凭皮疹外观或照片判断是否感染。确诊主要依靠PCR检测皮损样本中的病毒遗传物质，普通血液检查不能作为确诊依据。如症状持续、皮疹增加，即使首次检测结果为阴性，也应再次就医，由医生评估是否需要进一步检查。 疾病控制厅表示，大多数患者通过对症治疗即可康复，包括缓解疼痛、护理伤口及预防并发症等。但免疫功能低下者、孕妇及幼儿属于并发症风险较高的人群，需要接受密切医疗评估。如出现严重疼痛、无法正常进食或饮水、眼部皮损或病情恶化，应立即就医。患者是否需要住院，则由医生根据病情及居家隔离条件决定。 在预防方面，公众应避免直接接触患者皮肤及皮损，不与疑似患者进行密切身体接触或性接触，也不要共用衣物、毛巾及床上用品。出现疑似症状或正在等待检测结果的人士，应主动与他人保持距离，遮盖皮损，勤用肥皂或70%酒精清洁双手，佩戴贴合面部的口罩。确诊患者应遵医嘱进行隔离，避免外出，单独使用个人物品，直至所有皮损结痂脱落、新皮肤完全长出且黏膜部位皮损痊愈。 泰国疾病控制厅呼吁公众提高警惕，如出现发热、皮疹、水疱或异常伤口，特别是有高风险接触史者，应尽快就医并如实告知医生相关情况。卫生部门同时呼吁社会避免歧视或污名化患者，尊重个人隐私。如需咨询，可拨打泰国疾病控制厅热线1422。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：pptvhd36） The post 泰国猴痘累计确诊470例、3人死亡，疾控厅提醒警惕异常皮疹 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 王毅会见泰国副总理兼外长西哈萨
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 2026年11月3日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京会见来华工作访问并出席澜湄合作第十一次外长会的泰国副总理兼外长西哈萨。 王毅表示，近年来，习近平主席同哇集拉隆功国王保持密切沟通，共同引领中泰命运共同体建设走深走实，“中泰一家亲”更加深入人心。两国始终相互理解，相互信任，相互支持，不断为传统友好注入新的时代内涵。中方赞赏阿努廷总理领导的泰国新政府坚定奉行对华友好政策，这完全符合泰国的根本长远利益，也有利于维护本地区的和平稳定。中方愿与泰方加强战略沟通，深化互利合作，推动中泰命运共同体建设不断迈上新水平。 王毅表示，中方愿同泰方筹备好下阶段高层交往，为两国关系提供战略保障。中泰经贸合作是两国优势互补、市场导向的结果，本质上是互利共赢的。中国愿向泰国继续开放超大规模市场，鼓励更多企业赴泰投资兴业，拓展人工智能、算力中心、半导体等新兴领域合作，也希望泰方继续为中资企业提供稳定、良好、可预期营商环境。双方要加大联合打击网赌电诈力度，彻底铲除犯罪滋生土壤。 王毅指出，在变乱交织的国际形势下，加强邻国合作至关重要。澜湄合作是本地区最成功的次区域合作之一，中方高度赞赏泰方为澜湄合作发展作出的重要贡献，愿同泰方作为共同主席国筹备好澜湄合作第五次领导人会议。双方还要加强在亚太经合组织、中国—东盟等多边机制内协调协作，排除各种干扰，为地区和世界和平发展注入更多稳定性和确定性。 王毅介绍了中国共产党二十届五中全会情况，表示愿同泰方开展治党治国理政经验交流。 西哈萨祝贺中共二十届五中全会成功举行，高度赞赏中共“以人民为中心”的执政理念。表示泰中全面战略合作伙伴关系富有广度和深度，发展势头良好强劲。泰方坚定奉行一个中国政策，愿始终做中国的战略伙伴，共同落实好双方领导人共识，推进泰中全面战略合作伙伴关系发展，深化互联互通、经贸投资、绿色转型等领域互利合作，共同打击网赌电诈。欢迎更多中国企业来泰投资兴业。泰方赞赏中方为澜湄地区发展作出的贡献，愿发挥自身作用，同中方一道开好本次澜湄合作外长会，筹备好澜湄合作第五次领导人会议。泰方愿在国际事务中同中方加强沟通协调，共同倡导多边主义，维护以联合国为核心的国际秩序。 双方还就共同关心的地区问题交换了意见。 （来源：中国驻泰国大使馆） The post 王毅会见泰国副总理兼外长西哈萨 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 中国外交部长王毅会见泰国副总理兼外长西哈萨
summary_cn: 中国外交部长王毅11月3日在北京会见泰国副总理兼外长西哈萨。王毅重申中泰「一家亲」，表示中方赞赏泰国新政府对华友好政策，愿深化经贸合作、人工智能、算力等新兴领域合作，加大联合打击网赌电诈力度。西哈萨表示泰方坚定奉行一中政策，愿继续做中国战略伙伴，深化互联互通与经贸投资合作。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 2026年11月3日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京会见来华工作访问并出席澜湄合作第十一次外长会的泰国副总理兼外长西哈萨。 王毅表示，近年来，习近平主席同哇集拉隆功国王保持密切沟通，共同引领中泰命运共同体建设走深走实，“中泰一家亲”更加深入人心。两国始终相互理解，相互信任，相互支持，不断为传统友好注入新的时代内涵。中方赞赏阿努廷总理领导的泰国新政府坚定奉行对华友好政策，这完全符合泰国的根本长远利益，也有利于维护本地区的和平稳定。中方愿与泰方加强战略沟通，深化互利合作，推动中泰命运共同体建设不断迈上新水平。 王毅表示，中方愿同泰方筹备好下阶段高层交往，为两国关系提供战略保障。中泰经贸合作是两国优势互补、市场导向的结果，本质上是互利共赢的。中国愿向泰国继续开放超大规模市场，鼓励更多企业赴泰投资兴业，拓展人工智能、算力中心、半导体等新兴领域合作，也希望泰方继续为中资企业提供稳定、良好、可预期营商环境。双方要加大联合打击网赌电诈力度，彻底铲除犯罪滋生土壤。 王毅指出，在变乱交织的国际形势下，加强邻国合作至关重要。澜湄合作是本地区最成功的次区域合作之一，中方高度赞赏泰方为澜湄合作发展作出的重要贡献，愿同泰方作为共同主席国筹备好澜湄合作第五次领导人会议。双方还要加强在亚太经合组织、中国—东盟等多边机制内协调协作，排除各种干扰，为地区和世界和平发展注入更多稳定性和确定性。 王毅介绍了中国共产党二十届五中全会情况，表示愿同泰方开展治党治国理政经验交流。 西哈萨祝贺中共二十届五中全会成功举行，高度赞赏中共“以人民为中心”的执政理念。表示泰中全面战略合作伙伴关系富有广度和深度，发展势头良好强劲。泰方坚定奉行一个中国政策，愿始终做中国的战略伙伴，共同落实好双方领导人共识，推进泰中全面战略合作伙伴关系发展，深化互联互通、经贸投资、绿色转型等领域互利合作，共同打击网赌电诈。欢迎更多中国企业来泰投资兴业。泰方赞赏中方为澜湄地区发展作出的贡献，愿发挥自身作用，同中方一道开好本次澜湄合作外长会，筹备好澜湄合作第五次领导人会议。泰方愿在国际事务中同中方加强沟通协调，共同倡导多边主义，维护以联合国为核心的国际秩序。 双方还就共同关心的地区问题交换了意见。 （来源：中国驻泰国大使馆） The post 王毅会见泰国副总理兼外长西哈萨 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
